modelName: Timatic Data Model v5 - F04 F05 F06

collections.description: RAW historical Timatic source table at one source-aligned row per historical extract document.
collections.comments:
Purpose: RAW historical baseline from the Timatic application MongoDB domain. Source-aligned columns are preserved for migration reconciliation, replay evidence, and comparison. Historical extracts are not inferred to be current state merely because a document is absent from a later file.
Grain: one source-aligned row per historical extract document.
Source and extraction: Timatic application MongoDB historical/baseline export delivered through the data-lake historical file path.
Keys and cardinality: Technical/source primary key: document_id. Additional uniqueness: none beyond the technical PK.
History/SCD: Source-aligned RAW history/event evidence is retained. Corrections, late changes, and deletes are interpreted downstream from source metadata; absence is not a delete.
Soft deletes and absence: Historical absence is not interpreted as a deletion. Downstream current-state logic uses explicit source delete state or ODS tombstones.
Load, corrections, and reruns: External historical file ingestion; source-aligned append/snapshot behavior is orchestrated outside this analytical model. No transformation SELECT is asserted.
Data quality: cd_error/de_error and cd_alert/de_alert remain visible where modelled; key, cast, timestamp, domain, and relationship coverage are validated before CONSUMPTION publication.
Sensitive data: No new sensitive attribute is introduced by this model object; source-sensitive fields remain subject to access review.
Known limitation/assumption: No additional approved limitation.
Governance: shared structure, key, grain, SCD, or publication changes require I&D data-modeler and data-engineering review.

WITH historical_src AS (
  SELECT
    document_id,
    transaction_id,
    request_id,
    request_transaction_id,
    passenger_id,
    account_id,
    user_id,
    billing_customer_code,
    account_name,
    channel,
    channel_name,
    request_type,
    response,
    success,
    chargeable,
    departure_point,
    departure_country,
    departure_country_name,
    departure_location_type,
    destination_point,
    destination_name,
    destination_country,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS destination_country_name,
    destination_location_type,
    creation_date,
    transaction_date,
    transaction_date_time_in_millis,
    departure_date,
    destination_arrival_date,
    response_time_in_millis,
    passenger_type,
    passenger_type_name,
    gender,
    gender_name,
    age_group,
    processing_entity_id,
    processing_entity_name,
    product_code,
    product_name,
    capture_methods,
    capture_method_names,
    nationalities,
    transits,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(
        NULLIF(TRIM(document_categories), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(document_category_names), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(document_types), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(document_type_names), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(document_issue_countries), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(document_issue_country_names), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(doc_expiry_dates), '')
      ) IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE json_format(CAST(MAP(
        ARRAY[
          'document_categories',
          'document_category_names',
          'document_types',
          'document_type_names',
          'document_issue_countries',
          'document_issue_country_names',
          'doc_expiry_dates'
        ],
        ARRAY[
          COALESCE(document_categories, ''),
          COALESCE(document_category_names, ''),
          COALESCE(document_types, ''),
          COALESCE(document_type_names, ''),
          COALESCE(document_issue_countries, ''),
          COALESCE(document_issue_country_names, ''),
          COALESCE(doc_expiry_dates, '')
        ]
      ) AS JSON))
    END AS list_document_details,
    itinerary_details,
    enriched_parameters,
    parameter_list,
    hash_code,
    server_name,
    service_name,
    user_name,
    user_type,
    de_source_file_name,
    dt_load_utc,
    'historical_transaction_data' AS de_source_table,
    'historical' AS cd_source_event_type
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.historical_transaction_data
),
ods_insert_src AS (
  SELECT
    o.document_id,
    o.transaction_id,
    o.request_id,
    o.request_transaction_id,
    o.passenger_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.user_id,
    o.billing_customer_code,
    o.account_name,
    o.channel,
    o.channel_name,
    o.request_type,
    o.response,
    o.success,
    o.chargeable,
    o.departure_point,
    o.departure_country,
    o.departure_country_name,
    o.departure_location_type,
    o.destination_point,
    o.destination_name,
    o.destination_country,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS destination_country_name,
    o.destination_location_type,
    o.creation_date,
    o.transaction_date,
    o.transaction_date_time_in_millis,
    o.departure_date,
    o.destination_arrival_date,
    o.response_time_in_millis,
    o.passenger_type,
    o.passenger_type_name,
    o.gender,
    o.gender_name,
    o.age_group,
    o.processing_entity_id,
    o.processing_entity_name,
    o.product_code,
    o.product_name,
    o.capture_methods,
    o.capture_method_names,
    o.nationalities,
    o.transits,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(
        NULLIF(TRIM(o.document_categories), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(o.document_category_names), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(o.document_types), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(o.document_type_names), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(o.document_issue_countries), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(o.document_issue_country_names), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(o.doc_expiry_dates), '')
      ) IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE json_format(CAST(MAP(
        ARRAY[
          'document_categories',
          'document_category_names',
          'document_types',
          'document_type_names',
          'document_issue_countries',
          'document_issue_country_names',
          'doc_expiry_dates'
        ],
        ARRAY[
          COALESCE(o.document_categories, ''),
          COALESCE(o.document_category_names, ''),
          COALESCE(o.document_types, ''),
          COALESCE(o.document_type_names, ''),
          COALESCE(o.document_issue_countries, ''),
          COALESCE(o.document_issue_country_names, ''),
          COALESCE(o.doc_expiry_dates, '')
        ]
      ) AS JSON))
    END AS list_document_details,
    o.itinerary_details,
    o.enriched_parameters,
    o.parameter_list,
    o.hash_code,
    o.server_name,
    o.service_name,
    o.user_name,
    o.user_type,
    COALESCE(o.de_source_file_name, o.source_file_key) AS de_source_file_name,
    o.dt_load_utc,
    'ods_transaction_data' AS de_source_table,
    o.cdc_operation_type AS cd_source_event_type
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.ods_transaction_data o
  LEFT JOIN timatic4datarepositorydev.historical_transaction_data h
    ON NULLIF(TRIM(o.document_id), '') = NULLIF(TRIM(h.document_id), '')
  WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(o.cdc_operation_type, '')) = 'insert'
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(h.document_id), '') IS NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.ods_transaction_data o2
      WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(o2.cdc_operation_type, '')) = 'insert'
        AND NULLIF(TRIM(o2.document_id), '') = NULLIF(TRIM(o.document_id), '')
        AND (
          o2.dt_load_utc > o.dt_load_utc
          OR (
            o2.dt_load_utc = o.dt_load_utc
            AND COALESCE(o2.source_record_id, '') > COALESCE(o.source_record_id, '')
          )
        )
    )
),
combined AS (
  SELECT * FROM historical_src
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM ods_insert_src
),
typed AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    COALESCE(
      TRY(CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(creation_date) AS timestamp)),
      from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(creation_date AS bigint) / 1000.0)
    ) AS parsed_creation_utc,
    COALESCE(
      TRY(CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(transaction_date) AS timestamp)),
      from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(transaction_date_time_in_millis AS bigint) / 1000.0)
    ) AS parsed_transaction_utc,
    COALESCE(
      TRY(CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(departure_date) AS timestamp)),
      from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(departure_date AS bigint) / 1000.0)
    ) AS parsed_departure_utc,
    COALESCE(
      TRY(CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(destination_arrival_date) AS timestamp)),
      from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(destination_arrival_date AS bigint) / 1000.0)
    ) AS parsed_destination_arrival_utc,
    TRY(CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(dt_load_utc) AS timestamp)) AS parsed_source_load_utc
  FROM combined
)
SELECT
  to_hex(sha256(to_utf8(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''), CONCAT('missing_document_id|', COALESCE(transaction_id, ''), '|', COALESCE(request_id, '')))))) AS sk_transaction_data,
  NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') AS nk_transaction_document_id,
  NULLIF(TRIM(transaction_id), '') AS nk_transaction_id,
  NULLIF(TRIM(request_id), '') AS nk_request_id,
  NULLIF(TRIM(request_transaction_id), '') AS nk_request_transaction_id,
  NULLIF(TRIM(passenger_id), '') AS nk_passenger_id,
  NULLIF(TRIM(account_id), '') AS nk_account_id,
  NULLIF(TRIM(user_id), '') AS nk_user_id,
  NULLIF(TRIM(billing_customer_code), '') AS cd_billing_customer_code,
  NULLIF(TRIM(account_name), '') AS de_account_name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(channel), '') AS cd_channel,
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(channel), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(channel)) IN ('web', 'timaticweb', 'timaticweb2', 'timaticwidget') THEN 'web'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(channel)) IN ('counter', 'counter check-in') THEN 'counter'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(channel)) = 'mobile' THEN 'mobile'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(channel)) = 'kiosk' THEN 'kiosk'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(channel)) = 'info' THEN 'info'
    ELSE LOWER(TRIM(channel))
  END AS cd_channel_normalized,
  NULLIF(TRIM(channel_name), '') AS de_channel_name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(request_type), '') AS cd_request_type,
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(response)) = 'ok to board' THEN 'ok_to_board'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(response)) = 'conditional' THEN 'conditional'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(response)) = 'not ok to board' THEN 'not_ok_to_board'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(response)) = 'error' THEN 'error'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS cd_response_evaluation,
  NULLIF(TRIM(response), '') AS de_response_evaluation,
  TRY_CAST(success AS boolean) AS is_success,
  TRY_CAST(chargeable AS boolean) AS is_chargeable,
  NULLIF(TRIM(departure_point), '') AS cd_departure_point,
  NULLIF(TRIM(departure_country), '') AS cd_departure_country,
  NULLIF(TRIM(departure_country_name), '') AS de_departure_country_name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(departure_location_type), '') AS cd_departure_location_type,
  NULLIF(TRIM(destination_point), '') AS cd_destination_point,
  NULLIF(TRIM(destination_name), '') AS de_destination_name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(destination_country), '') AS cd_destination_country,
  NULLIF(TRIM(destination_country_name), '') AS de_destination_country_name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(destination_location_type), '') AS cd_destination_location_type,
  parsed_creation_utc AS dt_creation_utc,
  parsed_transaction_utc AS dt_transaction_utc,
  parsed_departure_utc AS dt_departure_utc,
  parsed_destination_arrival_utc AS dt_destination_arrival_utc,
  CAST(parsed_transaction_utc AS date) AS dt_transaction_date,
  date_format(COALESCE(parsed_transaction_utc, parsed_creation_utc, parsed_source_load_utc), '%Y%m%d') AS dt_partition,
  TRY_CAST(response_time_in_millis AS integer) AS ni_response_time_ms,
  NULLIF(TRIM(passenger_type), '') AS cd_passenger_type,
  NULLIF(TRIM(passenger_type_name), '') AS de_passenger_type_name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(gender), '') AS cd_gender,
  NULLIF(TRIM(gender_name), '') AS de_gender_name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(age_group), '') AS de_age_group,
  NULLIF(TRIM(processing_entity_id), '') AS cd_processing_entity_id,
  NULLIF(TRIM(processing_entity_name), '') AS de_processing_entity_name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(product_code), '') AS cd_product_code,
  NULLIF(TRIM(product_name), '') AS de_product_name,
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(capture_methods), '') IS NULL THEN CAST(NULL AS array(varchar))
    ELSE FILTER(
      TRANSFORM(SPLIT(capture_methods, ','), capture_method -> NULLIF(TRIM(capture_method), '')),
      capture_method -> capture_method IS NOT NULL
    )
  END AS arr_capture_method,
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(capture_method_names), '') IS NULL THEN CAST(NULL AS array(varchar))
    ELSE FILTER(
      TRANSFORM(SPLIT(capture_method_names, ','), capture_method_name -> NULLIF(TRIM(capture_method_name), '')),
      capture_method_name -> capture_method_name IS NOT NULL
    )
  END AS arr_capture_method_name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(nationalities), '') AS json_nationalities,
  NULLIF(TRIM(transits), '') AS json_transits,
  NULLIF(TRIM(list_document_details), '') AS json_document_details,
  NULLIF(TRIM(itinerary_details), '') AS json_itinerary_details,
  NULLIF(TRIM(enriched_parameters), '') AS json_enriched_parameters,
  NULLIF(TRIM(parameter_list), '') AS json_parameter_list,
  NULLIF(TRIM(hash_code), '') AS de_hash_code,
  NULLIF(TRIM(server_name), '') AS de_server_name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(service_name), '') AS de_service_name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(user_name), '') AS de_user_name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(user_type), '') AS cd_user_type,
  de_source_table,
  NULLIF(TRIM(de_source_file_name), '') AS de_source_file,
  cd_source_event_type,
  parsed_source_load_utc AS dt_source_load_utc,
  false AS is_deleted,
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'missing_document_id'
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(transaction_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'missing_transaction_id'
    WHEN parsed_transaction_utc IS NULL THEN 'bad_transaction_timestamp'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS cd_error,
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'Source document_id is missing.'
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(transaction_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'Source transaction_id is missing.'
    WHEN parsed_transaction_utc IS NULL THEN 'Transaction timestamp cannot be parsed from transaction_date or transaction_date_time_in_millis.'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS de_error,
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(response), '') IS NULL THEN 'missing_response'
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(account_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'missing_account_id'
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(passenger_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'missing_passenger_id'
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(departure_point), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(destination_point), '') IS NULL THEN 'missing_route_point'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS cd_alert,
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(response), '') IS NULL THEN 'Response is missing; row is retained for lineage but excluded from response-result KPIs.'
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(account_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'Account ID is missing; account dimension join will not resolve unless an alternate key is agreed.'
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(passenger_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'Passenger ID is missing; row cannot contribute to passenger-journey KPIs.'
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(departure_point), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(destination_point), '') IS NULL THEN 'Route endpoint is missing; route/location analytics may be incomplete.'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS de_alert,
  CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS run_id,
  CONCAT(de_source_table, ':', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''), COALESCE(transaction_id, 'missing'))) AS source_id,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_update_utc
FROM typed

    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(transaction_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'missing_transaction_id'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS cd_error,
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'Source document_id is missing.'
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(transaction_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'Source transaction_id is missing.'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS de_error,
  CASE
    WHEN matched_parent_transaction_id IS NULL THEN 'missing_transaction_parent'
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(segment_departure_point), '') IS NULL THEN 'missing_segment_departure_point'
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(segment_destination_point), '') IS NULL THEN 'missing_segment_destination_point'
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(segment_response), '') IS NULL THEN 'missing_segment_response'
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(rule_sets_and_response), '') IS NULL THEN 'missing_rule_sets_and_response'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS cd_alert,
  CASE
    WHEN matched_parent_transaction_id IS NULL THEN 'No parent transaction matched by transaction_id. SITA confirmed transaction_id is the transaction-to-segment join key; unmatched rows can exist for request types without segment records.'
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(segment_departure_point), '') IS NULL THEN 'Segment departure point is missing.'
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(segment_destination_point), '') IS NULL THEN 'Segment destination point is missing.'

    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(rule_sets_and_response), '') IS NULL THEN 'Rule sets and response payload is missing.'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS de_alert,

  CONCAT(de_source_table, ':', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''), COALESCE(transaction_id, 'missing'))) AS source_id,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_update_utc
FROM typed

collections.description: CONFORMED st_segment_transaction_info_data at one row per reconstructed segment-info source document.
collections.comments:
Purpose: CONFORMED typed and validated table sourced from Bronze historical and ODS. Surrogate keys are generated, source natural keys are retained, DQ fields are visible. The deterministic sk_ remains the technical primary key while a separately declared natural/version unique key documents the logical row grain. dt_load_utc is audit-only. Latest ST load contract deduplicates ODS re-emissions and uses source business timestamps before CDC/load tie-breakers for SCD current-state sequencing.
Grain: one row per reconstructed segment-info source document.
Source and extraction: raw.historical_segment_transaction_info_data; raw.ods_segment_transaction_info_data
Keys and cardinality: Technical primary key: sk_segment_transaction_info_data. Logical alternate unique key: nk_segment_transaction_info_document_id. The alternate key is declared separately from sk_ so duplicate source documents or business versions cannot be hidden by the surrogate key. dt_load_utc is audit lineage, not row identity; source CDC/order fields remain deterministic deduplication tie-breakers. Key-component DQ is enforced by the canonical load/tests while flagged CONFORMED evidence remains traceable.
History/SCD: CDC documents are deduplicated/reconstructed using confirmed document identity and source-business/CDC/load tie-breakers. SCD entities use is_current and dt_valid_from/dt_valid_to when present.
Soft deletes and absence: Explicit source deleted flags and reconstructed CDC tombstones drive is_deleted. Absence from an incremental load never creates a soft delete.
Load, corrections, and reruns: Canonical CONFORMED load is rerunnable at the declared deterministic key. The Hackolade As Select Statement contains the canonical transformation extracted from model_package/sql/04_conformed_st_load_sql.sql. Warnings load with visible alerts; rows that cannot be safely interpreted remain flagged or are excluded only according to the canonical eligibility contract.
Data quality: cd_error/de_error and cd_alert/de_alert remain visible where modelled; key, cast, timestamp, domain, and relationship coverage are validated before CONSUMPTION publication.
Sensitive data: No new sensitive attribute is introduced by this model object; source-sensitive fields remain subject to access review.
Known limitation/assumption: No additional approved limitation.
Governance: shared structure, key, grain, SCD, or publication changes require I&D data-modeler and data-engineering review.

WITH src AS (
  SELECT
    document_id,
    billing_customer_code,
    iata_code,
    salesforce_account_id,
    organization_account_name,
    category,
    status,
    country,
    iso_country,
    region,
    sub_region,
    sector,
    iata_designator,
    icao_designator,
    dcs_processing_entity,
    iata_account_indicator,
    product_subscriptions,
    created_date,
    created_date_time,
    last_modified_date,
    last_modified_date_time,
    de_source_file_name,
    dt_load_utc,
    'historical_accounts' AS de_source_table,
    'historical' AS cd_source_event_type,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS cdc_cluster_time,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS cdc_wall_time,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS cdc_event_id,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS source_record_id
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.historical_accounts
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract_scalar(cdc_document_key, '$._id')), '')) AS document_id,
    billing_customer_code,
    iata_code,
    salesforce_account_id,
    organization_account_name,
    category,
    status,
    country,
    iso_country,
    region,
    sub_region,
    sector,
    iata_designator,
    icao_designator,
    dcs_processing_entity,
    iata_account_indicator,
    product_subscriptions,
    created_date,
    created_date AS created_date_time,
    last_modified_date,
    last_modified_date_time,
    COALESCE(de_source_file_name, source_file_key) AS de_source_file_name,
    dt_load_utc,
    'ods_accounts' AS de_source_table,
    cdc_operation_type AS cd_source_event_type,
    cdc_cluster_time,
    cdc_wall_time,
    cdc_event_id,
    source_record_id
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.ods_accounts
  WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(cdc_operation_type, '')) NOT IN ('delete', 'drop')
    -- Account CDC updates can be partial payloads. Without a source-state
    -- merge, do not let sparse ODS rows overwrite the full historical
    -- baseline as the current account dimensional record.
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(organization_account_name), '') IS NOT NULL
),
typed AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    COALESCE(TRY(CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(created_date) AS timestamp)), from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(created_date_time AS bigint) / 1000.0)) AS parsed_created_utc,
    COALESCE(TRY(CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(last_modified_date) AS timestamp)), from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(last_modified_date_time AS bigint) / 1000.0)) AS parsed_last_modified_utc,
    from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(cdc_cluster_time AS bigint) / 1000.0) AS parsed_cdc_cluster_utc,
    COALESCE(TRY(CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(cdc_wall_time) AS timestamp)), TRY_CAST(cdc_wall_time AS timestamp)) AS parsed_cdc_wall_utc,
    TRY(CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(dt_load_utc) AS timestamp)) AS parsed_source_load_utc
  FROM src
),
versioned AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    COALESCE(parsed_last_modified_utc, parsed_created_utc, parsed_cdc_cluster_utc, parsed_cdc_wall_utc, parsed_source_load_utc) AS dt_valid_from_candidate
  FROM typed
),
versioned_dedup AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY to_hex(sha256(to_utf8(CONCAT(
          COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''), 'missing_account_id'), '|',
          CAST(COALESCE(dt_valid_from_candidate, TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00') AS varchar)))))
        ORDER BY dt_valid_from_candidate DESC,
                 COALESCE(parsed_cdc_cluster_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) DESC,
                 COALESCE(parsed_cdc_wall_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) DESC,
                 parsed_source_load_utc DESC,
                 COALESCE(cdc_event_id, '') DESC,
                 COALESCE(source_record_id, '') DESC
      ) AS rn_version_dedup
    FROM versioned
  ) x
  WHERE rn_version_dedup = 1
),
sequenced AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '')
      ORDER BY dt_valid_from_candidate DESC, COALESCE(parsed_cdc_cluster_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) DESC, COALESCE(parsed_cdc_wall_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) DESC, parsed_source_load_utc DESC, COALESCE(cdc_event_id, '') DESC, COALESCE(source_record_id, '') DESC
    ) AS rn_desc,
    LEAD(dt_valid_from_candidate) OVER (
      PARTITION BY NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '')
      ORDER BY dt_valid_from_candidate ASC, COALESCE(parsed_cdc_cluster_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) ASC, COALESCE(parsed_cdc_wall_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) ASC, parsed_source_load_utc ASC, COALESCE(cdc_event_id, '') ASC, COALESCE(source_record_id, '') ASC
    ) AS next_valid_from
  FROM versioned_dedup
)
SELECT
  to_hex(sha256(to_utf8(CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''), 'missing_account_id'), '|', CAST(COALESCE(dt_valid_from_candidate, TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00') AS varchar))))) AS sk_account,
  NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') AS nk_account_id,
  NULLIF(TRIM(billing_customer_code), '') AS ak_billing_customer_code,
  NULLIF(TRIM(iata_code), '') AS ak_iata_code,
  NULLIF(TRIM(salesforce_account_id), '') AS ak_salesforce_account_id,
  NULLIF(TRIM(organization_account_name), '') AS de_account_name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(category), '') AS cd_account_category,
  NULLIF(TRIM(status), '') AS cd_account_status,
  NULLIF(TRIM(country), '') AS cd_country,
  NULLIF(TRIM(iso_country), '') AS cd_iso_country,
  NULLIF(TRIM(region), '') AS cd_region,
  NULLIF(TRIM(sub_region), '') AS cd_sub_region,
  NULLIF(TRIM(sector), '') AS cd_sector,
  NULLIF(TRIM(iata_designator), '') AS cd_iata_designator,
  NULLIF(TRIM(icao_designator), '') AS cd_icao_designator,
  NULLIF(TRIM(dcs_processing_entity), '') AS cd_dcs_processing_entity,
  TRY_CAST(iata_account_indicator AS boolean) AS is_iata_account,
  NULLIF(TRIM(product_subscriptions), '') AS json_product_subscriptions,
  parsed_created_utc AS dt_created_utc,
  parsed_last_modified_utc AS dt_last_modified_utc,
  de_source_table,
  NULLIF(TRIM(de_source_file_name), '') AS de_source_file,
  cd_source_event_type,
  parsed_source_load_utc AS dt_source_load_utc,
  false AS is_deleted,
  rn_desc = 1 AS is_current,
  dt_valid_from_candidate AS dt_valid_from,
  COALESCE(next_valid_from, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59') AS dt_valid_to,
  date_format(dt_valid_from_candidate, '%Y%m%d') AS dt_partition,
  CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'missing_account_id' ELSE NULL END AS cd_error,
  CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'Source account document_id is missing.' ELSE NULL END AS de_error,
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(cd_source_event_type, '')) = 'update' AND NULLIF(TRIM(organization_account_name), '') IS NULL THEN 'possible_partial_cdc_update'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS cd_alert,
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(cd_source_event_type, '')) = 'update' AND NULLIF(TRIM(organization_account_name), '') IS NULL THEN 'ODS update event may not contain the full account business payload.'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS de_alert,
  CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS run_id,
  CONCAT(de_source_table, ':', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''), COALESCE(cdc_event_id, 'missing'))) AS source_id,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_update_utc
FROM sequenced

    'historical' AS cd_source_event_type,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS cdc_cluster_time,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS cdc_wall_time,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS cdc_event_id,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS source_record_id
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.historical_user
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract_scalar(cdc_document_key, '$._id')), '')) AS document_id,
    user_id,
    account_id,

    title,
    status,

    created_date_time,

    cdc_cluster_time,
    cdc_wall_time,
    cdc_event_id,
    source_record_id
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.ods_user
  WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(cdc_operation_type, '')) NOT IN ('delete', 'drop')
    -- User CDC update events can be partial payloads. Allow inserts/replaces,
    -- but only allow update events to participate in current-state sequencing
    -- when they carry the stable user business key.
    AND (
      LOWER(COALESCE(cdc_operation_type, '')) <> 'update'
      OR NULLIF(TRIM(user_id), '') IS NOT NULL
    )
),
typed AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(created_date_time AS bigint) / 1000.0) AS parsed_created_utc,
    from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(last_login_time AS bigint) / 1000.0) AS parsed_last_login_utc,
    from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(last_modified_date_time AS bigint) / 1000.0) AS parsed_last_modified_utc,
    from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(last_password_change_date_time AS bigint) / 1000.0) AS parsed_last_password_change_utc,

),
versioned_dedup AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY to_hex(sha256(to_utf8(CONCAT(
          COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(user_id), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''), 'missing_user_id'), '|',
          CAST(COALESCE(dt_valid_from_candidate, TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00') AS varchar)))))
        ORDER BY dt_valid_from_candidate DESC,
                 COALESCE(parsed_cdc_cluster_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) DESC,
                 COALESCE(parsed_cdc_wall_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) DESC,
                 parsed_source_load_utc DESC,
                 COALESCE(cdc_event_id, '') DESC,
                 COALESCE(source_record_id, '') DESC
      ) AS rn_version_dedup
    FROM versioned
  ) x
  WHERE rn_version_dedup = 1
),
sequenced AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(user_id), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''))
      ORDER BY dt_valid_from_candidate DESC, COALESCE(parsed_cdc_cluster_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) DESC, COALESCE(parsed_cdc_wall_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) DESC, parsed_source_load_utc DESC, COALESCE(cdc_event_id, '') DESC, COALESCE(source_record_id, '') DESC
    ) AS rn_desc,
    LEAD(dt_valid_from_candidate) OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(user_id), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''))
      ORDER BY dt_valid_from_candidate ASC, COALESCE(parsed_cdc_cluster_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) ASC, COALESCE(parsed_cdc_wall_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) ASC, parsed_source_load_utc ASC, COALESCE(cdc_event_id, '') ASC, COALESCE(source_record_id, '') ASC
    ) AS next_valid_from
  FROM versioned_dedup
)
SELECT
  to_hex(sha256(to_utf8(CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(user_id), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''), 'missing_user_id'), '|', CAST(COALESCE(dt_valid_from_candidate, TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00') AS varchar))))) AS sk_user,
  NULLIF(TRIM(user_id), '') AS nk_user_id,
  NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') AS nk_user_document_id,
  NULLIF(TRIM(account_id), '') AS nk_account_id,
  NULLIF(TRIM(salesforce_identifier), '') AS ak_salesforce_identifier,
  NULLIF(TRIM(user_name), '') AS de_user_name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(first_name), '') AS de_first_name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(last_name), '') AS de_last_name,
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(email), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN regexp_like(email, '^[^@]+@[^@]+$') THEN regexp_replace(email, '(^.).*(@.*$)', '$1***$2')
    ELSE '***'
  END AS de_email_masked,
  NULLIF(TRIM(title), '') AS de_title,
  NULLIF(TRIM(status), '') AS cd_user_status,
  NULLIF(TRIM(access_type), '') AS cd_access_type,
  TRY_CAST(cli_lines AS integer) AS ni_cli_line_count,
  NULLIF(TRIM(product_subscriptions), '') AS json_product_subscriptions,
  NULLIF(TRIM(rest_clients), '') AS json_rest_clients,
  NULLIF(TRIM(organisations_can_submit_request), '') AS json_organisations_can_submit_request,
  NULLIF(TRIM(submit_request_for_organisations), '') AS json_submit_request_for_organisations,

  parsed_last_login_utc AS dt_last_login_utc,
  parsed_last_modified_utc AS dt_last_modified_utc,
  parsed_last_password_change_utc AS dt_last_password_change_utc,
  de_source_table,
  NULLIF(TRIM(de_source_file_name), '') AS de_source_file,
  cd_source_event_type,
  parsed_source_load_utc AS dt_source_load_utc,
  false AS is_deleted,
  rn_desc = 1 AS is_current,
  dt_valid_from_candidate AS dt_valid_from,
  COALESCE(next_valid_from, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59') AS dt_valid_to,
  date_format(dt_valid_from_candidate, '%Y%m%d') AS dt_partition,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(user_id), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '')) IS NULL THEN 'missing_user_key'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS cd_error,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(user_id), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '')) IS NULL THEN 'Both user_id and document_id are missing.'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS de_error,
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(account_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'missing_account_id'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS cd_alert,
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(account_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'User cannot join to account by account_id.'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS de_alert,
  CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS run_id,
  CONCAT(de_source_table, ':', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(user_id), ''), COALESCE(cdc_event_id, 'missing'))) AS source_id,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_update_utc
FROM sequenced

    COALESCE(de_source_file_name, source_file_key) AS de_source_file_name,
    dt_load_utc,
    'ods_location' AS de_source_table,
    cdc_operation_type AS cd_source_event_type,
    cdc_cluster_time,
    cdc_wall_time,
    cdc_event_id,
    source_record_id
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.ods_location
  WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(cdc_operation_type, '')) NOT IN ('delete', 'drop')
    -- Location CDC updates can be partial payloads. Without a source-state
    -- merge, do not let partial ODS rows overwrite the full historical
    -- baseline as the current dimensional record.
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(code), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(syscode), '')) IS NOT NULL
),
typed AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(created_date_time AS bigint) / 1000.0) AS parsed_created_utc,
    from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(last_modified_date_time AS bigint) / 1000.0) AS parsed_last_modified_utc,
    from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(start_date_time AS bigint) / 1000.0) AS parsed_start_utc,
    from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(end_date_time AS bigint) / 1000.0) AS parsed_end_utc,
    from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(cdc_cluster_time AS bigint) / 1000.0) AS parsed_cdc_cluster_utc,
    COALESCE(TRY(CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(cdc_wall_time) AS timestamp)), TRY_CAST(cdc_wall_time AS timestamp)) AS parsed_cdc_wall_utc,
    TRY(CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(dt_load_utc) AS timestamp)) AS parsed_source_load_utc
  FROM src
),
versioned AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    COALESCE(parsed_last_modified_utc, parsed_created_utc, parsed_cdc_cluster_utc, parsed_cdc_wall_utc, parsed_source_load_utc) AS dt_valid_from_candidate
  FROM typed
),
versioned_dedup AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY to_hex(sha256(to_utf8(CONCAT(
          COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''), 'missing_location_id'), '|',
          CAST(COALESCE(dt_valid_from_candidate, TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00') AS varchar)))))
        ORDER BY dt_valid_from_candidate DESC,
                 COALESCE(parsed_cdc_cluster_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) DESC,
                 COALESCE(parsed_cdc_wall_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) DESC,
                 parsed_source_load_utc DESC,
                 COALESCE(cdc_event_id, '') DESC,
                 COALESCE(source_record_id, '') DESC
      ) AS rn_version_dedup
    FROM versioned
  ) x
  WHERE rn_version_dedup = 1
),
sequenced AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '')
      ORDER BY dt_valid_from_candidate DESC, COALESCE(parsed_cdc_cluster_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) DESC, COALESCE(parsed_cdc_wall_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) DESC, parsed_source_load_utc DESC, COALESCE(cdc_event_id, '') DESC, COALESCE(source_record_id, '') DESC
    ) AS rn_desc,
    LEAD(dt_valid_from_candidate) OVER (
      PARTITION BY NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '')
      ORDER BY dt_valid_from_candidate ASC, COALESCE(parsed_cdc_cluster_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) ASC, COALESCE(parsed_cdc_wall_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) ASC, parsed_source_load_utc ASC, COALESCE(cdc_event_id, '') ASC, COALESCE(source_record_id, '') ASC
    ) AS next_valid_from
  FROM versioned_dedup
)
SELECT
  to_hex(sha256(to_utf8(CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''), 'missing_location_id'), '|', CAST(COALESCE(dt_valid_from_candidate, TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00') AS varchar))))) AS sk_location,
  NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') AS nk_location_id,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(code), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(syscode), '')) AS cd_location_code,
  NULLIF(TRIM(code), '') AS cd_code,
  NULLIF(TRIM(code2), '') AS cd_code2,
  NULLIF(TRIM(code3), '') AS cd_code3,
  NULLIF(TRIM(code5), '') AS cd_code5,
  NULLIF(TRIM(syscode), '') AS cd_syscode,
  NULLIF(TRIM(parent_syscode), '') AS cd_parent_syscode,
  NULLIF(TRIM(location_type), '') AS cd_location_type,
  NULLIF(TRIM(name), '') AS de_location_name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(description), '') AS de_description,
  TRY_CAST(latitude AS double) AS nd_latitude,
  TRY_CAST(longitude AS double) AS nd_longitude,
  TRY_CAST(deleted AS boolean) AS is_deleted,
  TRY_CAST(is_group_value AS boolean) AS is_group,
  TRY_CAST(common_transit AS boolean) AS is_common_transit,
  TRY_CAST(expose_to_cli AS boolean) AS is_expose_to_cli,
  TRY_CAST(cli_only AS boolean) AS is_cli_only,
  NULLIF(TRIM(aliases), '') AS json_aliases,
  NULLIF(TRIM(members), '') AS json_members,
  NULLIF(TRIM(keywords), '') AS json_keywords,
  NULLIF(TRIM(cli_keywords), '') AS json_cli_keywords,
  NULLIF(TRIM(extensions), '') AS json_extensions,
  parsed_created_utc AS dt_created_utc,
  parsed_last_modified_utc AS dt_last_modified_utc,
  parsed_start_utc AS dt_start_utc,
  parsed_end_utc AS dt_end_utc,
  de_source_table,
  NULLIF(TRIM(de_source_file_name), '') AS de_source_file,
  cd_source_event_type,
  parsed_source_load_utc AS dt_source_load_utc,
  rn_desc = 1 AS is_current,
  dt_valid_from_candidate AS dt_valid_from,
  COALESCE(next_valid_from, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59') AS dt_valid_to,
  date_format(dt_valid_from_candidate, '%Y%m%d') AS dt_partition,
  CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'missing_location_id' ELSE NULL END AS cd_error,
  CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'Source location document_id is missing.' ELSE NULL END AS de_error,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(code), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(syscode), '')) IS NULL THEN 'missing_location_code'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS cd_alert,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(code), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(syscode), '')) IS NULL THEN 'No candidate location code is populated.'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS de_alert,
  CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS run_id,
  CONCAT(de_source_table, ':', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''), COALESCE(cdc_event_id, 'missing'))) AS source_id,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_update_utc
FROM sequenced

History/SCD: CDC documents are deduplicated/reconstructed using confirmed document identity and source-business/CDC/load tie-breakers. SCD entities use is_current and dt_valid_from/dt_valid_to when present.

The Hackolade As Select Statement contains the canonical transformation extracted from model_package/sql/04_conformed_st_load_sql.sql. Warnings load with visible alerts; rows that cannot be safely interpreted remain flagged or are excluded only according to the canonical eligibility contract.

Sensitive data: No new sensitive attribute is introduced by this model object; source-sensitive fields remain subject to access review.

collections.selectStatement:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT
    document_id,
    country_code,
    country_name,
    rule_set_type_code,
    rule_set_type_name,
    active_status_type,
    status_type,
    version,
    rules,
    created_date_time,
    start_date_time,
    end_date_time,
    de_source_file_name,
    dt_load_utc,
    'historical_searchable_rule_set' AS de_source_table,
    'historical' AS cd_source_event_type,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS cdc_cluster_time,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS cdc_wall_time,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS cdc_event_id,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS source_record_id
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.historical_searchable_rule_set
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract_scalar(cdc_document_key, '$._id')), '')) AS document_id,
    country_code,
    country_name,
    rule_set_type_code,
    rule_set_type_name,
    active_status_type,
    status_type,
    version,
    rules,
    created_date_time,
    start_date_time,
    end_date_time,
    COALESCE(de_source_file_name, source_file_key) AS de_source_file_name,
    dt_load_utc,
    'ods_searchable_rule_set' AS de_source_table,
    cdc_operation_type AS cd_source_event_type,
    cdc_cluster_time,
    cdc_wall_time,
    cdc_event_id,
    source_record_id
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.ods_searchable_rule_set
  WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(cdc_operation_type, '')) NOT IN ('delete', 'drop')
    -- Searchable rule set CDC update events can be partial payloads. Allow
    -- inserts/replaces, but only allow update events to participate in
    -- current-state sequencing when the core business payload is present.
    AND (
      LOWER(COALESCE(cdc_operation_type, '')) <> 'update'
      OR (
        NULLIF(TRIM(country_code), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND NULLIF(TRIM(rule_set_type_code), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND NULLIF(TRIM(rules), '') IS NOT NULL
      )
    )
),
typed AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(created_date_time AS bigint) / 1000.0) AS parsed_created_utc,
    from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(start_date_time AS bigint) / 1000.0) AS parsed_start_utc,
    from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(end_date_time AS bigint) / 1000.0) AS parsed_end_utc,
    from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(cdc_cluster_time AS bigint) / 1000.0) AS parsed_cdc_cluster_utc,
    COALESCE(TRY(CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(cdc_wall_time) AS timestamp)), TRY_CAST(cdc_wall_time AS timestamp)) AS parsed_cdc_wall_utc,
    TRY(CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(dt_load_utc) AS timestamp)) AS parsed_source_load_utc
  FROM src
),
versioned AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    COALESCE(parsed_start_utc, parsed_created_utc, parsed_cdc_cluster_utc, parsed_cdc_wall_utc, parsed_source_load_utc) AS dt_valid_from_candidate,
    COALESCE(parsed_created_utc, parsed_cdc_cluster_utc, parsed_cdc_wall_utc, parsed_source_load_utc) AS dt_partition_candidate
  FROM typed
),
versioned_dedup AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY to_hex(sha256(to_utf8(CONCAT(
          COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''), 'missing_searchable_rule_set_id'), '|',
          CAST(COALESCE(dt_valid_from_candidate, TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00') AS varchar), '|',
          COALESCE(version, '')))))
        ORDER BY TRY_CAST(version AS integer) DESC,
                 dt_valid_from_candidate DESC,
                 COALESCE(parsed_cdc_cluster_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) DESC,
                 COALESCE(parsed_cdc_wall_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) DESC,
                 parsed_source_load_utc DESC,
                 COALESCE(cdc_event_id, '') DESC,
                 COALESCE(source_record_id, '') DESC
      ) AS rn_version_dedup
    FROM versioned
  ) x
  WHERE rn_version_dedup = 1
),
sequenced AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '')
      ORDER BY TRY_CAST(version AS integer) DESC, dt_valid_from_candidate DESC, COALESCE(parsed_cdc_cluster_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) DESC, COALESCE(parsed_cdc_wall_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) DESC, parsed_source_load_utc DESC, COALESCE(cdc_event_id, '') DESC, COALESCE(source_record_id, '') DESC
    ) AS rn_desc,
    LEAD(dt_valid_from_candidate) OVER (
      PARTITION BY NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '')
      ORDER BY TRY_CAST(version AS integer) ASC, dt_valid_from_candidate ASC, COALESCE(parsed_cdc_cluster_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) ASC, COALESCE(parsed_cdc_wall_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) ASC, parsed_source_load_utc ASC, COALESCE(cdc_event_id, '') ASC, COALESCE(source_record_id, '') ASC
    ) AS next_valid_from
  FROM versioned_dedup
)
SELECT
  to_hex(sha256(to_utf8(CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''), 'missing_searchable_rule_set_id'), '|', CAST(COALESCE(dt_valid_from_candidate, TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00') AS varchar), '|', COALESCE(version, ''))))) AS sk_searchable_rule_set,
  NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') AS nk_searchable_rule_set_id,
  NULLIF(TRIM(country_code), '') AS cd_country_code,
  NULLIF(TRIM(country_name), '') AS de_country_name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(rule_set_type_code), '') AS cd_rule_set_type,
  NULLIF(TRIM(rule_set_type_name), '') AS de_rule_set_type_name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(active_status_type), '') AS cd_active_status_type,
  NULLIF(TRIM(status_type), '') AS cd_status_type,
  TRY_CAST(version AS integer) AS ni_version,
  NULLIF(TRIM(rules), '') AS json_rules,
  parsed_created_utc AS dt_created_utc,
  parsed_start_utc AS dt_start_utc,
  parsed_end_utc AS dt_end_utc,
  de_source_table,
  NULLIF(TRIM(de_source_file_name), '') AS de_source_file,
  cd_source_event_type,
  parsed_source_load_utc AS dt_source_load_utc,
  CASE
    WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(active_status_type), ''), '')) IN ('D_DELETE', 'DELETED', 'INACTIVE')
      OR UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(status_type), ''), '')) IN ('D_DELETE', 'DELETED', 'INACTIVE') THEN true
    ELSE false
  END AS is_deleted,
  rn_desc = 1 AS is_current,
  dt_valid_from_candidate AS dt_valid_from,
  COALESCE(next_valid_from, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59') AS dt_valid_to,
  date_format(dt_partition_candidate, '%Y%m%d') AS dt_partition,
  CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'missing_searchable_rule_set_id' ELSE NULL END AS cd_error,
  CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'Source searchable rule set document_id is missing.' ELSE NULL END AS de_error,
  CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(rules), '') IS NULL THEN 'missing_rules_payload' ELSE NULL END AS cd_alert,
  CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(rules), '') IS NULL THEN 'Searchable rule set rules payload is missing.' ELSE NULL END AS de_alert,
  CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS run_id,
  CONCAT(de_source_table, ':', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''), COALESCE(cdc_event_id, 'missing'))) AS source_id,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_update_utc
FROM sequenced

versioned AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    COALESCE(parsed_last_modified_utc, parsed_created_utc, parsed_cdc_cluster_utc, parsed_cdc_wall_utc, parsed_source_load_utc) AS dt_valid_from_candidate,
    COALESCE(parsed_cdc_cluster_utc, parsed_cdc_wall_utc, parsed_last_modified_utc, parsed_created_utc, parsed_source_load_utc) AS dt_source_order_utc

),
