  FROM (
    SELECT
      *,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY to_hex(sha256(to_utf8(CONCAT(
          COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''), 'missing_rule_text_lookup_id'), '|',
          CAST(COALESCE(dt_valid_from_candidate, TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00') AS varchar), '|',
          COALESCE(version, '')))))
        ORDER BY TRY_CAST(version AS integer) DESC,
                 dt_valid_from_candidate DESC,
                 COALESCE(parsed_cdc_cluster_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) DESC,
                 COALESCE(parsed_cdc_wall_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) DESC,
                 parsed_source_load_utc DESC,
                 COALESCE(cdc_event_id, '') DESC,
                 COALESCE(source_record_id, '') DESC
      ) AS rn_version_dedup
    FROM versioned
  ) x
  WHERE rn_version_dedup = 1
),
latest_business_event AS (
  SELECT
    business_document_id,
    dt_latest_business_order_utc,
    latest_business_cdc_event_id,
    latest_business_source_record_id
  FROM (
    SELECT
      NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') AS business_document_id,
      dt_source_order_utc AS dt_latest_business_order_utc,
      cdc_event_id AS latest_business_cdc_event_id,
      source_record_id AS latest_business_source_record_id,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '')
        ORDER BY COALESCE(dt_source_order_utc, TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00') DESC, parsed_source_load_utc DESC, COALESCE(cdc_event_id, '') DESC, COALESCE(source_record_id, '') DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM versioned_dedup
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) x
  WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_tombstone AS (
  SELECT
    tombstone_document_id,
    tombstone_source_event_type,
    dt_tombstone_order_utc,
    tombstone_cdc_event_id,
    tombstone_source_record_id
  FROM (
    SELECT
      document_id AS tombstone_document_id,
      cd_source_event_type AS tombstone_source_event_type,
      COALESCE(tombstone_cdc_cluster_utc, tombstone_cdc_wall_utc, tombstone_source_load_utc) AS dt_tombstone_order_utc,
      cdc_event_id AS tombstone_cdc_event_id,
      source_record_id AS tombstone_source_record_id,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY document_id
        ORDER BY COALESCE(tombstone_cdc_cluster_utc, tombstone_cdc_wall_utc, tombstone_source_load_utc, TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00') DESC, tombstone_source_load_utc DESC, COALESCE(cdc_event_id, '') DESC, COALESCE(source_record_id, '') DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM tombstone_typed
  ) x
  WHERE rn = 1
),
sequenced AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '')
      ORDER BY TRY_CAST(version AS integer) DESC, dt_valid_from_candidate DESC, COALESCE(parsed_cdc_cluster_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) DESC, COALESCE(parsed_cdc_wall_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) DESC, parsed_source_load_utc DESC, COALESCE(cdc_event_id, '') DESC, COALESCE(source_record_id, '') DESC
    ) AS rn_desc,
    LEAD(dt_valid_from_candidate) OVER (
      PARTITION BY NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '')
      ORDER BY TRY_CAST(version AS integer) ASC, dt_valid_from_candidate ASC, COALESCE(parsed_cdc_cluster_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) ASC, COALESCE(parsed_cdc_wall_utc, dt_valid_from_candidate) ASC, parsed_source_load_utc ASC, COALESCE(cdc_event_id, '') ASC, COALESCE(source_record_id, '') ASC
    ) AS next_valid_from
  FROM versioned_dedup
)
SELECT
  to_hex(sha256(to_utf8(CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''), 'missing_rule_text_lookup_id'), '|', CAST(COALESCE(dt_valid_from_candidate, TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00') AS varchar), '|', COALESCE(version, ''))))) AS sk_rule_set_rule_text_lookup,
  NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') AS nk_rule_text_lookup_id,
  NULLIF(TRIM(rule_set_id), '') AS nk_rule_set_id,
  NULLIF(TRIM(rule_text_id), '') AS nk_rule_text_id,
  NULLIF(TRIM(rule_out_come_id), '') AS nk_rule_outcome_id,
  NULLIF(TRIM(rule_set_type), '') AS cd_rule_set_type,
  NULLIF(TRIM(rule_set_type_description), '') AS de_rule_set_type_description,
  NULLIF(TRIM(rule_evaluation_result_type), '') AS cd_rule_evaluation_result_type,
  NULLIF(TRIM(rule_type), '') AS cd_rule_type,
  NULLIF(TRIM(regulation), '') AS cd_regulation,
  NULLIF(TRIM(regulation_desc), '') AS de_regulation_description,
  NULLIF(TRIM(location), '') AS cd_location,
  NULLIF(TRIM(location_description), '') AS de_location_description,
  NULLIF(TRIM(sys_code), '') AS cd_sys_code,
  NULLIF(TRIM(active_status_type), '') AS cd_active_status_type,
  NULLIF(TRIM(status_type), '') AS cd_status_type,
  NULLIF(TRIM(category_codes), '') AS json_category_codes,
  NULLIF(TRIM(rule_text), '') AS de_rule_text,
  TRY_CAST(version AS integer) AS ni_version,
  parsed_created_utc AS dt_created_utc,
  parsed_last_modified_utc AS dt_last_modified_utc,
  parsed_rule_set_start_utc AS dt_rule_set_start_utc,
  parsed_rule_set_end_utc AS dt_rule_set_end_utc,
  de_source_table,
  NULLIF(TRIM(de_source_file_name), '') AS de_source_file,
  cd_source_event_type,
  parsed_source_load_utc AS dt_source_load_utc,
  CASE
    WHEN rn_desc = 1
      AND lt.tombstone_document_id IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        COALESCE(lt.dt_tombstone_order_utc, TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00') > COALESCE(lb.dt_latest_business_order_utc, TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00')
        OR (
          COALESCE(lt.dt_tombstone_order_utc, TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00') = COALESCE(lb.dt_latest_business_order_utc, TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00')
          AND COALESCE(lt.tombstone_cdc_event_id, '') > COALESCE(lb.latest_business_cdc_event_id, '')
        )
        OR (
          COALESCE(lt.dt_tombstone_order_utc, TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00') = COALESCE(lb.dt_latest_business_order_utc, TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00')
          AND COALESCE(lt.tombstone_cdc_event_id, '') = COALESCE(lb.latest_business_cdc_event_id, '')
          AND COALESCE(lt.tombstone_source_record_id, '') > COALESCE(lb.latest_business_source_record_id, '')
        )
      ) THEN true
    WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(active_status_type), ''), '')) IN ('D_DELETE', 'DELETED', 'INACTIVE')
      OR UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(status_type), ''), '')) IN ('D_DELETE', 'DELETED', 'INACTIVE') THEN true
    ELSE false
  END AS is_deleted,
  rn_desc = 1 AS is_current,
  dt_valid_from_candidate AS dt_valid_from,
  COALESCE(next_valid_from, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59') AS dt_valid_to,
  date_format(dt_valid_from_candidate, '%Y%m%d') AS dt_partition,
  CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'missing_rule_text_lookup_id' ELSE NULL END AS cd_error,
  CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'Source rule text lookup document_id is missing.' ELSE NULL END AS de_error,
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(rule_set_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'missing_rule_set_id'
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(rule_text_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'missing_rule_text_id'
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(rule_text), '') IS NULL THEN 'missing_rule_text'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS cd_alert,
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(rule_set_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'Rule set ID is missing.'
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(rule_text_id), '') IS NULL THEN 'Rule text ID is missing.'
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(rule_text), '') IS NULL THEN 'Rule text is missing.'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS de_alert,
  CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS run_id,
  CONCAT(de_source_table, ':', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''), COALESCE(cdc_event_id, 'missing'))) AS source_id,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_update_utc
FROM sequenced
LEFT JOIN latest_business_event lb
  ON NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') = lb.business_document_id
LEFT JOIN latest_tombstone lt
  ON NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') = lt.tombstone_document_id

collections.description: CONFORMED st_role_or_action_group at one current row per role/action-group source document.
collections.comments:
Purpose: CONFORMED current role/action catalogue at one source document per row. The SHA-256 sk_ is unique, the source document ID is retained as nk_, sparse fields are overlaid independently, and invalid definitions remain visible through DQ columns.
Grain: one current row per role/action-group source document.
Source and extraction: raw.historical_role_or_action_group; raw.ods_role_or_action_group
Keys and cardinality: Technical primary key: sk_role_or_action_group. Logical alternate unique key: nk_role_or_action_group_id. The alternate key is declared separately from sk_ so duplicate source documents or business versions cannot be hidden by the surrogate key. dt_load_utc is audit lineage, not row identity; source CDC/order fields remain deterministic deduplication tie-breakers. Key-component DQ is enforced by the canonical load/tests while flagged CONFORMED evidence remains traceable.
History/SCD: CDC documents are deduplicated/reconstructed using confirmed document identity and source-business/CDC/load tie-breakers. SCD entities use is_current and dt_valid_from/dt_valid_to when present.
Soft deletes and absence: Explicit source deleted flags and reconstructed CDC tombstones drive is_deleted. Absence from an incremental load never creates a soft delete.
Load, corrections, and reruns: Canonical CONFORMED load is rerunnable at the declared deterministic key. The Hackolade As Select Statement contains the canonical transformation extracted from model_package/sql/04_conformed_st_load_sql.sql. Warnings load with visible alerts; rows that cannot be safely interpreted remain flagged or are excluded only according to the canonical eligibility contract.
Data quality: cd_error/de_error and cd_alert/de_alert remain visible where modelled; key, cast, timestamp, domain, and relationship coverage are validated before CONSUMPTION publication.
Sensitive data: No new sensitive attribute is introduced by this model object; source-sensitive fields remain subject to access review.
Known limitation/assumption: No additional approved limitation.
Governance: shared structure, key, grain, SCD, or publication changes require I&D data-modeler and data-engineering review.
collections.selectStatement:
WITH source_event AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') AS nk_definition_id,
    type AS de_type_value,
    code AS de_code_value,
    actions AS json_action_value,
    role_or_action_groups AS json_reference_value,
    deleted AS de_deleted_value,
    created_date_time,
    last_modified_date_time,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS cdc_update_description,
    'historical' AS cd_source_event_type,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS cdc_cluster_time,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS cdc_wall_time,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS cdc_event_id,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS source_record_id,
    dt_load_utc,
    'historical_role_or_action_group' AS de_source_table,
    0 AS ni_source_precedence
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.historical_role_or_action_group

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract_scalar(cdc_document_key, '$._id')), '')
    ) AS nk_definition_id,
    type AS de_type_value,
    code AS de_code_value,
    actions AS json_action_value,
    role_or_action_groups AS json_reference_value,
    deleted AS de_deleted_value,
    created_date_time,
    last_modified_date_time,
    cdc_update_description,
    LOWER(COALESCE(cdc_operation_type, '')) AS cd_source_event_type,
    cdc_cluster_time,
    cdc_wall_time,
    cdc_event_id,
    source_record_id,
    dt_load_utc,
    'ods_role_or_action_group' AS de_source_table,
    1 AS ni_source_precedence
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.ods_role_or_action_group
),
typed_event AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    COALESCE(
      from_unixtime(
        TRY_CAST(
          COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(last_modified_date_time), ''),
            NULLIF(
              TRIM(
                json_extract_scalar(
                  cdc_update_description,
                  '$.updatedFields.lastModifiedDateTime'
                )
              ),
              ''
            )
          ) AS bigint
        ) / 1000.0
      ),
      from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(created_date_time AS bigint) / 1000.0),
      from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(cdc_cluster_time AS bigint) / 1000.0),
      COALESCE(
        TRY(CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(cdc_wall_time) AS timestamp)),
        TRY_CAST(cdc_wall_time AS timestamp)
      ),
      COALESCE(
        TRY(CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(dt_load_utc) AS timestamp)),
        TRY_CAST(dt_load_utc AS timestamp)
      )
    ) AS dt_event_business_utc,
    from_unixtime(TRY_CAST(cdc_cluster_time AS bigint) / 1000.0)
      AS dt_cdc_cluster_utc,
    COALESCE(
      TRY(CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(cdc_wall_time) AS timestamp)),
      TRY_CAST(cdc_wall_time AS timestamp)
    ) AS dt_cdc_wall_utc,
    COALESCE(
      TRY(CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(dt_load_utc) AS timestamp)),
      TRY_CAST(dt_load_utc AS timestamp)
    ) AS dt_parsed_source_load_utc,
    TRANSFORM(
      COALESCE(
        TRY(
          CAST(
            json_extract(cdc_update_description, '$.removedFields')
            AS array(varchar)
          )
        ),
        CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(varchar))
      ),
      removed_field -> LOWER(TRIM(removed_field))
    ) AS arr_removed_field_normalized,
    cd_source_event_type IN ('historical', 'insert', 'replace')
      AS is_full_document_event
  FROM source_event
  WHERE nk_definition_id IS NOT NULL
),
normalized_event AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(de_type_value), ''),
      NULLIF(
        TRIM(
          json_extract_scalar(
            cdc_update_description,
            '$.updatedFields.type'
          )
        ),
        ''
      )
    ) AS de_type_candidate,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(de_code_value), ''),
      NULLIF(
        TRIM(
          json_extract_scalar(
            cdc_update_description,
            '$.updatedFields.code'
          )
        ),
        ''
      )
    ) AS de_code_candidate,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(json_action_value), ''),
      NULLIF(
        json_format(
          json_extract(
            cdc_update_description,
            '$.updatedFields.actions'
          )
        ),
        'null'
      )
    ) AS json_action_candidate,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(json_reference_value), ''),
      NULLIF(
        json_format(
          json_extract(
            cdc_update_description,
            '$.updatedFields.roleOrActionGroups'
          )
        ),
        'null'
      )
    ) AS json_reference_candidate,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(de_deleted_value), ''),
      NULLIF(
        TRIM(
          json_extract_scalar(
            cdc_update_description,
            '$.updatedFields.deleted'
          )
        ),
        ''
      )
    ) AS de_deleted_candidate
  FROM typed_event
),
field_event AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    'type' AS de_field_name,
    de_type_candidate AS de_field_value,
    CONTAINS(arr_removed_field_normalized, 'type') AS is_field_removed
  FROM normalized_event
  WHERE is_full_document_event
     OR (
       cd_source_event_type = 'update'
       AND (
         NULLIF(TRIM(de_type_value), '') IS NOT NULL
         OR REGEXP_LIKE(
           COALESCE(cdc_update_description, ''),
           '"type"[[:space:]]*:'
         )
         OR CONTAINS(arr_removed_field_normalized, 'type')
       )
     )

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    *,
    'code' AS de_field_name,
    de_code_candidate AS de_field_value,
    CONTAINS(arr_removed_field_normalized, 'code') AS is_field_removed
  FROM normalized_event
  WHERE is_full_document_event
     OR (
       cd_source_event_type = 'update'
       AND (
         NULLIF(TRIM(de_code_value), '') IS NOT NULL
         OR REGEXP_LIKE(
           COALESCE(cdc_update_description, ''),
           '"code"[[:space:]]*:'
         )
         OR CONTAINS(arr_removed_field_normalized, 'code')
       )
     )

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    *,
    'actions' AS de_field_name,
    json_action_candidate AS de_field_value,
    CONTAINS(arr_removed_field_normalized, 'actions') AS is_field_removed
  FROM normalized_event
  WHERE is_full_document_event
     OR (
       cd_source_event_type = 'update'
       AND (
         NULLIF(TRIM(json_action_value), '') IS NOT NULL
         OR REGEXP_LIKE(
           COALESCE(cdc_update_description, ''),
           '"actions"[[:space:]]*:'
         )
         OR CONTAINS(arr_removed_field_normalized, 'actions')
       )
     )

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    *,
    'role_or_action_groups' AS de_field_name,
    json_reference_candidate AS de_field_value,
    CONTAINS(arr_removed_field_normalized, 'roleoractiongroups')
      OR CONTAINS(arr_removed_field_normalized, 'role_or_action_groups')
      AS is_field_removed
  FROM normalized_event
  WHERE is_full_document_event
     OR (
       cd_source_event_type = 'update'
       AND (
         NULLIF(TRIM(json_reference_value), '') IS NOT NULL
         OR REGEXP_LIKE(
           COALESCE(cdc_update_description, ''),
           '"roleOrActionGroups"[[:space:]]*:'
         )
         OR CONTAINS(arr_removed_field_normalized, 'roleoractiongroups')
         OR CONTAINS(
           arr_removed_field_normalized,
           'role_or_action_groups'
         )
       )
     )

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    *,
    'deleted' AS de_field_name,
    CASE
      WHEN cd_source_event_type IN ('delete', 'drop') THEN 'true'
      ELSE de_deleted_candidate
    END AS de_field_value,
    CONTAINS(arr_removed_field_normalized, 'deleted') AS is_field_removed
  FROM normalized_event
  WHERE is_full_document_event
     OR cd_source_event_type IN ('delete', 'drop')
     OR (
       cd_source_event_type = 'update'
       AND (
         NULLIF(TRIM(de_deleted_value), '') IS NOT NULL
         OR REGEXP_LIKE(
           COALESCE(cdc_update_description, ''),
           '"deleted"[[:space:]]*:'
         )
         OR CONTAINS(arr_removed_field_normalized, 'deleted')
       )
     )
),
field_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY nk_definition_id, de_field_name
      ORDER BY
        COALESCE(
          dt_event_business_utc,
          TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
        ) DESC,
        COALESCE(
          dt_cdc_cluster_utc,
          TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
        ) DESC,
        COALESCE(
          dt_cdc_wall_utc,
          TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
        ) DESC,
        COALESCE(
          dt_parsed_source_load_utc,
          TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
        ) DESC,
        ni_source_precedence DESC,
        COALESCE(cdc_event_id, '') DESC,
        COALESCE(source_record_id, '') DESC
    ) AS ni_field_rank
  FROM field_event
),
definition_state AS (
  SELECT
    nk_definition_id,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN de_field_name = 'type'
         AND ni_field_rank = 1
         AND NOT is_field_removed
          THEN de_field_value
      END
    ) AS de_type_value,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN de_field_name = 'code'
         AND ni_field_rank = 1
         AND NOT is_field_removed
          THEN de_field_value
      END
    ) AS de_code_value,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN de_field_name = 'actions'
         AND ni_field_rank = 1
         AND NOT is_field_removed
          THEN de_field_value
      END
    ) AS json_action_value,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN de_field_name = 'role_or_action_groups'
         AND ni_field_rank = 1
         AND NOT is_field_removed
          THEN de_field_value
      END
    ) AS json_reference_value,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN de_field_name = 'deleted'
         AND ni_field_rank = 1
         AND NOT is_field_removed
          THEN de_field_value
      END
    ) AS de_deleted_value,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN ni_field_rank = 1 THEN dt_event_business_utc
      END
    ) AS dt_definition_modified_utc,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN ni_field_rank = 1 THEN dt_parsed_source_load_utc
      END
    ) AS dt_definition_source_load_utc
  FROM field_ranked
  GROUP BY nk_definition_id
),
definition_normalized AS (
  SELECT
    nk_definition_id,
    CASE
      WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(
        UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(de_type_value), ''), '')),
        '[^A-Z]',
        ''
      ) = 'ROLE' THEN 'ROLE'
      WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(
        UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(de_type_value), ''), '')),
        '[^A-Z]',
        ''
      ) = 'ACTIONGROUP' THEN 'ACTION_GROUP'
      ELSE NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(de_type_value)), '')
    END AS cd_definition_type,
    NULLIF(TRIM(de_code_value), '') AS cd_definition_code,
    LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(de_code_value), ''))
      AS cd_definition_code_normalized,
    ARRAY_DISTINCT(
      TRANSFORM(
        FILTER(
          COALESCE(
            TRY(CAST(json_parse(json_action_value) AS array(varchar))),
            CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(varchar))
          ),
          action_code -> NULLIF(TRIM(action_code), '') IS NOT NULL
        ),
        action_code -> TRIM(action_code)
      )
    ) AS arr_action,
    ARRAY_DISTINCT(
      TRANSFORM(
        FILTER(
          COALESCE(
            TRY(CAST(json_parse(json_reference_value) AS array(varchar))),
            CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(varchar))
          ),
          reference_code -> NULLIF(TRIM(reference_code), '') IS NOT NULL
        ),
        reference_code -> TRIM(reference_code)
      )
    ) AS arr_reference_code,
    json_action_value IS NULL
      OR TRY(CAST(json_parse(json_action_value) AS array(varchar))) IS NOT NULL
      AS is_action_json_valid,
    json_reference_value IS NULL
      OR TRY(
        CAST(json_parse(json_reference_value) AS array(varchar))
      ) IS NOT NULL AS is_reference_json_valid,
    CASE LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(de_deleted_value), ''), 'false'))
      WHEN 'true' THEN true
      WHEN '1' THEN true
      WHEN 'yes' THEN true
      ELSE false
    END AS is_deleted,
    dt_definition_modified_utc,
    dt_definition_source_load_utc
  FROM definition_state
)
SELECT
  to_hex(
    sha256(
      to_utf8(nk_definition_id)
    )
  ) AS sk_role_or_action_group,
  nk_definition_id AS nk_role_or_action_group_id,
  cd_definition_type AS cd_role_or_action_group_type,
  cd_definition_code AS cd_role_or_action_group_code,
  arr_action,
  arr_reference_code AS arr_role_or_action_group_reference,
  is_deleted,
  dt_definition_modified_utc AS dt_last_modified_utc,
  dt_definition_source_load_utc AS dt_source_load_utc,
  true AS is_current,
  date_format(
    COALESCE(
      dt_definition_modified_utc,
      dt_definition_source_load_utc,
      CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp)
    ),
    '%Y%m%d'
  ) AS dt_partition,
  CASE
    WHEN cd_definition_type IS NULL
      OR cd_definition_type NOT IN ('ROLE', 'ACTION_GROUP')
      THEN 'invalid_role_or_action_group_type'
    WHEN cd_definition_code IS NULL
      THEN 'missing_role_or_action_group_code'
    WHEN NOT is_action_json_valid
      THEN 'invalid_action_json'
    WHEN NOT is_reference_json_valid
      THEN 'invalid_role_or_action_group_reference_json'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS cd_error,
  CASE
    WHEN cd_definition_type IS NULL
      OR cd_definition_type NOT IN ('ROLE', 'ACTION_GROUP')
      THEN 'Definition type must resolve to ROLE or ACTION_GROUP.'
    WHEN cd_definition_code IS NULL
      THEN 'Role/action-group definition has no stable code.'
    WHEN NOT is_action_json_valid
      THEN 'The actions source value is not a valid varchar array.'
    WHEN NOT is_reference_json_valid
      THEN 'The roleOrActionGroups source value is not a valid varchar array.'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS de_error,
  CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS cd_alert,
  CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS de_alert,
  'historical_role_or_action_group+ods_role_or_action_group'
    AS de_source_table,
  'current_state_rebuild' AS cd_source_event_type,
  CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS run_id,
  nk_definition_id AS source_id,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_update_utc
FROM definition_normalized

collections.description: CONFORMED st_boarding_status at one row per resolved ODS Boarding Status source document.
collections.comments:
Purpose: CONFORMED Boarding Status event at one resolved ODS source document per row. It is sourced exclusively from ods_boarding_status, preserves the raw status code, canonicalizes the source/epoch timestamps, and keeps unsupported sparse images or timestamp conflicts visible through DQ fields.
Grain: one row per resolved ODS Boarding Status source document.
Source and extraction: raw.ods_boarding_status only
Keys and cardinality: Technical primary key: sk_boarding_status. Logical alternate unique key: nk_boarding_status_document_id. The alternate key is declared separately from sk_ so duplicate source documents or business versions cannot be hidden by the surrogate key. dt_load_utc is audit lineage, not row identity; source CDC/order fields remain deterministic deduplication tie-breakers. Key-component DQ is enforced by the canonical load/tests while flagged CONFORMED evidence remains traceable.
History/SCD: CDC documents are deduplicated/reconstructed using confirmed document identity and source-business/CDC/load tie-breakers. SCD entities use is_current and dt_valid_from/dt_valid_to when present.
Soft deletes and absence: The current event-ST contract does not interpret Boarding Status delete/drop events as authoritative business deletion. Complete business images are retained and any unsupported delete/drop condition remains visible through DQ metadata; absence is never interpreted as deletion.
Load, corrections, and reruns: Canonical CONFORMED load is rerunnable at the declared deterministic key. The Hackolade As Select Statement contains the canonical transformation extracted from model_package/sql/04_conformed_st_load_sql.sql. Warnings load with visible alerts; rows that cannot be safely interpreted remain flagged or are excluded only according to the canonical eligibility contract.
Data quality: cd_error/de_error and cd_alert/de_alert remain visible where modelled; key, cast, timestamp, domain, and relationship coverage are validated before CONSUMPTION publication.
Sensitive data: No new sensitive attribute is introduced by this model object; source-sensitive fields remain subject to access review.
Known limitation/assumption: Boarding Status codes are independent events with no defined sequence or terminal state. Future source timestamps are accepted by the application and remain visible.
Governance: shared structure, key, grain, SCD, or publication changes require I&D data-modeler and data-engineering review.
collections.selectStatement:
WITH ods_parsed AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''),
      NULLIF(
        TRIM(
          TRY(
            json_extract_scalar(
              NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_document_key), ''),
              '$._id'
            )
          )
        ),
        ''
      )
    ) AS resolved_document_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(cdc_operation_type)), ''), '__missing__')
      AS cdc_operation_type,
    NULLIF(
      json_format(
        TRY(json_extract(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_raw_event), ''), '$.fullDocument'))
      ),
      'null'
    ) IS NOT NULL AS is_raw_full_document_present,
    COALESCE(
      map_keys(
        TRY_CAST(
          json_extract(
            NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_update_description), ''),
            '$.updatedFields'
          ) AS map(varchar, json)
        )
      ),
      CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(varchar))
    ) AS updated_field_name,
    COALESCE(
      TRY_CAST(
        json_extract(
          NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_update_description), ''),
          '$.removedFields'
        ) AS array(varchar)
      ),
      CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(varchar))
    ) AS removed_field_name,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(
        json_format(
          TRY(json_extract(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_raw_event), ''), '$.fullDocument'))
        ),
        'null'
      ) IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            TRY(
              json_extract_scalar(
                cdc_raw_event,
                '$.fullDocument.transactionId'
              )
            )
          ),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(transaction_id), '')
    END AS transaction_id,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(
        json_format(
          TRY(json_extract(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_raw_event), ''), '$.fullDocument'))
        ),
        'null'
      ) IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            TRY(
              json_extract_scalar(
                cdc_raw_event,
                '$.fullDocument.passengerId'
              )
            )
          ),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(passenger_id), '')
    END AS passenger_id,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(
        json_format(
          TRY(json_extract(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_raw_event), ''), '$.fullDocument'))
        ),
        'null'
      ) IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            TRY(
              json_extract_scalar(cdc_raw_event, '$.fullDocument.accountId')
            )
          ),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(account_id), '')
    END AS account_id,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(
        json_format(
          TRY(json_extract(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_raw_event), ''), '$.fullDocument'))
        ),
        'null'
      ) IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            TRY(json_extract_scalar(cdc_raw_event, '$.fullDocument.userId'))
          ),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(user_id), '')
    END AS user_id,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(
        json_format(
          TRY(json_extract(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_raw_event), ''), '$.fullDocument'))
        ),
        'null'
      ) IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            TRY(json_extract_scalar(cdc_raw_event, '$.fullDocument.agentId'))
          ),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(agent_id), '')
    END AS agent_id,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(
        json_format(
          TRY(json_extract(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_raw_event), ''), '$.fullDocument'))
        ),
        'null'
      ) IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            TRY(
              json_extract_scalar(cdc_raw_event, '$.fullDocument.accountName')
            )
          ),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(account_name), '')
    END AS account_name,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(
        json_format(
          TRY(json_extract(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_raw_event), ''), '$.fullDocument'))
        ),
        'null'
      ) IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            TRY(
              json_extract_scalar(
                cdc_raw_event,
                '$.fullDocument.processingEntity'
              )
            )
          ),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(processing_entity), '')
    END AS processing_entity,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(
        json_format(
          TRY(json_extract(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_raw_event), ''), '$.fullDocument'))
        ),
        'null'
      ) IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            TRY(
              json_extract_scalar(
                cdc_raw_event,
                '$.fullDocument.processingEntityId'
              )
            )
          ),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(processing_entity_id), '')
    END AS processing_entity_id,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(
        json_format(
          TRY(json_extract(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_raw_event), ''), '$.fullDocument'))
        ),
        'null'
      ) IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            TRY(
              json_extract_scalar(
                cdc_raw_event,
                '$.fullDocument.processingEntityName'
              )
            )
          ),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(processing_entity_name), '')
    END AS processing_entity_name,
    UPPER(
      CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(
          json_format(
            TRY(
              json_extract(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_raw_event), ''), '$.fullDocument')
            )
          ),
          'null'
        ) IS NOT NULL
          THEN NULLIF(
            TRIM(
              TRY(
                json_extract_scalar(cdc_raw_event, '$.fullDocument.status')
              )
            ),
            ''
          )
        ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(status), '')
      END
    ) AS boarding_status,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(
        json_format(
          TRY(json_extract(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_raw_event), ''), '$.fullDocument'))
        ),
        'null'
      ) IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            TRY(json_extract_scalar(cdc_raw_event, '$.fullDocument.reason'))
          ),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(reason), '')
    END AS boarding_status_reason,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(
        json_format(
          TRY(json_extract(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_raw_event), ''), '$.fullDocument'))
        ),
        'null'
      ) IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            TRY(
              json_extract_scalar(
                cdc_raw_event,
                '$.fullDocument.responseTimeInMillis'
              )
            )
          ),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(response_time_in_millis), '')
    END AS response_time_in_millis,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(
        json_format(
          TRY(json_extract(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_raw_event), ''), '$.fullDocument'))
        ),
        'null'
      ) IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            TRY(
              json_extract_scalar(cdc_raw_event, '$.fullDocument.timestamp')
            )
          ),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM("timestamp"), '')
    END AS boarding_status_timestamp,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(
        json_format(
          TRY(json_extract(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_raw_event), ''), '$.fullDocument'))
        ),
        'null'
      ) IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            TRY(
              json_extract_scalar(
                cdc_raw_event,
                '$.fullDocument.timestampInMillis'
              )
            )
          ),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(timestamp_in_millis), '')
    END AS boarding_status_timestamp_ms,
    NULLIF(TRIM(event_date), '') AS event_date,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(
        json_format(
          TRY(json_extract(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_raw_event), ''), '$.fullDocument'))
        ),
        'null'
      ) IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            TRY(json_extract_scalar(cdc_raw_event, '$.fullDocument._class'))
          ),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(document_class), '')
    END AS document_class,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(
        json_format(
          TRY(json_extract(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_raw_event), ''), '$.fullDocument'))
        ),
        'null'
      ) IS NOT NULL
        THEN COALESCE(
          NULLIF(
            TRIM(
              TRY(
                json_extract_scalar(
                  cdc_raw_event,
                  '$.fullDocument.errorDetails'
                )
              )
            ),
            ''
          ),
          NULLIF(
            json_format(
              TRY(
                json_extract(
                  cdc_raw_event,
                  '$.fullDocument.errorDetails'
                )
              )
            ),
            'null'
          )
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(error_details), '')
    END AS source_error_detail,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(
        json_format(
          TRY(json_extract(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_raw_event), ''), '$.fullDocument'))
        ),
        'null'
      ) IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            TRY(json_extract_scalar(cdc_raw_event, '$.fullDocument.userName'))
          ),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(user_name), '')
    END AS user_name,
    TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_cluster_time), '') AS bigint)
      AS cdc_cluster_time_ms,
    TRY(
      CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_wall_time), '')) AS timestamp)
    ) AS cdc_wall_utc,
    TRY(
      CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(NULLIF(TRIM(dt_load_utc), '')) AS timestamp)
    ) AS source_load_utc,
    NULLIF(TRIM(source_record_id), '') AS source_record_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_event_id), '') AS cdc_event_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(de_source_file_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(source_file_key), ''))
      AS source_file
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.ods_boarding_status
  WHERE COALESCE(
    NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''),
    NULLIF(
      TRIM(
        TRY(
          json_extract_scalar(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_document_key), ''), '$._id')
        )
      ),
      ''
    )
  ) IS NOT NULL
),
ods_classified AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    cdc_operation_type IN ('insert', 'replace')
      OR is_raw_full_document_present AS is_complete_image_event,
    cdc_operation_type = 'update'
      AND NOT is_raw_full_document_present
      AND CARDINALITY(
        FILTER(
          ARRAY_DISTINCT(CONCAT(updated_field_name, removed_field_name)),
          field_name -> ANY_MATCH(
            ARRAY[
              '_class',
              '_id',
              'accountId',
              'accountName',
              'agentId',
              'errorDetails',
              'passengerId',
              'processingEntity',
              'processingEntityId',
              'processingEntityName',
              'reason',
              'responseTimeInMillis',
              'status',
              'timestamp',
              'timestampInMillis',
              'transactionId',
              'userId',
              'userName'
            ],
            modeled_field_name ->
              field_name = modeled_field_name
              OR STARTS_WITH(
                field_name,
                CONCAT(modeled_field_name, '.')
              )
          )
        )
      ) > 0 AS is_sparse_modeled_update
  FROM ods_parsed
),
ods_ordered AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY resolved_document_id
      ORDER BY
        cdc_cluster_time_ms DESC NULLS LAST,
        cdc_wall_utc DESC NULLS LAST,
        source_load_utc DESC NULLS LAST,
        source_record_id DESC NULLS LAST,
        cdc_event_id DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS ni_document_event_rank
  FROM ods_classified
),
ods_profile AS (
  SELECT
    resolved_document_id,
    MIN(
      CASE WHEN is_complete_image_event THEN ni_document_event_rank END
    ) AS ni_latest_complete_image_rank,
    MIN(
      CASE WHEN is_sparse_modeled_update THEN ni_document_event_rank END
    ) AS ni_latest_sparse_modeled_update_rank,
    ARRAY_SORT(
      ARRAY_DISTINCT(FLATTEN(ARRAY_AGG(updated_field_name)))
    ) AS all_updated_field_name,
    ARRAY_SORT(
      ARRAY_DISTINCT(FLATTEN(ARRAY_AGG(removed_field_name)))
    ) AS all_removed_field_name
  FROM ods_ordered
  GROUP BY resolved_document_id
),
ods_latest AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM ods_ordered
  WHERE ni_document_event_rank = 1
),
ods_complete_image AS (
  SELECT o.*
  FROM ods_ordered o
  INNER JOIN ods_profile p
    ON o.resolved_document_id = p.resolved_document_id
   AND o.ni_document_event_rank = p.ni_latest_complete_image_rank
),
document_set AS (
  SELECT resolved_document_id FROM ods_latest
),
resolved_image AS (
  SELECT
    d.resolved_document_id,
    oi.transaction_id,
    oi.passenger_id,
    oi.account_id,
    oi.user_id,
    oi.agent_id,
    oi.account_name,
    oi.processing_entity,
    oi.processing_entity_id,
    oi.processing_entity_name,
    oi.boarding_status,
    oi.boarding_status_reason,
    oi.response_time_in_millis,
    oi.boarding_status_timestamp,
    oi.boarding_status_timestamp_ms,
    oi.event_date,
    oi.document_class,
    oi.source_error_detail,
    oi.user_name,
    CASE
      WHEN oi.resolved_document_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'ods_boarding_status'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS business_image_source_table,
    oi.source_file AS business_image_source_file,
    oi.source_load_utc AS business_image_load_utc,
    ol.cdc_operation_type,
    ol.cdc_cluster_time_ms,
    ol.cdc_wall_utc,
    ol.source_load_utc AS change_source_load_utc,
    ol.source_record_id,
    ol.cdc_event_id,
    'ods_boarding_status' AS change_source_table,
    ol.source_file AS change_source_file,
    COALESCE(p.all_updated_field_name, CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(varchar)))
      AS all_updated_field_name,
    COALESCE(p.all_removed_field_name, CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(varchar)))
      AS all_removed_field_name,
    oi.resolved_document_id IS NOT NULL
      AND oi.ni_document_event_rank > ol.ni_document_event_rank
      AS is_business_image_reconstructed,
    oi.resolved_document_id IS NULL AS is_complete_business_image_missing,
    p.ni_latest_sparse_modeled_update_rank IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        p.ni_latest_complete_image_rank IS NULL
        OR p.ni_latest_sparse_modeled_update_rank
          < p.ni_latest_complete_image_rank
      ) AS is_sparse_modeled_update_unresolved
  FROM document_set d
  LEFT JOIN ods_profile p
    ON d.resolved_document_id = p.resolved_document_id
  LEFT JOIN ods_latest ol
    ON d.resolved_document_id = ol.resolved_document_id
  LEFT JOIN ods_complete_image oi
    ON d.resolved_document_id = oi.resolved_document_id
),
typed AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    TRY_CAST(response_time_in_millis AS integer) AS response_time_ms,
    TRY(
      CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(boarding_status_timestamp) AS timestamp)
    ) AS boarding_status_source_utc,
    TRY_CAST(boarding_status_timestamp_ms AS bigint)
      AS boarding_status_epoch_ms,
    TRY(
      CAST(
        from_unixtime(
          TRY_CAST(boarding_status_timestamp_ms AS bigint) / 1000.0
        ) AS timestamp
      )
    ) AS boarding_status_epoch_utc,
    TRY(
      CAST(date_parse(event_date, '%Y%m%d') AS date)
    ) AS source_event_date,
    COALESCE(
      TRY(
        CAST(from_unixtime(cdc_cluster_time_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp)
      ),
      cdc_wall_utc,
      change_source_load_utc,
      business_image_load_utc
    ) AS source_event_utc
  FROM resolved_image
),
measured AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    date_diff(
      'second',
      boarding_status_epoch_utc,
      boarding_status_source_utc
    ) AS boarding_timestamp_delta_seconds
  FROM typed
),
canonicalized AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN boarding_status_source_utc IS NOT NULL
        AND boarding_status_epoch_utc IS NOT NULL
        THEN ABS(boarding_timestamp_delta_seconds) <= 1
      ELSE NULL
    END AS is_timestamp_consistent,
    CASE
      WHEN boarding_status_source_utc IS NOT NULL
        AND boarding_status_epoch_utc IS NOT NULL
        AND ABS(boarding_timestamp_delta_seconds) <= 1
        THEN boarding_status_source_utc
      WHEN boarding_status_source_utc IS NOT NULL
        AND boarding_status_epoch_utc IS NULL
        THEN boarding_status_source_utc
      WHEN boarding_status_source_utc IS NULL
        AND boarding_status_epoch_utc IS NOT NULL
        THEN boarding_status_epoch_utc
      ELSE NULL
    END AS boarding_status_utc
  FROM measured
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    NULLIF(
      ARRAY_JOIN(
        FILTER(
          ARRAY[
            CASE
              WHEN is_complete_business_image_missing
                THEN 'missing_complete_business_image'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN is_sparse_modeled_update_unresolved
                THEN 'unsupported_sparse_modeled_update'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN cdc_operation_type IS NOT NULL
                AND cdc_operation_type NOT IN (
                  'insert',
                  'replace',
                  'update',
                  'delete',
                  'drop',
                  'dropdatabase',
                  'rename'
                )
                THEN 'unsupported_cdc_operation_type'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN boarding_status IS NULL
                THEN 'missing_boarding_status'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN boarding_status_source_utc IS NULL
                AND boarding_status_epoch_utc IS NULL
                THEN 'missing_or_invalid_boarding_timestamp'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN boarding_status_source_utc IS NOT NULL
                AND boarding_status_epoch_utc IS NOT NULL
                AND ABS(boarding_timestamp_delta_seconds) > 1
                THEN 'boarding_timestamp_conflict'
            END
          ],
          error_code -> error_code IS NOT NULL
        ),
        '|'
      ),
      ''
    ) AS error_code,
    NULLIF(
      ARRAY_JOIN(
        FILTER(
          ARRAY[
            CASE
              WHEN is_complete_business_image_missing
                THEN 'No complete ODS insert, replace, or raw fullDocument business image is available.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN is_sparse_modeled_update_unresolved
                THEN 'A sparse CDC update changed a modelled field after the latest complete image.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN cdc_operation_type IS NOT NULL
                AND cdc_operation_type NOT IN (
                  'insert',
                  'replace',
                  'update',
                  'delete',
                  'drop',
                  'dropdatabase',
                  'rename'
                )
                THEN 'The latest CDC operation type is not supported by the boarding-status contract.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN boarding_status IS NULL
                THEN 'The reconstructed source document has no boarding-status code.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN boarding_status_source_utc IS NULL
                AND boarding_status_epoch_utc IS NULL
                THEN 'Neither source business timestamp representation can be interpreted.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN boarding_status_source_utc IS NOT NULL
                AND boarding_status_epoch_utc IS NOT NULL
                AND ABS(boarding_timestamp_delta_seconds) > 1
                THEN 'The ISO and epoch business timestamps disagree by more than one second.'
            END
          ],
          error_text -> error_text IS NOT NULL
        ),
        ' | '
      ),
      ''
    ) AS error_text,
    NULLIF(
      ARRAY_JOIN(
        FILTER(
          ARRAY[
            CASE
              WHEN transaction_id IS NULL
                THEN 'missing_boarding_status_transaction_id'
            END,
            CASE WHEN passenger_id IS NULL THEN 'missing_passenger_id' END,
            CASE WHEN account_id IS NULL THEN 'missing_account_id' END,
            CASE WHEN user_id IS NULL THEN 'missing_user_id' END,
            CASE
              WHEN processing_entity_id IS NULL
                THEN 'missing_processing_entity_id'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN boarding_status_reason IS NULL
                THEN 'missing_boarding_status_reason'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN response_time_in_millis IS NULL
                THEN 'missing_response_time'
              WHEN response_time_ms IS NULL
                THEN 'invalid_response_time'
              WHEN response_time_ms < 0
                THEN 'negative_response_time'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN event_date IS NOT NULL AND source_event_date IS NULL
                THEN 'invalid_source_event_date'
              WHEN source_event_date IS NOT NULL
                AND boarding_status_utc IS NOT NULL
                AND source_event_date <> CAST(boarding_status_utc AS date)
                THEN 'source_event_date_mismatch'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN (
                boarding_status_source_utc IS NULL
                AND boarding_status_epoch_utc IS NOT NULL
              ) OR (
                boarding_status_source_utc IS NOT NULL
                AND boarding_status_epoch_utc IS NULL
              )
                THEN 'single_timestamp_representation'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN source_error_detail IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'source_error_detail_present'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN is_business_image_reconstructed
                THEN 'ods_image_with_later_change_lineage'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN cdc_operation_type IN (
                'delete',
                'drop',
                'dropdatabase',
                'rename'
              )
                THEN 'unapproved_destructive_cdc_operation'
            END
          ],
          alert_code -> alert_code IS NOT NULL
        ),
        '|'
      ),
      ''
    ) AS alert_code,
    NULLIF(
      ARRAY_JOIN(
        FILTER(
          ARRAY[
            CASE
              WHEN transaction_id IS NULL
                THEN 'The independent Boarding Status source transactionId is missing.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN passenger_id IS NULL
                THEN 'Passenger identifier is missing.'
            END,
            CASE WHEN account_id IS NULL THEN 'Account identifier is missing.' END,
            CASE WHEN user_id IS NULL THEN 'User identifier is missing.' END,
            CASE
              WHEN processing_entity_id IS NULL
                THEN 'Processing-entity identifier is missing.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN boarding_status_reason IS NULL
                THEN 'Boarding-status reason is missing.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN response_time_in_millis IS NULL
                THEN 'Response time is missing.'
              WHEN response_time_ms IS NULL
                THEN 'Response time is not a valid integer.'
              WHEN response_time_ms < 0
                THEN 'Response time is negative.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN event_date IS NOT NULL AND source_event_date IS NULL
                THEN 'Source event_date is not valid yyyyMMdd.'
              WHEN source_event_date IS NOT NULL
                AND boarding_status_utc IS NOT NULL
                AND source_event_date <> CAST(boarding_status_utc AS date)
                THEN 'Source event_date differs from the canonical business date.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN (
                boarding_status_source_utc IS NULL
                AND boarding_status_epoch_utc IS NOT NULL
              ) OR (
                boarding_status_source_utc IS NOT NULL
                AND boarding_status_epoch_utc IS NULL
              )
                THEN 'Only one business timestamp representation is usable.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN source_error_detail IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'The source supplied error_details; restricted ST review is required.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN is_business_image_reconstructed
                THEN 'An earlier complete ODS business image was retained because later ODS events did not change modelled fields.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN cdc_operation_type IN (
                'delete',
                'drop',
                'dropdatabase',
                'rename'
              )
                THEN 'Destructive CDC semantics are not approved for boarding status.'
            END
          ],
          alert_text -> alert_text IS NOT NULL
        ),
        ' | '
      ),
      ''
    ) AS alert_text
  FROM canonicalized
)
SELECT
  to_hex(sha256(to_utf8(resolved_document_id))) AS sk_boarding_status,
  resolved_document_id AS nk_boarding_status_document_id,
  transaction_id AS cd_boarding_status_transaction_id,
  passenger_id AS nk_passenger_id,
  account_id AS nk_account_id,
  user_id AS nk_user_id,
  agent_id AS cd_agent_id,
  account_name AS de_account_name,
  processing_entity AS cd_processing_entity,
  processing_entity_id AS cd_processing_entity_id,
  processing_entity_name AS de_processing_entity_name,
  boarding_status AS cd_boarding_status,
  boarding_status_reason AS de_boarding_status_reason,
  response_time_ms AS ni_response_time_ms,
  boarding_status_source_utc AS dt_boarding_status_source_utc,
  boarding_status_epoch_ms AS ni_boarding_status_epoch_ms,
  boarding_status_epoch_utc AS dt_boarding_status_epoch_utc,
  source_event_date AS dt_source_event_date,
  boarding_timestamp_delta_seconds AS ni_boarding_timestamp_delta_seconds,
  is_timestamp_consistent AS is_boarding_timestamp_consistent,
  boarding_status_utc AS dt_boarding_status_utc,
  CAST(boarding_status_utc AS date) AS dt_boarding_status_date,
  document_class AS de_document_class,
  source_error_detail AS de_source_error_detail,
  user_name AS de_user_name,
  cdc_cluster_time_ms AS ni_cdc_cluster_time_ms,
  cdc_wall_utc AS dt_cdc_wall_utc,
  source_event_utc AS dt_source_event_utc,
  business_image_load_utc AS dt_business_image_load_utc,
  COALESCE(change_source_load_utc, business_image_load_utc)
    AS dt_source_load_utc,
  COALESCE(
    date_format(boarding_status_utc, '%Y%m%d'),
    REPLACE(CAST(source_event_date AS varchar), '-', ''),
    date_format(source_event_utc, '%Y%m%d')
  ) AS dt_partition,
  COALESCE(business_image_source_table, change_source_table)
    AS de_source_table,
  COALESCE(business_image_source_file, change_source_file)
    AS de_source_file,
  change_source_table AS de_change_source_table,
  change_source_file AS de_change_source_file,
  COALESCE(cdc_operation_type, '__missing__') AS cd_source_event_type,
  source_record_id AS cd_source_record_id,
  cdc_event_id AS cd_source_event_id,
  all_updated_field_name AS arr_updated_field_name,
  all_removed_field_name AS arr_removed_field_name,
  is_business_image_reconstructed,
  false AS is_deleted,
  error_code AS cd_error,
  error_text AS de_error,
  alert_code AS cd_alert,
  alert_text AS de_alert,
  CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS run_id,
  CONCAT(
    'ods_boarding_status',
    ':',
    resolved_document_id
  ) AS source_id,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_update_utc
FROM classified

collections.description: CONFORMED st_boarding_status_code at one row per reconstructed BOARDINGSTATUS Parameter Value document.
collections.comments:
Purpose: CONFORMED reconstructed Parameter Value document at one BOARDINGSTATUS definition document per row. Historical and ODS images are sequenced by document, including authoritative deletes. Multiple active documents for the same code remain visible; CONSUMPTION publication fails closed unless exactly one active definition remains.
Grain: one row per reconstructed BOARDINGSTATUS Parameter Value document.
Source and extraction: raw.historical_parameter_value; raw.ods_parameter_value
Keys and cardinality: Technical primary key: sk_boarding_status_code. Logical alternate unique key: nk_parameter_value_document_id. The alternate key is declared separately from sk_ so duplicate source documents or business versions cannot be hidden by the surrogate key. dt_load_utc is audit lineage, not row identity; source CDC/order fields remain deterministic deduplication tie-breakers. Key-component DQ is enforced by the canonical load/tests while flagged CONFORMED evidence remains traceable.
History/SCD: CDC documents are deduplicated/reconstructed using confirmed document identity and source-business/CDC/load tie-breakers. SCD entities use is_current and dt_valid_from/dt_valid_to when present.
Soft deletes and absence: Explicit source deleted flags and reconstructed CDC tombstones drive is_deleted. Absence from an incremental load never creates a soft delete.
Load, corrections, and reruns: Canonical CONFORMED load is rerunnable at the declared deterministic key. The Hackolade As Select Statement contains the canonical transformation extracted from model_package/sql/04_conformed_st_load_sql.sql. Warnings load with visible alerts; rows that cannot be safely interpreted remain flagged or are excluded only according to the canonical eligibility contract.
Data quality: cd_error/de_error and cd_alert/de_alert remain visible where modelled; key, cast, timestamp, domain, and relationship coverage are validated before CONSUMPTION publication.
Sensitive data: No new sensitive attribute is introduced by this model object; source-sensitive fields remain subject to access review.
Known limitation/assumption: Weekly synchronization publishes delete events. Active definitions must therefore be derived after per-document CDC reconstruction rather than by querying retained insert images directly.
Governance: shared structure, key, grain, SCD, or publication changes require I&D data-modeler and data-engineering review.
