WITH historical_event AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') AS resolved_document_id,
    0 AS ni_source_rank,
    COALESCE(
      TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(last_modified_date_time), '') AS bigint),
      TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(created_date_time), '') AS bigint),
      TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(start_date_time), '') AS bigint),
      0
    ) AS ni_event_order_ms,
    true AS is_complete_image,
    true AS is_code_touched,
    NULLIF(TRIM(code), '') AS code_value,
    true AS is_syscode_touched,
    NULLIF(TRIM(syscode), '') AS syscode_value,
    true AS is_param_identifier_touched,
    NULLIF(TRIM(param_identifier), '') AS param_identifier_value,
    true AS is_name_touched,
    NULLIF(TRIM(name), '') AS name_value,
    true AS is_description_touched,
    NULLIF(TRIM(description), '') AS description_value,
    true AS is_version_touched,
    NULLIF(TRIM(version), '') AS version_value,
    true AS is_deleted_touched,
    NULLIF(TRIM(deleted), '') AS deleted_value,
    true AS is_created_touched,
    NULLIF(TRIM(created_date_time), '') AS created_value,
    true AS is_modified_touched,
    NULLIF(TRIM(last_modified_date_time), '') AS modified_value,
    true AS is_start_touched,
    NULLIF(TRIM(start_date_time), '') AS start_value,
    true AS is_end_touched,
    NULLIF(TRIM(end_date_time), '') AS end_value,
    'historical_parameter_value' AS de_source_table,
    NULLIF(TRIM(de_source_file_name), '') AS de_source_file,
    'historical_baseline' AS cd_source_event_type,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS cd_source_record_id,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS cd_source_event_id,
    TRY(
      CAST(
        FROM_UNIXTIME(
          TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(last_modified_date_time), '') AS bigint)
            / 1000.0
        ) AS timestamp
      )
    ) AS dt_source_event_utc,
    TRY(
      CAST(
        FROM_ISO8601_TIMESTAMP(NULLIF(TRIM(dt_load_utc), ''))
          AS timestamp
      )
    ) AS dt_source_load_utc,
    'HISTORICAL_PARAMETER_VALUE' AS source_id
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.historical_parameter_value
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), '') IS NOT NULL
),
ods_base AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''),
      NULLIF(
        TRIM(
          TRY(
            json_extract_scalar(
              NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_document_key), ''),
              '$._id'
            )
          )
        ),
        ''
      )
    ) AS resolved_document_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(cdc_operation_type)), ''), '__missing__')
      AS cdc_operation_type,
    TRY(json_extract(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_raw_event), ''), '$.fullDocument'))
      AS json_full_document,
    COALESCE(
      TRY_CAST(
        json_extract(
          NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_update_description), ''),
          '$.updatedFields'
        ) AS map(varchar, json)
      ),
      MAP(
        CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(varchar)),
        CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(json))
      )
    ) AS updated_field,
    COALESCE(
      TRY_CAST(
        json_extract(
          NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_update_description), ''),
          '$.removedFields'
        ) AS array(varchar)
      ),
      CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(varchar))
    ) AS removed_field,
    cdc_cluster_time,
    cdc_wall_time,
    cdc_event_id,
    source_record_id,
    de_source_file_name,
    source_file_key,
    dt_load_utc,
    source_stream,
    code,
    syscode,
    param_identifier,
    name,
    description,
    version,
    deleted,
    created_date_time,
    last_modified_date_time,
    start_date_time,
    end_date_time
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.ods_parameter_value
  WHERE COALESCE(
    NULLIF(TRIM(document_id), ''),
    NULLIF(
      TRIM(
        TRY(
          json_extract_scalar(
            NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_document_key), ''),
            '$._id'
          )
        )
      ),
      ''
    )
  ) IS NOT NULL
),
ods_flagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    json_full_document IS NOT NULL
      OR cdc_operation_type IN ('insert', 'replace')
      AS is_complete_image,
    MAP_KEYS(updated_field) AS updated_field_name
  FROM ods_base
),
ods_event AS (
  SELECT
    resolved_document_id,
    1 AS ni_source_rank,
    COALESCE(
      TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_cluster_time), '') AS bigint),
      TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(last_modified_date_time), '') AS bigint),
      TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(created_date_time), '') AS bigint),
      0
    ) AS ni_event_order_ms,
    is_complete_image,
    is_complete_image
      OR CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'code')
      OR CONTAINS(removed_field, 'code') AS is_code_touched,
    CASE
      WHEN CONTAINS(removed_field, 'code') THEN CAST(NULL AS varchar)
      WHEN json_full_document IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(TRY(json_extract_scalar(json_full_document, '$.code'))),
          ''
        )
      WHEN CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'code')
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(json_extract_scalar(updated_field['code'], '$')),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(code), '')
    END AS code_value,
    is_complete_image
      OR CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'syscode')
      OR CONTAINS(removed_field, 'syscode') AS is_syscode_touched,
    CASE
      WHEN CONTAINS(removed_field, 'syscode') THEN CAST(NULL AS varchar)
      WHEN json_full_document IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(TRY(json_extract_scalar(json_full_document, '$.syscode'))),
          ''
        )
      WHEN CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'syscode')
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(json_extract_scalar(updated_field['syscode'], '$')),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(syscode), '')
    END AS syscode_value,
    is_complete_image
      OR CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'paramIdentifier')
      OR CONTAINS(removed_field, 'paramIdentifier')
      AS is_param_identifier_touched,
    CASE
      WHEN CONTAINS(removed_field, 'paramIdentifier')
        THEN CAST(NULL AS varchar)
      WHEN json_full_document IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            TRY(
              json_extract_scalar(
                json_full_document,
                '$.paramIdentifier'
              )
            )
          ),
          ''
        )
      WHEN CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'paramIdentifier')
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(json_extract_scalar(updated_field['paramIdentifier'], '$')),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(param_identifier), '')
    END AS param_identifier_value,
    is_complete_image
      OR CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'name')
      OR CONTAINS(removed_field, 'name') AS is_name_touched,
    CASE
      WHEN CONTAINS(removed_field, 'name') THEN CAST(NULL AS varchar)
      WHEN json_full_document IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(TRY(json_extract_scalar(json_full_document, '$.name'))),
          ''
        )
      WHEN CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'name')
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(json_extract_scalar(updated_field['name'], '$')),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(name), '')
    END AS name_value,
    is_complete_image
      OR CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'description')
      OR CONTAINS(removed_field, 'description')
      AS is_description_touched,
    CASE
      WHEN CONTAINS(removed_field, 'description')
        THEN CAST(NULL AS varchar)
      WHEN json_full_document IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            TRY(json_extract_scalar(json_full_document, '$.description'))
          ),
          ''
        )
      WHEN CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'description')
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(json_extract_scalar(updated_field['description'], '$')),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(description), '')
    END AS description_value,
    is_complete_image
      OR CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'version')
      OR CONTAINS(removed_field, 'version') AS is_version_touched,
    CASE
      WHEN CONTAINS(removed_field, 'version') THEN CAST(NULL AS varchar)
      WHEN json_full_document IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(TRY(json_extract_scalar(json_full_document, '$.version'))),
          ''
        )
      WHEN CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'version')
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(json_extract_scalar(updated_field['version'], '$')),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(version), '')
    END AS version_value,
    is_complete_image
      OR CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'deleted')
      OR CONTAINS(removed_field, 'deleted') AS is_deleted_touched,
    CASE
      WHEN CONTAINS(removed_field, 'deleted') THEN CAST(NULL AS varchar)
      WHEN json_full_document IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(TRY(json_extract_scalar(json_full_document, '$.deleted'))),
          ''
        )
      WHEN CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'deleted')
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(json_extract_scalar(updated_field['deleted'], '$')),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(deleted), '')
    END AS deleted_value,
    is_complete_image
      OR CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'createdDateTime')
      OR CONTAINS(removed_field, 'createdDateTime')
      AS is_created_touched,
    CASE
      WHEN CONTAINS(removed_field, 'createdDateTime')
        THEN CAST(NULL AS varchar)
      WHEN json_full_document IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            TRY(
              json_extract_scalar(
                json_full_document,
                '$.createdDateTime'
              )
            )
          ),
          ''
        )
      WHEN CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'createdDateTime')
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(json_extract_scalar(updated_field['createdDateTime'], '$')),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(created_date_time), '')
    END AS created_value,
    is_complete_image
      OR CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'lastModifiedDateTime')
      OR CONTAINS(removed_field, 'lastModifiedDateTime')
      AS is_modified_touched,
    CASE
      WHEN CONTAINS(removed_field, 'lastModifiedDateTime')
        THEN CAST(NULL AS varchar)
      WHEN json_full_document IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            TRY(
              json_extract_scalar(
                json_full_document,
                '$.lastModifiedDateTime'
              )
            )
          ),
          ''
        )
      WHEN CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'lastModifiedDateTime')
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            json_extract_scalar(
              updated_field['lastModifiedDateTime'],
              '$'
            )
          ),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(last_modified_date_time), '')
    END AS modified_value,
    is_complete_image
      OR CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'startDateTime')
      OR CONTAINS(removed_field, 'startDateTime')
      AS is_start_touched,
    CASE
      WHEN CONTAINS(removed_field, 'startDateTime')
        THEN CAST(NULL AS varchar)
      WHEN json_full_document IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            TRY(
              json_extract_scalar(json_full_document, '$.startDateTime')
            )
          ),
          ''
        )
      WHEN CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'startDateTime')
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(json_extract_scalar(updated_field['startDateTime'], '$')),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(start_date_time), '')
    END AS start_value,
    is_complete_image
      OR CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'endDateTime')
      OR CONTAINS(removed_field, 'endDateTime') AS is_end_touched,
    CASE
      WHEN CONTAINS(removed_field, 'endDateTime')
        THEN CAST(NULL AS varchar)
      WHEN json_full_document IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(
            TRY(json_extract_scalar(json_full_document, '$.endDateTime'))
          ),
          ''
        )
      WHEN CONTAINS(updated_field_name, 'endDateTime')
        THEN NULLIF(
          TRIM(json_extract_scalar(updated_field['endDateTime'], '$')),
          ''
        )
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(end_date_time), '')
    END AS end_value,
    'ods_parameter_value' AS de_source_table,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(de_source_file_name), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(source_file_key), '')
    ) AS de_source_file,
    cdc_operation_type AS cd_source_event_type,
    NULLIF(TRIM(source_record_id), '') AS cd_source_record_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_event_id), '') AS cd_source_event_id,
    COALESCE(
      TRY(
        CAST(
          FROM_UNIXTIME(
            TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_cluster_time), '') AS bigint)
              / 1000.0
          ) AS timestamp
        )
      ),
      TRY(
        CAST(
          FROM_ISO8601_TIMESTAMP(NULLIF(TRIM(cdc_wall_time), ''))
            AS timestamp
        )
      )
    ) AS dt_source_event_utc,
    TRY(
      CAST(
        FROM_ISO8601_TIMESTAMP(NULLIF(TRIM(dt_load_utc), ''))
          AS timestamp
      )
    ) AS dt_source_load_utc,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(source_stream), ''), 'MASTER_DATA') AS source_id
  FROM ods_flagged
),
all_event AS (
  SELECT * FROM historical_event
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM ods_event
),
ordered_event AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY resolved_document_id
      ORDER BY
        ni_source_rank,
        ni_event_order_ms,
        COALESCE(dt_source_load_utc, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 00:00:00'),
        COALESCE(cd_source_record_id, ''),
        COALESCE(cd_source_event_id, '')
    ) AS ni_event_sequence
  FROM all_event
),
document_state AS (
  SELECT
    resolved_document_id,
    MAX_BY(
      code_value,
      IF(is_code_touched, ni_event_sequence, CAST(NULL AS bigint))
    ) AS code_value,
    MAX_BY(
      syscode_value,
      IF(is_syscode_touched, ni_event_sequence, CAST(NULL AS bigint))
    ) AS syscode_value,
    MAX_BY(
      param_identifier_value,
      IF(
        is_param_identifier_touched,
        ni_event_sequence,
        CAST(NULL AS bigint)
      )
    ) AS param_identifier_value,
    MAX_BY(
      name_value,
      IF(is_name_touched, ni_event_sequence, CAST(NULL AS bigint))
    ) AS name_value,
    MAX_BY(
      description_value,
      IF(
        is_description_touched,
        ni_event_sequence,
        CAST(NULL AS bigint)
      )
    ) AS description_value,
    MAX_BY(
      version_value,
      IF(is_version_touched, ni_event_sequence, CAST(NULL AS bigint))
    ) AS version_value,
    MAX_BY(
      deleted_value,
      IF(is_deleted_touched, ni_event_sequence, CAST(NULL AS bigint))
    ) AS deleted_value,
    MAX_BY(
      created_value,
      IF(is_created_touched, ni_event_sequence, CAST(NULL AS bigint))
    ) AS created_value,
    MAX_BY(
      modified_value,
      IF(is_modified_touched, ni_event_sequence, CAST(NULL AS bigint))
    ) AS modified_value,
    MAX_BY(
      start_value,
      IF(is_start_touched, ni_event_sequence, CAST(NULL AS bigint))
    ) AS start_value,
    MAX_BY(
      end_value,
      IF(is_end_touched, ni_event_sequence, CAST(NULL AS bigint))
    ) AS end_value,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS integer) AS ni_source_event_count,
    CAST(COUNT_IF(is_complete_image) AS integer)
      AS ni_complete_image_count,
    COALESCE(
      MAX_BY(
        de_source_table,
        IF(is_complete_image, ni_event_sequence, CAST(NULL AS bigint))
      ),
      MAX_BY(de_source_table, ni_event_sequence)
    ) AS de_source_table,
    COALESCE(
      MAX_BY(
        de_source_file,
        IF(is_complete_image, ni_event_sequence, CAST(NULL AS bigint))
      ),
      MAX_BY(de_source_file, ni_event_sequence)
    ) AS de_source_file,
    MAX_BY(de_source_table, ni_event_sequence)
      AS de_change_source_table,
    MAX_BY(de_source_file, ni_event_sequence)
      AS de_change_source_file,
    MAX_BY(cd_source_event_type, ni_event_sequence)
      AS cd_source_event_type,
    MAX_BY(cd_source_record_id, ni_event_sequence)
      AS cd_source_record_id,
    MAX_BY(cd_source_event_id, ni_event_sequence)
      AS cd_source_event_id,
    MAX_BY(
      dt_source_load_utc,
      IF(is_complete_image, ni_event_sequence, CAST(NULL AS bigint))
    ) AS dt_business_image_load_utc,
    MAX_BY(dt_source_event_utc, ni_event_sequence)
      AS dt_source_event_utc,
    MAX_BY(dt_source_load_utc, ni_event_sequence)
      AS dt_source_load_utc,
    MAX(ni_event_sequence) >
      COALESCE(
        MAX(IF(is_complete_image, ni_event_sequence, NULL)),
        MAX(ni_event_sequence)
      ) AS is_business_image_reconstructed,
    MAX_BY(source_id, ni_event_sequence) AS source_id,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN is_complete_image
          AND UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(param_identifier_value), ''))
            = 'BOARDINGSTATUS'
          THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS has_boarding_status_image
  FROM ordered_event
  GROUP BY resolved_document_id
),
typed AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    TRY_CAST(version_value AS integer) AS typed_version,
    CASE LOWER(deleted_value)
      WHEN 'true' THEN true
      WHEN 'false' THEN false
      ELSE CAST(NULL AS boolean)
    END AS typed_deleted,
    TRY(
      CAST(
        FROM_UNIXTIME(TRY_CAST(created_value AS bigint) / 1000.0)
          AS timestamp
      )
    ) AS typed_created_utc,
    TRY(
      CAST(
        FROM_UNIXTIME(TRY_CAST(modified_value AS bigint) / 1000.0)
          AS timestamp
      )
    ) AS typed_modified_utc,
    TRY(
      CAST(
        FROM_UNIXTIME(TRY_CAST(start_value AS bigint) / 1000.0)
          AS timestamp
      )
    ) AS typed_valid_from_utc,
    TRY(
      CAST(
        FROM_UNIXTIME(TRY_CAST(end_value AS bigint) / 1000.0)
          AS timestamp
      )
    ) AS typed_valid_to_utc
  FROM document_state
  WHERE has_boarding_status_image = 1
     OR UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(param_identifier_value), ''))
       = 'BOARDINGSTATUS'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    cd_source_event_type IN ('delete', 'drop')
      OR COALESCE(typed_deleted, false) AS final_is_deleted,
    UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(param_identifier_value), ''))
        = 'BOARDINGSTATUS'
      AND NOT (
        cd_source_event_type IN ('delete', 'drop')
        OR COALESCE(typed_deleted, false)
      )
      AND typed_valid_from_utc IS NOT NULL
      AND typed_valid_to_utc IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) > typed_valid_from_utc
      AND CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) < typed_valid_to_utc
      AS final_is_effective_current
  FROM typed
),
finalized AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(param_identifier_value), ''))
      AS cd_parameter_identifier,
    UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(code_value), '')) AS cd_boarding_status,
    UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(syscode_value), ''))
      AS cd_boarding_status_syscode,
    NULLIF(TRIM(name_value), '') AS de_boarding_status_name,
    NULLIF(TRIM(description_value), '')
      AS de_boarding_status_description
  FROM classified
)
SELECT
  TO_HEX(SHA256(TO_UTF8(resolved_document_id)))
    AS sk_boarding_status_code,
  resolved_document_id AS nk_parameter_value_document_id,
  cd_parameter_identifier,
  cd_boarding_status,
  cd_boarding_status_syscode,
  de_boarding_status_name,
  de_boarding_status_description,
  typed_version AS ni_parameter_value_version,
  final_is_deleted AS is_deleted,
  final_is_effective_current AS is_effective_current,
  typed_created_utc AS dt_created_utc,
  typed_modified_utc AS dt_last_modified_utc,
  typed_valid_from_utc AS dt_valid_from_utc,
  typed_valid_to_utc AS dt_valid_to_utc,
  ni_source_event_count,
  ni_complete_image_count,
  de_source_table,
  de_source_file,
  de_change_source_table,
  de_change_source_file,
  cd_source_event_type,
  cd_source_record_id,
  cd_source_event_id,
  dt_business_image_load_utc,
  dt_source_event_utc,
  dt_source_load_utc,
  is_business_image_reconstructed,
  NULLIF(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(
        ARRAY[
          IF(
            ni_complete_image_count = 0,
            'missing_complete_business_image',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            cd_parameter_identifier IS NULL,
            'missing_parameter_identifier',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            cd_parameter_identifier = 'BOARDINGSTATUS'
              AND cd_boarding_status IS NULL,
            'missing_boarding_status_code',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            deleted_value IS NOT NULL AND typed_deleted IS NULL,
            'invalid_deleted_boolean',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            start_value IS NOT NULL AND typed_valid_from_utc IS NULL,
            'invalid_valid_from_timestamp',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            end_value IS NOT NULL AND typed_valid_to_utc IS NULL,
            'invalid_valid_to_timestamp',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            typed_valid_from_utc IS NOT NULL
              AND typed_valid_to_utc IS NOT NULL
              AND typed_valid_to_utc <= typed_valid_from_utc,
            'invalid_effective_interval',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            cd_source_event_type = '__missing__',
            'missing_cdc_operation_type',
            NULL
          )
        ],
        error_code -> error_code IS NOT NULL
      ),
      '|'
    ),
    ''
  ) AS cd_error,
  NULLIF(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(
        ARRAY[
          IF(
            ni_complete_image_count = 0,
            'No historical or ODS complete image exists for this parameterValue document.',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            cd_parameter_identifier IS NULL,
            'The reconstructed parameter identifier is missing.',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            cd_parameter_identifier = 'BOARDINGSTATUS'
              AND cd_boarding_status IS NULL,
            'The active Boarding Status reference document has no code.',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            deleted_value IS NOT NULL AND typed_deleted IS NULL,
            'The deleted value cannot be cast to boolean.',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            start_value IS NOT NULL AND typed_valid_from_utc IS NULL,
            'The startDateTime value cannot be cast from epoch milliseconds.',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            end_value IS NOT NULL AND typed_valid_to_utc IS NULL,
            'The endDateTime value cannot be cast from epoch milliseconds.',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            typed_valid_from_utc IS NOT NULL
              AND typed_valid_to_utc IS NOT NULL
              AND typed_valid_to_utc <= typed_valid_from_utc,
            'The effective-to timestamp is not later than effective-from.',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            cd_source_event_type = '__missing__',
            'The latest ODS CDC operation type is missing.',
            NULL
          )
        ],
        error_text -> error_text IS NOT NULL
      ),
      ' | '
    ),
    ''
  ) AS de_error,
  NULLIF(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(
        ARRAY[
          IF(
            cd_parameter_identifier <> 'BOARDINGSTATUS',
            'parameter_identifier_changed',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            cd_parameter_identifier = 'BOARDINGSTATUS'
              AND de_boarding_status_name IS NULL,
            'boarding_status_name_missing',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            cd_parameter_identifier = 'BOARDINGSTATUS'
              AND de_boarding_status_description IS NULL,
            'boarding_status_description_missing',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            cd_boarding_status IS NOT NULL
              AND cd_boarding_status_syscode IS NOT NULL
              AND cd_boarding_status <> cd_boarding_status_syscode,
            'boarding_status_code_syscode_mismatch',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            is_business_image_reconstructed,
            'sparse_cdc_patch_applied',
            NULL
          )
        ],
        alert_code -> alert_code IS NOT NULL
      ),
      '|'
    ),
    ''
  ) AS cd_alert,
  NULLIF(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(
        ARRAY[
          IF(
            cd_parameter_identifier <> 'BOARDINGSTATUS',
            'The document previously represented Boarding Status but its current parameter identifier differs.',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            cd_parameter_identifier = 'BOARDINGSTATUS'
              AND de_boarding_status_name IS NULL,
            'The Boarding Status display name is missing.',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            cd_parameter_identifier = 'BOARDINGSTATUS'
              AND de_boarding_status_description IS NULL,
            'The Boarding Status business description is missing.',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            cd_boarding_status IS NOT NULL
              AND cd_boarding_status_syscode IS NOT NULL
              AND cd_boarding_status <> cd_boarding_status_syscode,
            'The normalized code and syscode do not agree.',
            NULL
          ),
          IF(
            is_business_image_reconstructed,
            'One or more later sparse ODS changes were applied to a complete source image.',
            NULL
          )
        ],
        alert_text -> alert_text IS NOT NULL
      ),
      ' | '
    ),
    ''
  ) AS de_alert,
  CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS run_id,
  source_id,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_update_utc
FROM finalized

collections.selectStatement:
WITH channel_src AS (
  SELECT cd_channel, cd_channel_normalized, de_channel_name
  FROM st_transaction_data
  WHERE cd_error IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cd_channel, cd_channel_normalized, de_channel_name
  FROM st_segment_transaction_data
  WHERE cd_error IS NULL
),
normalized AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(cd_channel_normalized), ''), LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(cd_channel), '')), 'unknown') AS cd_channel_normalized
  FROM channel_src
)
SELECT
  to_hex(sha256(to_utf8(cd_channel_normalized))) AS sk_channel,
  cd_channel_normalized AS cd_channel,
  cd_channel_normalized,
  CASE
    WHEN cd_channel_normalized IN ('web', 'counter', 'info', 'mobile', 'kiosk', 'automation', 'mybooking', 'publicsite') THEN cd_channel_normalized
    WHEN cd_channel_normalized = 'unknown' THEN 'unknown'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS cd_channel_group,
  CASE
    WHEN cd_channel_normalized = 'web' THEN 'Web'
    WHEN cd_channel_normalized = 'counter' THEN 'Counter'
    WHEN cd_channel_normalized = 'info' THEN 'Info'
    WHEN cd_channel_normalized = 'mobile' THEN 'Mobile'
    WHEN cd_channel_normalized = 'kiosk' THEN 'Kiosk'
    WHEN cd_channel_normalized = 'automation' THEN 'Automation'
    WHEN cd_channel_normalized = 'mybooking' THEN 'My Booking'
    WHEN cd_channel_normalized = 'publicsite' THEN 'Public Site'
    WHEN cd_channel_normalized = 'unknown' THEN 'Unknown'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS de_channel_group,
  CASE cd_channel_normalized
    WHEN 'web' THEN 'Web'
    WHEN 'counter' THEN 'Counter'
    WHEN 'info' THEN 'Info'
    WHEN 'mobile' THEN 'Mobile'
    WHEN 'kiosk' THEN 'Kiosk'
    WHEN 'automation' THEN 'Automation'
    WHEN 'mybooking' THEN 'My Booking'
    WHEN 'publicsite' THEN 'Public Site'
    ELSE cd_channel_normalized
  END AS de_channel_name,
  true AS is_current,
  date_format(CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp), '%Y%m%d') AS dt_partition,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_update_utc,
  CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS run_id
FROM normalized
