collections.selectStatement:
WITH authorization_rule_config AS (
  SELECT
    -- Confirmed by SITA: effective action ALL_ACCOUNT_ACCESS
    --   <=> allAccountAccessEnabled = true.
    CAST(true AS boolean) AS is_all_account_access_rule_confirmed
),
current_user_src AS (
  SELECT
    sk_user,
    nk_user_id,
    nk_account_id,
    cd_user_status,
    json_product_subscriptions,
    dt_valid_from,
    dt_valid_to,
    dt_source_load_utc,
    source_id
  FROM st_user
  WHERE is_current = true
    AND cd_error IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(is_deleted, false) = false
    AND LOWER(COALESCE(cd_user_status, '')) = 'active'
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(nk_user_id), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(nk_account_id), '') IS NOT NULL
),
current_account AS (
  SELECT
    sk_account,
    nk_account_id,
    dt_valid_from,
    dt_valid_to,
    dt_source_load_utc
  FROM st_account
  WHERE is_current = true
    AND cd_error IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(is_deleted, false) = false
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(nk_account_id), '') IS NOT NULL
),
user_subscription AS (
  SELECT
    user_src.sk_user,
    user_src.nk_user_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract_scalar(subscription, '$._id')), '')
      AS nk_product_subscription_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract_scalar(subscription, '$.productId')), '')
      AS cd_product_id,
    from_unixtime(
      TRY_CAST(
        json_extract_scalar(subscription, '$.startDateTime') AS bigint
      ) / 1000.0
    ) AS dt_subscription_start_utc,
    from_unixtime(
      TRY_CAST(
        json_extract_scalar(subscription, '$.endDateTime') AS bigint
      ) / 1000.0
    ) AS dt_subscription_end_utc,
    from_unixtime(
      TRY_CAST(
        json_extract_scalar(
          subscription,
          '$.lastModifiedDateTime'
        ) AS bigint
      ) / 1000.0
    ) AS dt_subscription_modified_utc,
    ARRAY_DISTINCT(
      FILTER(
        CONCAT(
          CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(
              TRIM(json_extract_scalar(subscription, '$.role')),
              ''
            ) IS NULL
              THEN CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(varchar))
            ELSE ARRAY[
              NULLIF(
                TRIM(json_extract_scalar(subscription, '$.role')),
                ''
              )
            ]
          END,
          COALESCE(
            TRY(
              CAST(
                json_extract(subscription, '$.roles')
                AS array(varchar)
              )
            ),
            CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(varchar))
          )
        ),
        role_code -> NULLIF(TRIM(role_code), '') IS NOT NULL
      )
    ) AS arr_access_role
  FROM current_user_src user_src
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(
    COALESCE(
      TRY(
        CAST(
          json_parse(user_src.json_product_subscriptions)
          AS array(json)
        )
      ),
      CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(json))
    )
  ) AS subscription_item(subscription)
  WHERE COALESCE(
      from_unixtime(
        TRY_CAST(
          json_extract_scalar(subscription, '$.startDateTime')
          AS bigint
        ) / 1000.0
      ),
      TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
    ) <= CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp)
    AND COALESCE(
      from_unixtime(
        TRY_CAST(
          json_extract_scalar(subscription, '$.endDateTime')
          AS bigint
        ) / 1000.0
      ),
      TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59'
    ) >= CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp)
),
user_role_raw AS (
  SELECT
    subscription.sk_user,
    subscription.nk_user_id,
    subscription.nk_product_subscription_id,
    subscription.cd_product_id,
    subscription.dt_subscription_start_utc,
    subscription.dt_subscription_end_utc,
    subscription.dt_subscription_modified_utc,
    NULLIF(TRIM(cd_access_role), '') AS cd_access_role,
    LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(cd_access_role), ''))
      AS cd_access_role_normalized
  FROM user_subscription subscription
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(subscription.arr_access_role)
    AS role_item(cd_access_role)
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(cd_access_role), '') IS NOT NULL
),
user_role_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY
        sk_user,
        LOWER(COALESCE(cd_product_id, '')),
        cd_access_role_normalized
      ORDER BY
        COALESCE(
          dt_subscription_modified_utc,
          TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
        ) DESC,
        COALESCE(
          dt_subscription_start_utc,
          TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
        ) DESC,
        COALESCE(nk_product_subscription_id, '') DESC
    ) AS ni_user_role_rank
  FROM user_role_raw
),
user_role_assignment AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM user_role_ranked
  WHERE ni_user_role_rank = 1
),
active_definition AS (
  SELECT
    sk_role_or_action_group,
    nk_role_or_action_group_id,
    cd_role_or_action_group_type AS cd_definition_type,
    cd_role_or_action_group_code AS cd_definition_code,
    LOWER(TRIM(cd_role_or_action_group_code))
      AS cd_definition_code_normalized,
    COALESCE(arr_action, CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(varchar)))
      AS arr_action,
    COALESCE(
      arr_role_or_action_group_reference,
      CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(varchar))
    ) AS arr_reference,
    dt_last_modified_utc,
    dt_source_load_utc
  FROM st_role_or_action_group
  WHERE is_current = true
    AND cd_error IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(is_deleted, false) = false
    AND cd_role_or_action_group_type IN ('ROLE', 'ACTION_GROUP')
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(cd_role_or_action_group_code), '') IS NOT NULL
),
definition_code_profile AS (
  SELECT
    cd_definition_code_normalized,
    COUNT(*) AS ni_definition_count
  FROM active_definition
  GROUP BY cd_definition_code_normalized
),
unique_definition AS (
  SELECT definition.*
  FROM active_definition definition
  JOIN definition_code_profile profile
    ON definition.cd_definition_code_normalized =
       profile.cd_definition_code_normalized
  WHERE profile.ni_definition_count = 1
),
role_code_profile AS (
  SELECT
    cd_definition_code_normalized AS cd_role_code_normalized,
    COUNT(*) AS ni_role_definition_count
  FROM unique_definition
  WHERE cd_definition_type = 'ROLE'
  GROUP BY cd_definition_code_normalized
),
unique_role_definition AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM unique_definition
  WHERE cd_definition_type = 'ROLE'
),
role_reference AS (
  SELECT
    role.sk_role_or_action_group,
    LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(reference_code), ''))
      AS cd_reference_code_normalized
  FROM unique_role_definition role
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(role.arr_reference)
    AS reference_item(reference_code)
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(reference_code), '') IS NOT NULL
),
role_reference_resolution AS (
  SELECT
    reference.sk_role_or_action_group,
    COALESCE(profile.ni_definition_count, 0)
      AS ni_target_definition_count,
    target.sk_role_or_action_group AS sk_target_definition,
    target.arr_reference AS arr_target_reference
  FROM role_reference reference
  LEFT JOIN definition_code_profile profile
    ON reference.cd_reference_code_normalized =
       profile.cd_definition_code_normalized
  LEFT JOIN unique_definition target
    ON reference.cd_reference_code_normalized =
       target.cd_definition_code_normalized
),
role_reference_profile AS (
  SELECT
    sk_role_or_action_group,
    COUNT_IF(ni_target_definition_count <> 1)
      AS ni_unresolved_reference_count,
    COUNT_IF(sk_target_definition = sk_role_or_action_group)
      AS ni_cycle_reference_count,
    COUNT_IF(
      ni_target_definition_count = 1
      AND CARDINALITY(arr_target_reference) > 0
    ) AS ni_deeper_reference_count
  FROM role_reference_resolution
  GROUP BY sk_role_or_action_group
),
role_graph_profile AS (
  SELECT
    role.*,
    COALESCE(reference_profile.ni_unresolved_reference_count, 0) = 0
      AND COALESCE(reference_profile.ni_cycle_reference_count, 0) = 0
      AND COALESCE(reference_profile.ni_deeper_reference_count, 0) = 0
      AS is_action_resolution_complete
  FROM unique_role_definition role
  LEFT JOIN role_reference_profile reference_profile
    ON role.sk_role_or_action_group =
       reference_profile.sk_role_or_action_group
),
role_action_candidate AS (
  SELECT
    role.sk_role_or_action_group,
    UPPER(TRIM(action_code)) AS cd_effective_action_normalized,
    CAST(0 AS integer) AS ni_resolution_depth,
    role.dt_last_modified_utc AS dt_action_graph_modified_utc,
    role.dt_source_load_utc AS dt_action_graph_source_load_utc
  FROM role_graph_profile role
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(role.arr_action) AS action_item(action_code)
  WHERE role.is_action_resolution_complete
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(action_code), '') IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    role.sk_role_or_action_group,
    UPPER(TRIM(action_code)) AS cd_effective_action_normalized,
    CAST(1 AS integer) AS ni_resolution_depth,
    GREATEST(
      COALESCE(
        role.dt_last_modified_utc,
        TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      ),
      COALESCE(
        target.dt_last_modified_utc,
        TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      )
    ) AS dt_action_graph_modified_utc,
    GREATEST(
      COALESCE(
        role.dt_source_load_utc,
        TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      ),
      COALESCE(
        target.dt_source_load_utc,
        TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      )
    ) AS dt_action_graph_source_load_utc
  FROM role_graph_profile role
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(role.arr_reference)
    AS reference_item(reference_code)
  JOIN unique_definition target
    ON LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(reference_code), '')) =
       target.cd_definition_code_normalized
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(target.arr_action) AS action_item(action_code)
  WHERE role.is_action_resolution_complete
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(action_code), '') IS NOT NULL
),
role_effective_action_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY
        sk_role_or_action_group,
        cd_effective_action_normalized
      ORDER BY ni_resolution_depth ASC
    ) AS ni_effective_action_rank
  FROM role_action_candidate
),
role_effective_action AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM role_effective_action_ranked
  WHERE ni_effective_action_rank = 1
),
resolved_role_assignment AS (
  SELECT
    assignment.*,
    COALESCE(profile.ni_role_definition_count, 0)
      AS ni_role_definition_count,
    role_definition.sk_role_or_action_group,
    role_definition.nk_role_or_action_group_id,
    role_definition.arr_action,
    role_definition.is_action_resolution_complete,
    role_definition.dt_last_modified_utc AS dt_role_modified_utc,
    role_definition.dt_source_load_utc AS dt_role_source_load_utc
  FROM user_role_assignment assignment
  LEFT JOIN role_code_profile profile
    ON assignment.cd_access_role_normalized =
       profile.cd_role_code_normalized
  LEFT JOIN role_graph_profile role_definition
    ON assignment.cd_access_role_normalized =
       role_definition.cd_definition_code_normalized
),
assignment_profile AS (
  SELECT
    sk_user,
    COUNT(*) AS ni_role_assignment_count,
    COUNT_IF(
      ni_role_definition_count <> 1
      OR NOT COALESCE(is_action_resolution_complete, false)
    ) AS ni_unresolved_role_assignment_count,
    COUNT_IF(
      ni_role_definition_count = 1
      AND COALESCE(is_action_resolution_complete, false)
      AND CONTAINS(
        TRANSFORM(
          COALESCE(arr_action, CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(varchar))),
          action_code -> UPPER(TRIM(action_code))
        ),
        'ALL_ACCOUNT_ACCESS'
      )
    ) > 0 AS is_direct_all_account_access_action_present,
    COUNT_IF(
      ni_role_definition_count = 1
      AND COALESCE(is_action_resolution_complete, false)
      AND CONTAINS(
        TRANSFORM(
          COALESCE(arr_action, CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(varchar))),
          action_code -> UPPER(TRIM(action_code))
        ),
        'READ_DASHBOARD_DATA'
      )
    ) > 0 AS is_direct_dashboard_data_action_present,
    MAX(dt_role_source_load_utc) AS dt_role_source_load_utc
  FROM resolved_role_assignment
  GROUP BY sk_user
),
effective_action_profile AS (
  SELECT
    assignment.sk_user,
    COUNT_IF(
      action.cd_effective_action_normalized = 'ALL_ACCOUNT_ACCESS'
    ) > 0 AS is_effective_all_account_access_action_present,
    MIN(
      CASE
        WHEN action.cd_effective_action_normalized = 'ALL_ACCOUNT_ACCESS'
          THEN GREATEST(
            COALESCE(
              assignment.dt_subscription_start_utc,
              TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
            ),
            COALESCE(
              action.dt_action_graph_modified_utc,
              TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
            )
          )
      END
    ) AS dt_all_account_access_valid_from,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN action.cd_effective_action_normalized = 'ALL_ACCOUNT_ACCESS'
          THEN COALESCE(
            assignment.dt_subscription_end_utc,
            TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59'
          )
      END
    ) AS dt_all_account_access_valid_to,
    MAX(action.dt_action_graph_source_load_utc)
      AS dt_effective_action_source_load_utc
  FROM resolved_role_assignment assignment
  JOIN role_effective_action action
    ON assignment.sk_role_or_action_group =
       action.sk_role_or_action_group
  WHERE assignment.ni_role_definition_count = 1
    AND assignment.is_action_resolution_complete
  GROUP BY assignment.sk_user
),
user_direct_action AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    assignment.sk_user,
    UPPER(TRIM(action_code)) AS cd_direct_action
  FROM resolved_role_assignment assignment
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(
    COALESCE(
      assignment.arr_action,
      CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(varchar))
    )
  ) AS action_item(action_code)
  WHERE assignment.ni_role_definition_count = 1
    AND assignment.is_action_resolution_complete
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(action_code), '') IS NOT NULL
),
direct_action_profile AS (
  SELECT
    sk_user,
    COUNT(*) AS ni_direct_action_count
  FROM user_direct_action
  GROUP BY sk_user
),
eligible_user AS (
  SELECT
    user_src.sk_user,
    user_src.nk_user_id,
    user_src.nk_account_id AS nk_home_account_id,
    user_src.cd_user_status,
    user_src.dt_valid_from AS dt_user_valid_from,
    COALESCE(
      user_src.dt_valid_to,
      TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59'
    ) AS dt_user_valid_to,
    user_src.dt_source_load_utc AS dt_user_source_load_utc,
    user_src.source_id AS de_user_source_id,
    home_account.sk_account AS sk_home_account,
    home_account.dt_valid_from AS dt_home_account_valid_from,
    COALESCE(
      home_account.dt_valid_to,
      TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59'
    ) AS dt_home_account_valid_to,
    home_account.dt_source_load_utc AS dt_home_account_source_load_utc,
    COALESCE(profile.ni_role_assignment_count, 0)
      AS ni_role_assignment_count,
    COALESCE(action_profile.ni_direct_action_count, 0)
      AS ni_direct_action_count,
    COALESCE(profile.ni_unresolved_role_assignment_count, 0)
      AS ni_unresolved_role_assignment_count,
    COALESCE(profile.ni_role_assignment_count, 0) > 0
      AND COALESCE(profile.ni_unresolved_role_assignment_count, 0) = 0
      AS is_authorization_evidence_complete,
    COALESCE(
      profile.is_direct_all_account_access_action_present,
      false
    ) AS is_direct_all_account_access_action_present,
    config.is_all_account_access_rule_confirmed,
    config.is_all_account_access_rule_confirmed
      AND COALESCE(
        effective_profile.is_effective_all_account_access_action_present,
        false
      )
      AND COALESCE(profile.ni_role_assignment_count, 0) > 0
      AND COALESCE(profile.ni_unresolved_role_assignment_count, 0) = 0
      AS is_all_account_access_enabled,
    COALESCE(
      profile.is_direct_dashboard_data_action_present,
      false
    ) AS is_direct_dashboard_data_action_present,
    effective_profile.dt_all_account_access_valid_from,
    effective_profile.dt_all_account_access_valid_to,
    GREATEST(
      COALESCE(
        profile.dt_role_source_load_utc,
        TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      ),
      COALESCE(
        effective_profile.dt_effective_action_source_load_utc,
        TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      )
    ) AS dt_role_source_load_utc
  FROM current_user_src user_src
  JOIN current_account home_account
    ON user_src.nk_account_id = home_account.nk_account_id
  LEFT JOIN assignment_profile profile
    ON user_src.sk_user = profile.sk_user
  LEFT JOIN direct_action_profile action_profile
    ON user_src.sk_user = action_profile.sk_user
  LEFT JOIN effective_action_profile effective_profile
    ON user_src.sk_user = effective_profile.sk_user
  CROSS JOIN authorization_rule_config config
),
own_account_scope AS (
  SELECT
    access_user.*,
    access_user.sk_home_account AS sk_allowed_account,
    access_user.nk_home_account_id AS nk_allowed_account_id,
    access_user.dt_home_account_valid_from AS dt_allowed_account_valid_from,
    access_user.dt_home_account_valid_to AS dt_allowed_account_valid_to,
    access_user.dt_home_account_source_load_utc
      AS dt_allowed_account_source_load_utc,
    'own_account' AS cd_access_scope
  FROM eligible_user access_user
  WHERE NOT access_user.is_all_account_access_enabled
),
all_account_scope AS (
  SELECT
    access_user.*,
    account.sk_account AS sk_allowed_account,
    account.nk_account_id AS nk_allowed_account_id,
    account.dt_valid_from AS dt_allowed_account_valid_from,
    COALESCE(
      account.dt_valid_to,
      TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59'
    ) AS dt_allowed_account_valid_to,
    account.dt_source_load_utc AS dt_allowed_account_source_load_utc,
    'all_account' AS cd_access_scope
  FROM eligible_user access_user
  CROSS JOIN current_account account
  WHERE access_user.is_all_account_access_enabled
),
access_scope AS (
  SELECT * FROM own_account_scope
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM all_account_scope
),
projected AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    GREATEST(
      COALESCE(
        dt_user_valid_from,
        TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      ),
      COALESCE(
        dt_allowed_account_valid_from,
        TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      ),
      CASE
        WHEN is_all_account_access_enabled
          THEN COALESCE(
            dt_all_account_access_valid_from,
            TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
          )
        ELSE TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      END
    ) AS dt_access_valid_from,
    LEAST(
      dt_user_valid_to,
      dt_allowed_account_valid_to,
      CASE
        WHEN is_all_account_access_enabled
          THEN COALESCE(
            dt_all_account_access_valid_to,
            TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59'
          )
        ELSE TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59'
      END
    ) AS dt_access_valid_to,
    GREATEST(
      COALESCE(
        dt_user_source_load_utc,
        TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      ),
      COALESCE(
        dt_home_account_source_load_utc,
        TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      ),
      COALESCE(
        dt_allowed_account_source_load_utc,
        TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      ),
      COALESCE(
        dt_role_source_load_utc,
        TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      )
    ) AS dt_effective_source_load_utc
  FROM access_scope
)
SELECT
  to_hex(
    sha256(
      to_utf8(
        CONCAT(
          nk_user_id, '|',
          nk_allowed_account_id
        )
      )
    )
  ) AS sk_user_account_access,
  sk_user,
  nk_user_id,
  nk_home_account_id,
  sk_allowed_account,
  nk_allowed_account_id,
  cd_user_status,
  cd_access_scope,
  TRY_CAST(ni_role_assignment_count AS integer)
    AS ni_role_assignment_count,
  TRY_CAST(ni_direct_action_count AS integer)
    AS ni_direct_action_count,
  TRY_CAST(ni_unresolved_role_assignment_count AS integer)
    AS ni_unresolved_role_assignment_count,
  is_authorization_evidence_complete,
  is_direct_all_account_access_action_present,
  is_all_account_access_rule_confirmed,
  is_all_account_access_enabled,
  is_direct_dashboard_data_action_present,
  dt_access_valid_from,
  dt_access_valid_to,
  true AS is_current,
  'st_user+st_role_or_action_group+st_account' AS de_source_table,
  NULLIF(
    dt_effective_source_load_utc,
    TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
  ) AS dt_source_load_utc,
  CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS run_id,
  CONCAT(
    COALESCE(de_user_source_id, 'st_user:missing'),
    '|allowed_account:',
    nk_allowed_account_id
  ) AS source_id,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_update_utc
FROM projected

collections.description: CONSUMPTION dsr_user_report_access at one active Timatic user per product, assigned role, and effective dashboard action.
collections.comments:
Purpose: CONSUMPTION report/action permission map at one active Timatic user per product, assigned role, and effective dashboard action. Account row scope remains governed separately by dsr_user_account_access.
Grain: one active Timatic user per product, assigned role, and effective dashboard action.
Source and extraction: conformed.st_user; conformed.st_role_or_action_group
Keys and cardinality: Technical/source primary key: sk_user_report_access. Additional uniqueness: nk_user_id, cd_product_id, cd_access_role, cd_report_action.
History/SCD: Current snapshot/reference object; no separate Type-2 history object is approved.
Soft deletes and absence: The snapshot/load excludes explicitly deleted or ineligible CONFORMED rows. Production reruns must use an atomic dbt rebuild/swap; absence alone is not a new delete signal.
Load, corrections, and reruns: Current portable SQL uses a full snapshot DELETE/INSERT template. The Hackolade As Select Statement contains the canonical transformation extracted from model_package/sql/05_consumption_dim_load_sql.sql. Production dbt must rebuild/swap atomically so readers never observe the gap; run_id must be stamped by orchestration.
Data quality: cd_error/de_error and cd_alert/de_alert remain visible where modelled; key, cast, timestamp, domain, and relationship coverage are validated before CONSUMPTION publication.
Sensitive data: No email, name, token, password, or secret is published; stable Timatic identifiers only.
Known limitation/assumption: No additional approved limitation.
Governance: shared structure, key, grain, SCD, or publication changes require I&D data-modeler and data-engineering review.
collections.selectStatement:
WITH report_action_config (
  cd_report_action_normalized,
  cd_report_action
) AS (
  VALUES
    ('VIEW_RAWDATA', 'View_RawData'),
    ('VIEW_OPERATIONALPERFORMANCE', 'View_OperationalPerformance'),
    (
      'VIEW_OPERATIONALPERFORMANCEINFORM',
      'View_OperationalPerformanceInform'
    ),
    ('VIEW_WHOAREMYCUSTOMER', 'View_WhoAreMyCustomer'),
    ('VIEW_PUBLISHINGACTIVITIES', 'View_PublishingActivities'),
    ('VIEW_BILLINGREPORT', 'View_BillingReport'),
    ('VIEW_RECONCILIATIONBILLING', 'View_ReconciliationBilling'),
    ('READ_DASHBOARD_DATA', 'Read_Dashboard_Data'),
    (
      'DB_VIEW_EXTERNAL_USER_LANDING_DASHBOARD',
      'DB_View_External_User_Landing_Dashboard'
    )
),
current_user_src AS (
  SELECT
    sk_user,
    nk_user_id,
    nk_account_id,
    cd_user_status,
    json_product_subscriptions,
    dt_valid_from,
    COALESCE(
      dt_valid_to,
      TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59'
    ) AS dt_valid_to,
    dt_source_load_utc,
    source_id
  FROM st_user
  WHERE is_current = true
    AND cd_error IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(is_deleted, false) = false
    AND LOWER(COALESCE(cd_user_status, '')) = 'active'
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(nk_user_id), '') IS NOT NULL
),
user_subscription AS (
  SELECT
    user_src.sk_user,
    user_src.nk_user_id,
    user_src.nk_account_id AS nk_home_account_id,
    user_src.cd_user_status,
    user_src.dt_valid_from AS dt_user_valid_from,
    user_src.dt_valid_to AS dt_user_valid_to,
    user_src.dt_source_load_utc AS dt_user_source_load_utc,
    user_src.source_id AS de_user_source_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract_scalar(subscription, '$._id')), '')
      AS nk_product_subscription_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract_scalar(subscription, '$.productId')), '')
      AS cd_product_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract_scalar(subscription, '$.productName')), '')
      AS de_product_name,
    from_unixtime(
      TRY_CAST(
        json_extract_scalar(subscription, '$.startDateTime') AS bigint
      ) / 1000.0
    ) AS dt_subscription_start_utc,
    from_unixtime(
      TRY_CAST(
        json_extract_scalar(subscription, '$.endDateTime') AS bigint
      ) / 1000.0
    ) AS dt_subscription_end_utc,
    from_unixtime(
      TRY_CAST(
        json_extract_scalar(
          subscription,
          '$.lastModifiedDateTime'
        ) AS bigint
      ) / 1000.0
    ) AS dt_subscription_modified_utc,
    ARRAY_DISTINCT(
      FILTER(
        CONCAT(
          CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(
              TRIM(json_extract_scalar(subscription, '$.role')),
              ''
            ) IS NULL
              THEN CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(varchar))
            ELSE ARRAY[
              NULLIF(
                TRIM(json_extract_scalar(subscription, '$.role')),
                ''
              )
            ]
          END,
          COALESCE(
            TRY(
              CAST(
                json_extract(subscription, '$.roles')
                AS array(varchar)
              )
            ),
            CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(varchar))
          )
        ),
        role_code -> NULLIF(TRIM(role_code), '') IS NOT NULL
      )
    ) AS arr_access_role
  FROM current_user_src user_src
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(
    COALESCE(
      TRY(
        CAST(
          json_parse(user_src.json_product_subscriptions)
          AS array(json)
        )
      ),
      CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(json))
    )
  ) AS subscription_item(subscription)
  WHERE COALESCE(
      from_unixtime(
        TRY_CAST(
          json_extract_scalar(subscription, '$.startDateTime')
          AS bigint
        ) / 1000.0
      ),
      TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
    ) <= CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp)
    AND COALESCE(
      from_unixtime(
        TRY_CAST(
          json_extract_scalar(subscription, '$.endDateTime')
          AS bigint
        ) / 1000.0
      ),
      TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59'
    ) >= CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp)
),
user_role_raw AS (
  SELECT
    subscription.*,
    NULLIF(TRIM(access_role), '') AS cd_assigned_access_role,
    LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(access_role), ''))
      AS cd_access_role_normalized
  FROM user_subscription subscription
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(subscription.arr_access_role)
    AS role_item(access_role)
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(access_role), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND subscription.cd_product_id IS NOT NULL
),
user_role_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY
        sk_user,
        LOWER(cd_product_id),
        cd_access_role_normalized
      ORDER BY
        COALESCE(
          dt_subscription_modified_utc,
          TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
        ) DESC,
        COALESCE(
          dt_subscription_start_utc,
          TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
        ) DESC,
        COALESCE(nk_product_subscription_id, '') DESC
    ) AS ni_user_role_rank
  FROM user_role_raw
),
user_role_assignment AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM user_role_ranked
  WHERE ni_user_role_rank = 1
),
active_definition AS (
  SELECT
    sk_role_or_action_group,
    nk_role_or_action_group_id,
    cd_role_or_action_group_type AS cd_definition_type,
    cd_role_or_action_group_code AS cd_definition_code,
    LOWER(TRIM(cd_role_or_action_group_code))
      AS cd_definition_code_normalized,
    COALESCE(arr_action, CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(varchar)))
      AS arr_action,
    COALESCE(
      arr_role_or_action_group_reference,
      CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(varchar))
    ) AS arr_reference,
    dt_last_modified_utc,
    dt_source_load_utc
  FROM st_role_or_action_group
  WHERE is_current = true
    AND cd_error IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(is_deleted, false) = false
    AND cd_role_or_action_group_type IN ('ROLE', 'ACTION_GROUP')
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(cd_role_or_action_group_code), '') IS NOT NULL
),
definition_code_profile AS (
  SELECT
    cd_definition_code_normalized,
    COUNT(*) AS ni_definition_count
  FROM active_definition
  GROUP BY cd_definition_code_normalized
),
unique_definition AS (
  SELECT definition.*
  FROM active_definition definition
  JOIN definition_code_profile profile
    ON definition.cd_definition_code_normalized =
       profile.cd_definition_code_normalized
  WHERE profile.ni_definition_count = 1
),
role_reference AS (
  SELECT
    role.sk_role_or_action_group AS sk_access_role,
    role.nk_role_or_action_group_id AS nk_access_role_id,
    role.cd_definition_code_normalized AS cd_access_role_normalized,
    LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(reference_code), ''))
      AS cd_reference_code_normalized
  FROM unique_definition role
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(role.arr_reference)
    AS reference_item(reference_code)
  WHERE role.cd_definition_type = 'ROLE'
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(reference_code), '') IS NOT NULL
),
role_reference_resolution AS (
  SELECT
    reference.*,
    COALESCE(profile.ni_definition_count, 0)
      AS ni_target_definition_count,
    target.sk_role_or_action_group AS sk_target_definition,
    target.nk_role_or_action_group_id AS nk_target_definition_id,
    target.cd_definition_type AS cd_target_definition_type,
    target.cd_definition_code AS cd_target_definition_code,
    target.cd_definition_code_normalized
      AS cd_target_definition_code_normalized,
    target.arr_action AS arr_target_action,
    target.arr_reference AS arr_target_reference,
    target.dt_last_modified_utc AS dt_target_modified_utc,
    target.dt_source_load_utc AS dt_target_source_load_utc
  FROM role_reference reference
  LEFT JOIN definition_code_profile profile
    ON reference.cd_reference_code_normalized =
       profile.cd_definition_code_normalized
  LEFT JOIN unique_definition target
    ON reference.cd_reference_code_normalized =
       target.cd_definition_code_normalized
),
role_reference_profile AS (
  SELECT
    sk_access_role,
    COUNT(*) AS ni_reference_count,
    COUNT_IF(ni_target_definition_count <> 1)
      AS ni_unresolved_reference_count,
    COUNT_IF(sk_target_definition = sk_access_role)
      AS ni_cycle_reference_count,
    COUNT_IF(
      ni_target_definition_count = 1
      AND CARDINALITY(arr_target_reference) > 0
    ) AS ni_deeper_reference_count
  FROM role_reference_resolution
  GROUP BY sk_access_role
),
role_graph_profile AS (
  SELECT
    role.*,
    COALESCE(reference_profile.ni_reference_count, 0)
      AS ni_reference_count,
    COALESCE(reference_profile.ni_unresolved_reference_count, 0)
      AS ni_unresolved_reference_count,
    COALESCE(reference_profile.ni_cycle_reference_count, 0)
      AS ni_cycle_reference_count,
    COALESCE(reference_profile.ni_deeper_reference_count, 0)
      AS ni_deeper_reference_count,
    COALESCE(reference_profile.ni_unresolved_reference_count, 0) = 0
      AND COALESCE(reference_profile.ni_cycle_reference_count, 0) = 0
      AND COALESCE(reference_profile.ni_deeper_reference_count, 0) = 0
      AS is_action_resolution_complete
  FROM unique_definition role
  LEFT JOIN role_reference_profile reference_profile
    ON role.sk_role_or_action_group =
       reference_profile.sk_access_role
  WHERE role.cd_definition_type = 'ROLE'
),
role_action_candidate AS (
  SELECT
    role.sk_role_or_action_group AS sk_access_role,
    role.nk_role_or_action_group_id AS nk_access_role_id,
    role.cd_definition_code AS cd_access_role,
    role.cd_definition_code_normalized
      AS cd_access_role_normalized,
    role.cd_definition_type AS cd_action_source_type,
    role.cd_definition_code AS cd_action_source_code,
    role.sk_role_or_action_group AS sk_action_source,
    role.nk_role_or_action_group_id AS nk_action_source_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(action_code), '') AS cd_effective_action,
    CAST(0 AS integer) AS ni_resolution_depth,
    role.dt_last_modified_utc AS dt_action_graph_modified_utc,
    role.dt_source_load_utc AS dt_action_graph_source_load_utc
  FROM role_graph_profile role
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(role.arr_action) AS action_item(action_code)
  WHERE role.is_action_resolution_complete
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(action_code), '') IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    role.sk_role_or_action_group AS sk_access_role,
    role.nk_role_or_action_group_id AS nk_access_role_id,
    role.cd_definition_code AS cd_access_role,
    role.cd_definition_code_normalized
      AS cd_access_role_normalized,
    target.cd_definition_type AS cd_action_source_type,
    target.cd_definition_code AS cd_action_source_code,
    target.sk_role_or_action_group AS sk_action_source,
    target.nk_role_or_action_group_id AS nk_action_source_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(action_code), '') AS cd_effective_action,
    CAST(1 AS integer) AS ni_resolution_depth,
    GREATEST(
      COALESCE(
        role.dt_last_modified_utc,
        TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      ),
      COALESCE(
        target.dt_last_modified_utc,
        TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      )
    ) AS dt_action_graph_modified_utc,
    GREATEST(
      COALESCE(
        role.dt_source_load_utc,
        TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      ),
      COALESCE(
        target.dt_source_load_utc,
        TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      )
    ) AS dt_action_graph_source_load_utc
  FROM role_graph_profile role
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(role.arr_reference)
    AS reference_item(reference_code)
  JOIN unique_definition target
    ON LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(reference_code), '')) =
       target.cd_definition_code_normalized
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(target.arr_action) AS action_item(action_code)
  WHERE role.is_action_resolution_complete
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(action_code), '') IS NOT NULL
),
role_report_action_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    action.*,
    config.cd_report_action,
    config.cd_report_action_normalized,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY
        action.sk_access_role,
        config.cd_report_action_normalized
      ORDER BY
        action.ni_resolution_depth ASC,
        LOWER(action.cd_action_source_code) ASC,
        action.nk_action_source_id ASC
    ) AS ni_role_action_rank
  FROM role_action_candidate action
  JOIN report_action_config config
    ON UPPER(TRIM(action.cd_effective_action)) =
       config.cd_report_action_normalized
),
role_report_action AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM role_report_action_ranked
  WHERE ni_role_action_rank = 1
),
user_report_action_candidate AS (
  SELECT
    assignment.sk_user,
    assignment.nk_user_id,
    assignment.nk_home_account_id,
    assignment.nk_product_subscription_id,
    assignment.cd_product_id,
    assignment.de_product_name,
    report_action.cd_access_role,
    report_action.cd_access_role_normalized,
    report_action.sk_access_role,
    report_action.nk_access_role_id,
    report_action.cd_report_action,
    report_action.cd_report_action_normalized,
    report_action.cd_action_source_type,
    report_action.cd_action_source_code,
    report_action.sk_action_source,
    report_action.nk_action_source_id,
    report_action.ni_resolution_depth,
    GREATEST(
      COALESCE(
        assignment.dt_user_valid_from,
        TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      ),
      COALESCE(
        assignment.dt_subscription_start_utc,
        TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      ),
      COALESCE(
        report_action.dt_action_graph_modified_utc,
        TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      )
    ) AS dt_access_valid_from,
    LEAST(
      assignment.dt_user_valid_to,
      COALESCE(
        assignment.dt_subscription_end_utc,
        TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59'
      )
    ) AS dt_access_valid_to,
    GREATEST(
      COALESCE(
        assignment.dt_user_source_load_utc,
        TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      ),
      COALESCE(
        report_action.dt_action_graph_source_load_utc,
        TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
      )
    ) AS dt_effective_source_load_utc,
    assignment.de_user_source_id
  FROM user_role_assignment assignment
  JOIN role_report_action report_action
    ON assignment.cd_access_role_normalized =
       report_action.cd_access_role_normalized
),
user_report_action_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY
        sk_user,
        LOWER(cd_product_id),
        cd_access_role_normalized,
        cd_report_action_normalized
      ORDER BY
        ni_resolution_depth ASC,
        COALESCE(nk_product_subscription_id, '') DESC,
        COALESCE(nk_action_source_id, '') ASC
    ) AS ni_user_report_action_rank
  FROM user_report_action_candidate
  WHERE dt_access_valid_to >= dt_access_valid_from
)
SELECT
  to_hex(
    sha256(
      to_utf8(
        CONCAT(
          nk_user_id, '|',
          LOWER(cd_product_id), '|',
          cd_access_role_normalized, '|',
          cd_report_action_normalized
        )
      )
    )
  ) AS sk_user_report_access,
  sk_user,
  nk_user_id,
  nk_home_account_id,
  nk_product_subscription_id,
  cd_product_id,
  de_product_name,
  cd_access_role,
  sk_access_role,
  nk_access_role_id,
  cd_report_action,
  cd_action_source_type,
  cd_action_source_code,
  sk_action_source,
  nk_action_source_id,
  ni_resolution_depth = 0 AS is_direct_action,
  TRY_CAST(ni_resolution_depth AS integer) AS ni_resolution_depth,
  dt_access_valid_from,
  dt_access_valid_to,
  true AS is_current,
  'st_user+st_role_or_action_group' AS de_source_table,
  NULLIF(
    dt_effective_source_load_utc,
    TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
  ) AS dt_source_load_utc,
  CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS run_id,
  CONCAT(
    COALESCE(de_user_source_id, 'st_user:missing'),
    '|product_subscription:',
    COALESCE(nk_product_subscription_id, 'missing'),
    '|role:',
    nk_access_role_id,
    '|action_source:',
    nk_action_source_id,
    '|report_action:',
    cd_report_action
  ) AS source_id,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_update_utc
FROM user_report_action_ranked
WHERE ni_user_report_action_rank = 1

collections.description:
TIM-IDL-F06-01/03. Transaction detail for the Data Page and downstream reporting.

One row per valid, non-deleted CONFORMED transaction document. sk_transaction_event inherits sk_transaction_data and must be unique. nk_transaction_document_id retains the source document ID. Check nk_transaction_id uniqueness before using it to join other facts.

Account, user and location lookups return at most one current match. Missing or ambiguous matches retain their status. Segment evidence is collected for the resolved parent transaction. Transaction, successful and chargeable counts can be summed at event grain, before any one-to-many joins.

Arrays retain the submitted values. Comma-separated fields are for display, not joins. The original scalar labels are kept in de_source_* fields where a display field now contains a list.

Boarding status is matched by account and passenger as of the transaction query time. Both the status and recorded time must be no later than the query. An ambiguous latest match remains unresolved. This is recorded passenger/account status, not proof of boarding on the Journey. Timatic evaluation results remain separate.
collections.comments:
Sources: st_account, st_boarding_status, st_location, st_segment_transaction_data, st_transaction_data, st_user.

Loaded incrementally by data engineering. Replace the affected event by its technical key. Segment, boarding-status and lookup changes can also require the transaction to be refreshed.

History: current values for retained source events, with current dimension references. CONFORMED errors and deleted records are excluded; warnings and match-status fields remain visible.

Checks: unique technical key, source-row reconciliation, lookup coverage and timestamp consistency. Retain source keys and audit fields for trace-back.

cd_row_signature is an internal join field used by the load. It has no reporting role.

The three ni_request_leg_* timing counters exist in the table but are not yet included in the SELECT below.

Keep account/user access rules on report and export paths. Request payloads and passenger/document identifiers remain restricted.
collections.selectStatement:
-- TIM-IDL-F06-01/03. Transaction detail for the Data Page and downstream reporting.
-- cd_row_signature is handled by the load logic.
-- The three ni_request_leg_* timing counters are not included in this SELECT.
WITH transaction_source AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_transaction_data
  WHERE
    cd_error IS NULL AND COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
), segment_source AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_segment_transaction_data
  WHERE
    cd_error IS NULL AND COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
), transaction_id_profile AS (
  SELECT
    nk_transaction_id,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS INTEGER) AS ni_transaction_candidate_count,
    MAX(sk_transaction_data) AS sk_single_transaction_event
  FROM transaction_source
  GROUP BY
    nk_transaction_id
), ambiguous_transaction_source AS (
  SELECT
    t.*
  FROM transaction_source AS t
  JOIN transaction_id_profile AS p
    ON t.nk_transaction_id = p.nk_transaction_id
    AND p.ni_transaction_candidate_count > 1
), passenger_timestamp_profile AS (
  SELECT
    s.sk_segment_transaction_data,
    CAST(COUNT(t.sk_transaction_data) AS INTEGER) AS ni_transaction_passenger_timestamp_candidate_count,
    MAX(t.sk_transaction_data) AS sk_passenger_timestamp_transaction_event
  FROM segment_source AS s
  JOIN transaction_id_profile AS p
    ON s.nk_transaction_id = p.nk_transaction_id
    AND p.ni_transaction_candidate_count > 1
  LEFT JOIN ambiguous_transaction_source AS t
    ON s.nk_transaction_id = t.nk_transaction_id
    AND NOT s.nk_passenger_id IS NULL
    AND s.nk_passenger_id = t.nk_passenger_id
    AND NOT s.dt_transaction_utc IS NULL
    AND s.dt_transaction_utc = t.dt_transaction_utc
  GROUP BY
    s.sk_segment_transaction_data
), segment_parent AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN p.ni_transaction_candidate_count = 1
      THEN p.sk_single_transaction_event
      WHEN p.ni_transaction_candidate_count > 1
      AND pt.ni_transaction_passenger_timestamp_candidate_count = 1
      THEN pt.sk_passenger_timestamp_transaction_event
    END AS sk_transaction_event,
    NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_regulation_applicability)), '') AS cd_regulation_applicability,
    s.sk_segment_transaction_data,
    NULLIF(TRIM(s.cd_processing_entity_id), '') AS cd_processing_entity_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(s.de_processing_entity_name), '') AS de_processing_entity_name
  FROM segment_source AS s
  LEFT JOIN transaction_id_profile AS p
    ON s.nk_transaction_id = p.nk_transaction_id
  LEFT JOIN passenger_timestamp_profile AS pt
    ON s.sk_segment_transaction_data = pt.sk_segment_transaction_data
), segment_applicability AS (
  SELECT
    sk_transaction_event,
    ARRAY_SORT(
      ARRAY_DISTINCT(
        FILTER(ARRAY_AGG(cd_regulation_applicability), value -> value IN ('ENTRY', 'TRANSIT'))
      )
    ) AS arr_regulation_applicability,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT_IF(cd_regulation_applicability IN ('ENTRY', 'TRANSIT')) = COUNT(*)
      THEN 'available'
      WHEN COUNT_IF(cd_regulation_applicability IN ('ENTRY', 'TRANSIT')) > 0
      THEN 'partial'
      ELSE 'unavailable'
    END AS cd_regulation_applicability_status,
    ARRAY_SORT(ARRAY_DISTINCT(FILTER(ARRAY_AGG(cd_processing_entity_id), v -> NOT v IS NULL))) AS arr_processing_entity_id,
    ARRAY_SORT(ARRAY_DISTINCT(FILTER(ARRAY_AGG(de_processing_entity_name), v -> NOT v IS NULL))) AS arr_processing_entity_name,
    ARRAY_AGG(
      CAST(ROW(sk_segment_transaction_data, cd_processing_entity_id, de_processing_entity_name) AS ROW(
        sk_segment_transaction_event VARCHAR,
        cd_processing_entity_id VARCHAR,
        de_processing_entity_name VARCHAR
      )) ORDER BY sk_segment_transaction_data
    ) AS arr_segment_processing_entity,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT_IF(NOT cd_processing_entity_id IS NULL) = COUNT(*)
      THEN 'available'
      WHEN COUNT_IF(NOT cd_processing_entity_id IS NULL OR NOT de_processing_entity_name IS NULL) > 0
      THEN 'partial'
      ELSE 'unavailable'
    END AS cd_processing_entity_status
  FROM segment_parent
  WHERE
    NOT sk_transaction_event IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    sk_transaction_event
), account_latest AS (
  SELECT
    nk_account_id,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT sk_account) AS INTEGER) AS ni_account_match_count,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sk_account) = 1 THEN MAX(sk_account) ELSE NULL END AS sk_account_latest
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_account
  WHERE
    cd_error IS NULL
    AND is_current = TRUE
    AND COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND NOT nk_account_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    nk_account_id
), user_latest AS (
  SELECT
    nk_user_id,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT sk_user) AS INTEGER) AS ni_user_match_count,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sk_user) = 1 THEN MAX(sk_user) ELSE NULL END AS sk_user_latest
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_user
  WHERE
    cd_error IS NULL
    AND is_current = TRUE
    AND COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND NOT nk_user_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    nk_user_id
), current_location AS (
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    cd_location_code,
    cd_code,
    cd_code2,
    cd_code3,
    cd_code5,
    cd_syscode
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_location
  WHERE
    cd_error IS NULL AND is_current = TRUE AND COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
), location_code_source AS (
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_location_code)) AS cd_location_code
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_location_code), '') IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_code))
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_code), '') IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_code2))
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_code2), '') IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_code3))
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_code3), '') IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_code5))
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_code5), '') IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_syscode))
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_syscode), '') IS NULL
), location_code_resolver AS (
  SELECT
    cd_location_code,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT sk_location) AS INTEGER) AS ni_location_match_count,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sk_location) = 1 THEN MAX(sk_location) ELSE NULL END AS sk_location_latest
  FROM location_code_source
  GROUP BY
    cd_location_code
), boarding_status_source AS (
  SELECT
    sk_boarding_status,
    nk_boarding_status_document_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(nk_account_id), '') AS nk_account_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(nk_passenger_id), '') AS nk_passenger_id,
    cd_boarding_status,
    dt_boarding_status_utc,
    dt_source_event_utc AS dt_boarding_status_recorded_utc
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_boarding_status
  WHERE
    cd_error IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(sk_boarding_status), '') IS NULL
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(nk_boarding_status_document_id), '') IS NULL
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(nk_account_id), '') IS NULL
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(nk_passenger_id), '') IS NULL
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_boarding_status), '') IS NULL
    AND NOT dt_boarding_status_utc IS NULL
    AND NOT dt_source_event_utc IS NULL
), boarding_status_candidate AS (
  SELECT
    t.sk_transaction_data,
    b.sk_boarding_status,
    b.nk_boarding_status_document_id,
    b.cd_boarding_status,
    b.dt_boarding_status_utc,
    b.dt_boarding_status_recorded_utc
  FROM transaction_source AS t
  JOIN boarding_status_source AS b
    ON NULLIF(TRIM(t.nk_account_id), '') = b.nk_account_id
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(t.nk_passenger_id), '') = b.nk_passenger_id
    AND b.dt_boarding_status_utc <= t.dt_transaction_utc
    AND b.dt_boarding_status_recorded_utc <= t.dt_transaction_utc
), boarding_status_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sk_transaction_data ORDER BY dt_boarding_status_utc DESC) AS ni_boarding_status_time_rank
  FROM boarding_status_candidate
), boarding_status_resolved AS (
  SELECT
    sk_transaction_data,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(cd_boarding_status) END AS cd_boarding_status,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(sk_boarding_status) END AS sk_boarding_status_event,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(nk_boarding_status_document_id) END AS nk_boarding_status_document_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(dt_boarding_status_utc) END AS dt_boarding_status_utc,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(dt_boarding_status_recorded_utc) END AS dt_boarding_status_recorded_utc,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) = 1
      THEN 'matched_as_of_query_time'
      ELSE 'ambiguous_latest_timestamp'
    END AS cd_boarding_status_match_status
  FROM boarding_status_ranked
  WHERE
    ni_boarding_status_time_rank = 1
  GROUP BY
    sk_transaction_data
)
SELECT
  s.sk_transaction_data AS sk_transaction_event,
  a.sk_account_latest AS sk_account_latest,
  u.sk_user_latest AS sk_user_latest,
  TO_HEX(
    SHA256(
      TO_UTF8(
        COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(s.cd_channel_normalized), ''),
          LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(s.cd_channel), '')),
          'unknown'
        )
      )
    )
  ) AS sk_channel,
  TO_HEX(SHA256(TO_UTF8(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.cd_response_evaluation), ''), 'unknown')))) AS sk_response_evaluation,
  departure_location.sk_location_latest AS sk_departure_location_latest,
  departure_country.sk_location_latest AS sk_departure_country_location_latest,
  destination_location.sk_location_latest AS sk_destination_location_latest,
  destination_country.sk_location_latest AS sk_destination_country_location_latest,
  s.nk_transaction_document_id AS nk_transaction_document_id,
  s.nk_transaction_id AS nk_transaction_id,
  CASE
    WHEN s.nk_transaction_id IS NULL
    THEN 'missing'
    WHEN STRPOS(s.nk_transaction_id, ',') > 0
    THEN 'comma_delimited'
    ELSE 'single_value'
  END AS cd_transaction_id_format,
  CASE
    WHEN s.nk_transaction_id IS NULL
    THEN 0
    ELSE CAST(CARDINALITY(
      FILTER(
        SPLIT(s.nk_transaction_id, ','),
        transaction_id_component -> NOT NULLIF(TRIM(transaction_id_component), '') IS NULL
      )
    ) AS INTEGER)
  END AS ni_transaction_id_component_count,
  s.nk_request_id AS nk_request_id,
  s.nk_request_transaction_id AS nk_request_transaction_id,
  s.nk_passenger_id AS nk_passenger_id,
  s.nk_account_id AS nk_account_id,
  s.nk_user_id AS nk_user_id,
  CASE
    WHEN s.nk_account_id IS NULL
    THEN 'source_key_missing'
    WHEN a.ni_account_match_count IS NULL
    THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN a.ni_account_match_count = 1
    THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_account_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN s.nk_user_id IS NULL
    THEN 'source_key_missing'
    WHEN u.ni_user_match_count IS NULL
    THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN u.ni_user_match_count = 1
    THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_user_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN s.cd_departure_point IS NULL
    THEN 'source_code_missing'
    WHEN departure_location.ni_location_match_count IS NULL
    THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN departure_location.ni_location_match_count = 1
    THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_departure_location_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN s.cd_departure_country IS NULL
    THEN 'source_code_missing'
    WHEN departure_country.ni_location_match_count IS NULL
    THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN departure_country.ni_location_match_count = 1
    THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_departure_country_location_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN s.cd_destination_point IS NULL
    THEN 'source_code_missing'
    WHEN destination_location.ni_location_match_count IS NULL
    THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN destination_location.ni_location_match_count = 1
    THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_destination_location_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN s.cd_destination_country IS NULL
    THEN 'source_code_missing'
    WHEN destination_country.ni_location_match_count IS NULL
    THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN destination_country.ni_location_match_count = 1
    THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_destination_country_location_match_status,
  s.cd_billing_customer_code AS cd_billing_customer_code,
  s.de_account_name AS de_account_name,
  s.cd_channel AS cd_channel,
  s.cd_channel_normalized AS cd_channel_normalized,
  s.de_channel_name AS de_channel_name,
  s.cd_request_type AS cd_request_type,
  s.cd_response_evaluation AS cd_response_evaluation,
  s.de_response_evaluation AS de_response_evaluation,
  s.is_success AS is_success,
  s.is_chargeable AS is_chargeable,
  s.cd_departure_point AS cd_departure_point,
  s.cd_departure_country AS cd_departure_country,
  s.de_departure_country_name AS de_departure_country_name,
  s.cd_departure_location_type AS cd_departure_location_type,
  s.cd_destination_point AS cd_destination_point,
  s.de_destination_name AS de_destination_name,
  s.cd_destination_country AS cd_destination_country,
  s.cd_destination_location_type AS cd_destination_location_type,
  s.dt_creation_utc AS dt_creation_utc,
  s.dt_transaction_utc AS dt_transaction_utc,
  s.dt_departure_utc AS dt_departure_utc,
  s.dt_destination_arrival_utc AS dt_destination_arrival_utc,
  s.dt_transaction_date AS dt_transaction_date,
  s.dt_partition AS dt_partition,
  1 AS ni_transaction_count,
  CASE WHEN s.is_success = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ni_successful_transaction_count,
  CASE WHEN s.is_chargeable = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ni_chargeable_transaction_count,
  s.ni_response_time_ms AS ni_response_time_ms,
  s.cd_passenger_type AS cd_passenger_type,
  s.de_passenger_type_name AS de_passenger_type_name,
  s.cd_gender AS cd_gender,
  s.de_submitted_gender_name AS de_gender_name,
  s.de_age_group AS de_age_group,
  s.cd_processing_entity_id AS cd_processing_entity_id,
  COALESCE(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(
        TRANSFORM(segment_role.arr_processing_entity_name, v -> NULLIF(TRIM(v), '')),
        v -> NOT v IS NULL
      ),
      ', '
    ),
    ''
  ) AS de_processing_entity_name,
  s.cd_product_code AS cd_product_code,
  s.de_product_name AS de_product_name,
  s.arr_capture_method AS arr_capture_method,
  s.arr_capture_method_name AS arr_capture_method_name,
  s.json_nationalities AS json_nationalities,
  s.json_transits AS json_transits,
  s.json_itinerary_details AS json_itinerary_details,
  s.de_hash_code AS de_hash_code,
  s.de_source_table AS de_source_table,
  s.de_source_file AS de_source_file,
  s.cd_source_event_type AS cd_source_event_type,
  s.dt_source_load_utc AS dt_source_load_utc,
  s.cd_alert AS cd_alert,
  s.de_alert AS de_alert,
  s.source_id AS source_id,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS run_id,
  CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS dt_update_utc,
  s.json_request AS json_request,
  s.cd_request_payload_status AS cd_request_payload_status,
  s.arr_nationality AS arr_nationality,
  s.arr_nationality_name AS arr_nationality_name,
  s.cd_nationality_status AS cd_nationality_status,
  s.cd_nationality_source AS cd_nationality_source,
  s.arr_gender AS arr_gender,
  s.arr_gender_name AS arr_gender_name,
  s.cd_gender_status AS cd_gender_status,
  s.cd_gender_source AS cd_gender_source,
  s.arr_operating_carrier AS arr_operating_carrier,
  s.cd_operating_carrier_status AS cd_operating_carrier_status,
  s.arr_submitted_return_onward_ticket AS arr_submitted_return_onward_ticket,
  s.cd_submitted_ticket_status AS cd_submitted_ticket_status,
  s.arr_request_segment AS arr_request_segment,
  s.cd_itinerary_status AS cd_itinerary_status,
  s.cd_itinerary_time_basis AS cd_itinerary_time_basis,
  segment_role.arr_processing_entity_id AS arr_processing_entity_id,
  segment_role.arr_processing_entity_name AS arr_processing_entity_name,
  segment_role.arr_segment_processing_entity AS arr_segment_processing_entity,
  COALESCE(segment_role.cd_processing_entity_status, 'no_linked_segment') AS cd_processing_entity_status,
  CAST(id_profile.ni_transaction_candidate_count AS BIGINT) AS ni_transaction_id_count,
  CASE
    WHEN s.nk_transaction_id IS NULL
    THEN 'missing_transaction_id'
    WHEN id_profile.ni_transaction_candidate_count = 1
    THEN 'unique'
    ELSE 'duplicate_transaction_id_publication_blocked'
  END AS cd_transaction_uniqueness_status,
  s.cd_residence_country AS cd_residence_country,
  s.de_residence_country_name AS de_residence_country_name,
  s.cd_logged_ticket AS cd_logged_ticket,
  s.de_logged_ticket_name AS de_logged_ticket_name,
  s.cd_logged_ticket_status AS cd_logged_ticket_status,
  s.de_service_name AS de_service_name,
  segment_role.arr_regulation_applicability AS arr_regulation_applicability,
  COALESCE(segment_role.cd_regulation_applicability_status, 'no_linked_segment') AS cd_regulation_applicability_status,
  COALESCE(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(TRANSFORM(s.arr_capture_method, v -> NULLIF(TRIM(v), '')), v -> NOT v IS NULL),
      ', '
    ),
    ''
  ) AS de_capture_method,
  COALESCE(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(TRANSFORM(s.arr_capture_method_name, v -> NULLIF(TRIM(v), '')), v -> NOT v IS NULL),
      ', '
    ),
    ''
  ) AS de_capture_method_name,
  s.de_nationality AS de_nationality,
  s.de_nationality_name AS de_nationality_name,
  s.de_submitted_gender AS de_gender,
  s.de_operating_carrier AS de_operating_carrier,
  s.de_submitted_return_onward_ticket AS de_submitted_return_onward_ticket,
  COALESCE(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(
        TRANSFORM(segment_role.arr_processing_entity_id, v -> NULLIF(TRIM(v), '')),
        v -> NOT v IS NULL
      ),
      ', '
    ),
    ''
  ) AS de_processing_entity_id,
  COALESCE(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(
        TRANSFORM(segment_role.arr_regulation_applicability, v -> NULLIF(TRIM(v), '')),
        v -> NOT v IS NULL
      ),
      ', '
    ),
    ''
  ) AS de_regulation_applicability,
  s.de_gender_name AS de_source_gender_name,
  s.de_processing_entity_name AS de_source_processing_entity_name,
  boarding_status.cd_boarding_status AS cd_boarding_status,
  boarding_status.sk_boarding_status_event AS sk_boarding_status_event,
  boarding_status.nk_boarding_status_document_id AS nk_boarding_status_document_id,
  boarding_status.dt_boarding_status_utc AS dt_boarding_status_utc,
  boarding_status.dt_boarding_status_recorded_utc AS dt_boarding_status_recorded_utc,
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(s.nk_account_id), '') IS NULL
    OR NULLIF(TRIM(s.nk_passenger_id), '') IS NULL
    THEN 'source_key_missing'
    WHEN s.dt_transaction_utc IS NULL
    THEN 'query_time_missing'
    ELSE COALESCE(boarding_status.cd_boarding_status_match_status, 'not_found_as_of_query_time')
  END AS cd_boarding_status_match_status,
  'source_transaction_query_time' AS cd_boarding_status_time_basis
FROM transaction_source AS s
LEFT JOIN boarding_status_resolved AS boarding_status
  ON s.sk_transaction_data = boarding_status.sk_transaction_data
LEFT JOIN transaction_id_profile AS id_profile
  ON s.nk_transaction_id = id_profile.nk_transaction_id
LEFT JOIN segment_applicability AS segment_role
  ON s.sk_transaction_data = segment_role.sk_transaction_event
LEFT JOIN account_latest AS a
  ON s.nk_account_id = a.nk_account_id
LEFT JOIN user_latest AS u
  ON s.nk_user_id = u.nk_user_id
LEFT JOIN location_code_resolver AS departure_location
  ON UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_departure_point)) = departure_location.cd_location_code
LEFT JOIN location_code_resolver AS departure_country
  ON UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_departure_country)) = departure_country.cd_location_code
LEFT JOIN location_code_resolver AS destination_location
  ON UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_destination_point)) = destination_location.cd_location_code
LEFT JOIN location_code_resolver AS destination_country
  ON UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_destination_country)) = destination_country.cd_location_code;

collections.description:
TIM-IDL-F06-01/02/03. Logged segment detail supporting the Data Page and Journey analysis.

One row per valid, non-deleted logged segment document. sk_segment_transaction_event inherits sk_segment_transaction_data and must be unique. nk_segment_transaction_document_id retains the source ID.

Each segment has at most one resolved transaction parent; a transaction can have many segments. Parent resolution uses the candidate-count, passenger and timestamp rules in the SELECT. Ambiguous matches remain flagged rather than selecting an arbitrary parent. Account, user and location lookups also return at most one match.

Ticket, channel, purpose of stay and applicability belong to the logged segment. Segment measures can be summed at unique segment grain.
collections.comments:
Sources: st_account, st_location, st_segment_transaction_data, st_transaction_data, st_user.

Loaded incrementally by data engineering. Replace the affected segment by its technical key. Revisit parent resolution and lookups when their source data changes.

History: current values for retained source events, with current dimension references. CONFORMED errors and deleted records are excluded; warnings and match-status fields remain visible.

Checks: unique technical key, source-row reconciliation, lookup coverage and timestamp consistency. Retain source keys and audit fields for trace-back.

cd_row_signature is an internal join field used by the load. It has no reporting role.

Keep account/user access rules on report and export paths. Request payloads and passenger/document identifiers remain restricted.
collections.selectStatement:
-- TIM-IDL-F06-01/02/03. Logged segment detail supporting the Data Page and Journey analysis.
-- cd_row_signature is handled by the load logic.
WITH transaction_source AS (
  SELECT
    sk_transaction_data,
    nk_transaction_id,
    nk_passenger_id,
    dt_transaction_utc
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_transaction_data
  WHERE
    cd_error IS NULL AND COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
), segment_source AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_segment_transaction_data
  WHERE
    cd_error IS NULL AND COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
), transaction_id_profile AS (
  SELECT
    nk_transaction_id,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS INTEGER) AS ni_transaction_candidate_count,
    MAX(sk_transaction_data) AS sk_single_transaction_event
  FROM transaction_source
  GROUP BY
    nk_transaction_id
), ambiguous_transaction_source AS (
  SELECT
    t.*
  FROM transaction_source AS t
  JOIN transaction_id_profile AS p
    ON t.nk_transaction_id = p.nk_transaction_id
    AND p.ni_transaction_candidate_count > 1
), passenger_timestamp_profile AS (
  SELECT
    s.sk_segment_transaction_data,
    CAST(COUNT(t.sk_transaction_data) AS INTEGER) AS ni_transaction_passenger_timestamp_candidate_count,
    MAX(t.sk_transaction_data) AS sk_passenger_timestamp_transaction_event
  FROM segment_source AS s
  JOIN transaction_id_profile AS p
    ON s.nk_transaction_id = p.nk_transaction_id
    AND p.ni_transaction_candidate_count > 1
  LEFT JOIN ambiguous_transaction_source AS t
    ON s.nk_transaction_id = t.nk_transaction_id
    AND NOT s.nk_passenger_id IS NULL
    AND s.nk_passenger_id = t.nk_passenger_id
    AND NOT s.dt_transaction_utc IS NULL
    AND s.dt_transaction_utc = t.dt_transaction_utc
  GROUP BY
    s.sk_segment_transaction_data
), account_latest AS (
  SELECT
    nk_account_id,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT sk_account) AS INTEGER) AS ni_account_match_count,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sk_account) = 1 THEN MAX(sk_account) ELSE NULL END AS sk_account_latest
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_account
  WHERE
    cd_error IS NULL
    AND is_current = TRUE
    AND COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND NOT nk_account_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    nk_account_id
), user_latest AS (
  SELECT
    nk_user_id,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT sk_user) AS INTEGER) AS ni_user_match_count,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sk_user) = 1 THEN MAX(sk_user) ELSE NULL END AS sk_user_latest
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_user
  WHERE
    cd_error IS NULL
    AND is_current = TRUE
    AND COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND NOT nk_user_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    nk_user_id
), current_location AS (
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    cd_location_code,
    cd_code,
    cd_code2,
    cd_code3,
    cd_code5,
    cd_syscode
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_location
  WHERE
    cd_error IS NULL AND is_current = TRUE AND COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
), location_code_source AS (
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_location_code)) AS cd_location_code
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_location_code), '') IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_code))
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_code), '') IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_code2))
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_code2), '') IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_code3))
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_code3), '') IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_code5))
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_code5), '') IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_syscode))
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_syscode), '') IS NULL
), location_code_resolver AS (
  SELECT
    cd_location_code,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT sk_location) AS INTEGER) AS ni_location_match_count,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sk_location) = 1 THEN MAX(sk_location) ELSE NULL END AS sk_location_latest
  FROM location_code_source
  GROUP BY
    cd_location_code
)
SELECT
  s.sk_segment_transaction_data AS sk_segment_transaction_event,
  CASE
    WHEN p.ni_transaction_candidate_count = 1
    THEN p.sk_single_transaction_event
    WHEN p.ni_transaction_candidate_count > 1
    AND pt.ni_transaction_passenger_timestamp_candidate_count = 1
    THEN pt.sk_passenger_timestamp_transaction_event
    ELSE NULL
  END AS sk_transaction_event,
  a.sk_account_latest AS sk_account_latest,
  u.sk_user_latest AS sk_user_latest,
  TO_HEX(
    SHA256(
      TO_UTF8(
        COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(s.cd_channel_normalized), ''),
          LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(s.cd_channel), '')),
          'unknown'
        )
      )
    )
  ) AS sk_channel,
  TO_HEX(SHA256(TO_UTF8(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.cd_response_evaluation), ''), 'unknown')))) AS sk_response_evaluation,
  TO_HEX(
    SHA256(TO_UTF8(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.cd_segment_response_evaluation), ''), 'unknown')))
  ) AS sk_segment_response_evaluation,
  departure_location.sk_location_latest AS sk_departure_location_latest,
  destination_location.sk_location_latest AS sk_destination_location_latest,
  segment_departure_location.sk_location_latest AS sk_segment_departure_location_latest,
  segment_destination_location.sk_location_latest AS sk_segment_destination_location_latest,
  segment_destination_country.sk_location_latest AS sk_segment_destination_country_location_latest,
  s.nk_segment_transaction_document_id AS nk_segment_transaction_document_id,
  s.nk_transaction_id AS nk_transaction_id,
  CASE
    WHEN s.nk_transaction_id IS NULL
    THEN 'missing'
    WHEN STRPOS(s.nk_transaction_id, ',') > 0
    THEN 'comma_delimited'
    ELSE 'single_value'
  END AS cd_transaction_id_format,
  CASE
    WHEN s.nk_transaction_id IS NULL
    THEN 0
    ELSE CAST(CARDINALITY(
      FILTER(
        SPLIT(s.nk_transaction_id, ','),
        transaction_id_component -> NOT NULLIF(TRIM(transaction_id_component), '') IS NULL
      )
    ) AS INTEGER)
  END AS ni_transaction_id_component_count,
  s.nk_request_id AS nk_request_id,
  s.nk_passenger_id AS nk_passenger_id,
  s.nk_account_id AS nk_account_id,
  s.nk_user_id AS nk_user_id,
  COALESCE(p.ni_transaction_candidate_count, 0) AS ni_transaction_candidate_count,
  COALESCE(pt.ni_transaction_passenger_timestamp_candidate_count, 0) AS ni_transaction_passenger_timestamp_candidate_count,
  CASE
    WHEN s.nk_transaction_id IS NULL
    THEN 'transaction_key_missing'
    WHEN p.ni_transaction_candidate_count IS NULL
    THEN 'transaction_not_found'
    WHEN p.ni_transaction_candidate_count = 1
    THEN 'transaction_id_unique'
    WHEN pt.ni_transaction_passenger_timestamp_candidate_count = 1
    THEN 'passenger_timestamp_unique'
    ELSE 'transaction_ambiguous'
  END AS cd_transaction_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN s.nk_account_id IS NULL
    THEN 'source_key_missing'
    WHEN a.ni_account_match_count IS NULL
    THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN a.ni_account_match_count = 1
    THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_account_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN s.nk_user_id IS NULL
    THEN 'source_key_missing'
    WHEN u.ni_user_match_count IS NULL
    THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN u.ni_user_match_count = 1
    THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_user_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN s.cd_departure_point IS NULL
    THEN 'source_code_missing'
    WHEN departure_location.ni_location_match_count IS NULL
    THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN departure_location.ni_location_match_count = 1
    THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_departure_location_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN s.cd_destination_point IS NULL
    THEN 'source_code_missing'
    WHEN destination_location.ni_location_match_count IS NULL
    THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN destination_location.ni_location_match_count = 1
    THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_destination_location_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN s.cd_segment_departure_point IS NULL
    THEN 'source_code_missing'
    WHEN segment_departure_location.ni_location_match_count IS NULL
    THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN segment_departure_location.ni_location_match_count = 1
    THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_segment_departure_location_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN s.cd_segment_destination_point IS NULL
    THEN 'source_code_missing'
    WHEN segment_destination_location.ni_location_match_count IS NULL
    THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN segment_destination_location.ni_location_match_count = 1
    THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_segment_destination_location_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN s.cd_segment_destination_country IS NULL
    THEN 'source_code_missing'
    WHEN segment_destination_country.ni_location_match_count IS NULL
    THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN segment_destination_country.ni_location_match_count = 1
    THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_segment_destination_country_location_match_status,
  s.cd_channel AS cd_channel,
  s.cd_channel_normalized AS cd_channel_normalized,
  s.de_channel_name AS de_channel_name,
  s.cd_request_type AS cd_request_type,
  s.cd_response_evaluation AS cd_response_evaluation,
  s.de_response_evaluation AS de_response_evaluation,
  s.cd_segment_response_evaluation AS cd_segment_response_evaluation,
  s.de_segment_response_evaluation AS de_segment_response_evaluation,
  s.is_success AS is_success,
  s.is_chargeable AS is_chargeable,
  s.is_first_leg AS is_first_leg,
  s.is_last_leg AS is_last_leg,
  s.is_first_airport_leg AS is_first_airport_leg,
  s.is_last_airport_leg AS is_last_airport_leg,
  s.cd_departure_point AS cd_departure_point,
  s.cd_destination_point AS cd_destination_point,
  s.cd_segment_departure_point AS cd_segment_departure_point,
  s.de_segment_departure_name AS de_segment_departure_name,
  s.cd_segment_departure_location_type AS cd_segment_departure_location_type,
  s.nd_segment_departure_latitude AS nd_segment_departure_latitude,
  s.nd_segment_departure_longitude AS nd_segment_departure_longitude,
  s.cd_segment_destination_point AS cd_segment_destination_point,
  s.de_segment_destination_name AS de_segment_destination_name,
  s.cd_segment_destination_country AS cd_segment_destination_country,
  s.de_segment_destination_country_name AS de_segment_destination_country_name,
  s.cd_segment_destination_location_type AS cd_segment_destination_location_type,
  s.nd_segment_destination_latitude AS nd_segment_destination_latitude,
  s.nd_segment_destination_longitude AS nd_segment_destination_longitude,
  s.dt_creation_utc AS dt_creation_utc,
  s.dt_transaction_utc AS dt_transaction_utc,
  s.dt_departure_utc AS dt_departure_utc,
  s.dt_destination_arrival_utc AS dt_destination_arrival_utc,
  s.dt_segment_departure_utc AS dt_segment_departure_utc,
  s.dt_segment_destination_arrival_utc AS dt_segment_destination_arrival_utc,
  s.dt_transaction_date AS dt_transaction_date,
  s.dt_partition AS dt_partition,
  1 AS ni_segment_transaction_count,
  CASE WHEN s.is_success = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ni_successful_segment_transaction_count,
  CASE WHEN s.is_chargeable = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ni_chargeable_segment_transaction_count,
  s.ni_response_time_ms AS ni_response_time_ms,
  s.ni_transit_waiting_time AS ni_transit_waiting_time,
  s.cd_stay_type AS cd_stay_type,
  s.cd_regulation_applicability AS cd_regulation_applicability,
  s.cd_passenger_type AS cd_passenger_type,
  s.de_passenger_type_name AS de_passenger_type_name,
  s.cd_gender AS cd_gender,
  s.de_gender_name AS de_gender_name,
  s.de_age_group AS de_age_group,
  s.cd_processing_entity_id AS cd_processing_entity_id,
  s.de_processing_entity_name AS de_processing_entity_name,
  s.json_nationalities AS json_nationalities,
  s.json_rule_sets_and_response AS json_rule_sets_and_response,
  s.json_itinerary_details AS json_itinerary_details,
  s.de_hash_code AS de_hash_code,
  s.de_source_table AS de_source_table,
  s.de_source_file AS de_source_file,
  s.cd_source_event_type AS cd_source_event_type,
  s.dt_source_load_utc AS dt_source_load_utc,
  s.cd_alert AS cd_alert,
  s.de_alert AS de_alert,
  s.source_id AS source_id,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS run_id,
  CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS dt_update_utc,
  s.cd_logged_ticket AS cd_logged_ticket,
  s.de_logged_ticket_name AS de_logged_ticket_name,
  s.cd_logged_ticket_status AS cd_logged_ticket_status
FROM segment_source AS s
LEFT JOIN transaction_id_profile AS p
  ON s.nk_transaction_id = p.nk_transaction_id
LEFT JOIN passenger_timestamp_profile AS pt
  ON s.sk_segment_transaction_data = pt.sk_segment_transaction_data
LEFT JOIN account_latest AS a
  ON s.nk_account_id = a.nk_account_id
LEFT JOIN user_latest AS u
  ON s.nk_user_id = u.nk_user_id
LEFT JOIN location_code_resolver AS departure_location
  ON UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_departure_point)) = departure_location.cd_location_code
LEFT JOIN location_code_resolver AS destination_location
  ON UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_destination_point)) = destination_location.cd_location_code
LEFT JOIN location_code_resolver AS segment_departure_location
  ON UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_segment_departure_point)) = segment_departure_location.cd_location_code
LEFT JOIN location_code_resolver AS segment_destination_location
  ON UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_segment_destination_point)) = segment_destination_location.cd_location_code
LEFT JOIN location_code_resolver AS segment_destination_country
  ON UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_segment_destination_country)) = segment_destination_country.cd_location_code;
