collections.description:
CONSUMPTION fact_boarding_status_event at one eligible Boarding Status source document per event row.      (18 sep 26 - need more detail here )
 
18 sep 2026  NOTE:  This is currently a standalone table.   Its not currently being used in reports  for 04 05 06
collections.comments:
Purpose: CONSUMPTION Boarding Status fact at one eligible st_boarding_status document per row. Codes are independent labels with no implied lifecycle or terminal-state sequence. The source transactionId is currently an orphan identifier and therefore does not resolve to fact_transaction_event unless and until the source owner confirms and implements an authoritative end-to-end identifier contract.
Grain: one eligible Boarding Status source document per event row.
Source and extraction: conformed.st_boarding_status plus current CONFORMED st_account, st_user, and st_boarding_status_code definition candidates
Keys and cardinality: Technical primary key: sk_boarding_status_event. Business uniqueness: nk_boarding_status_document_id. DIM sk_ columns are foreign keys, not FACT PK components. The event timestamp is a business-time attribute; adding it to an already unique source-document key would be redundant and would change the agreed grain.
History/SCD: Event history is append/rebuild-safe at the declared source-document grain. Late or corrected eligible CONFORMED rows replace the same deterministic event key.
Soft deletes and absence: The snapshot/load excludes explicitly deleted or ineligible CONFORMED rows. Production reruns must use an atomic dbt rebuild/swap; absence alone is not a new delete signal.
Load, corrections, and reruns: Current portable SQL uses a full snapshot DELETE/INSERT template. The Hackolade As Select Statement contains the canonical transformation extracted from model_package/sql/08_consumption_fact_load_sql.sql. Production dbt must rebuild/swap atomically so readers never observe the gap; run_id must be stamped by orchestration.
Data quality: cd_error/de_error and cd_alert/de_alert remain visible where modelled; key, cast, timestamp, domain, and relationship coverage are validated before CONSUMPTION publication.
Sensitive data: No new sensitive attribute is introduced by this model object; source-sensitive fields remain subject to access review.
Known limitation/assumption: The Boarding Status transactionId is currently independent from transaction_data.transaction_id. No transaction FACT key is asserted unless and until the source owner confirms and implements an authoritative end-to-end identifier contract.
Governance: shared structure, key, grain, SCD, or publication changes require I&D data-modeler and data-engineering review.
collections.selectStatement:
WITH boarding_source AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM st_boarding_status
  WHERE cd_error IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(is_deleted, false) = false
    AND dt_boarding_status_utc IS NOT NULL
),
account_latest AS (
  SELECT
    nk_account_id,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT sk_account) AS integer) AS ni_account_match_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sk_account) = 1 THEN MAX(sk_account)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS sk_account_latest
  FROM st_account
  WHERE cd_error IS NULL
    AND is_current = true
    AND COALESCE(is_deleted, false) = false
    AND nk_account_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY nk_account_id
),
user_latest AS (
  SELECT
    nk_user_id,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT sk_user) AS integer) AS ni_user_match_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sk_user) = 1 THEN MAX(sk_user)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS sk_user_latest
  FROM st_user
  WHERE cd_error IS NULL
    AND is_current = true
    AND COALESCE(is_deleted, false) = false
    AND nk_user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY nk_user_id
),
boarding_status_latest AS (
  SELECT
    cd_boarding_status,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT nk_parameter_value_document_id) AS integer)
      AS ni_boarding_status_dimension_candidate_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT nk_parameter_value_document_id) = 1
        THEN TO_HEX(
          SHA256(
            TO_UTF8('BOARDINGSTATUS|' || cd_boarding_status)
          )
        )
      ELSE NULL
    END AS sk_boarding_status_latest
  FROM st_boarding_status_code
  WHERE cd_error IS NULL
    AND cd_parameter_identifier = 'BOARDINGSTATUS'
    AND COALESCE(is_deleted, false) = false
    AND is_effective_current = true
    AND cd_boarding_status IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY cd_boarding_status
)
SELECT
  s.sk_boarding_status AS sk_boarding_status_event,
  a.sk_account_latest,
  u.sk_user_latest,
  d.sk_boarding_status_latest,
  s.nk_boarding_status_document_id,
  s.cd_boarding_status_transaction_id,
  s.nk_passenger_id,
  s.nk_account_id,
  s.nk_user_id,
  CASE
    WHEN s.nk_account_id IS NULL THEN 'source_key_missing'
    WHEN a.ni_account_match_count IS NULL THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN a.ni_account_match_count = 1 THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_account_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN s.nk_user_id IS NULL THEN 'source_key_missing'
    WHEN u.ni_user_match_count IS NULL THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN u.ni_user_match_count = 1 THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_user_match_status,
  COALESCE(d.ni_boarding_status_dimension_candidate_count, 0)
    AS ni_boarding_status_dimension_candidate_count,
  CASE
    WHEN s.cd_boarding_status IS NULL THEN 'source_code_missing'
    WHEN d.ni_boarding_status_dimension_candidate_count IS NULL
      THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN d.ni_boarding_status_dimension_candidate_count = 1
      THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_boarding_status_dimension_match_status,
  s.cd_processing_entity,
  s.cd_processing_entity_id,
  s.de_processing_entity_name,
  s.cd_boarding_status,
  s.dt_boarding_status_utc,
  s.dt_boarding_status_date,
  s.dt_partition,
  1 AS ni_boarding_status_event_count,
  s.ni_response_time_ms,
  s.de_source_table,
  s.de_source_file,
  s.de_change_source_table,
  s.de_change_source_file,
  s.cd_source_event_type,
  s.cd_source_record_id,
  s.cd_source_event_id,
  s.dt_source_event_utc,
  s.dt_source_load_utc,
  NULLIF(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(
        ARRAY[
          s.cd_alert,
          CASE
            WHEN s.nk_account_id IS NULL
              THEN 'account_key_missing'
            WHEN a.ni_account_match_count IS NULL
              THEN 'account_not_found'
            WHEN a.ni_account_match_count > 1
              THEN 'account_ambiguous'
          END,
          CASE
            WHEN s.nk_user_id IS NULL
              THEN 'user_key_missing'
            WHEN u.ni_user_match_count IS NULL
              THEN 'user_not_found'
            WHEN u.ni_user_match_count > 1
              THEN 'user_ambiguous'
          END,
          CASE
            WHEN s.cd_boarding_status IS NULL
              THEN 'boarding_status_code_missing'
            WHEN d.ni_boarding_status_dimension_candidate_count IS NULL
              THEN 'boarding_status_definition_not_found'
            WHEN d.ni_boarding_status_dimension_candidate_count > 1
              THEN 'boarding_status_definition_ambiguous'
          END
        ],
        alert_code -> alert_code IS NOT NULL
      ),
      '|'
    ),
    ''
  ) AS cd_alert,
  NULLIF(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(
        ARRAY[
          s.de_alert,
          CASE
            WHEN s.nk_account_id IS NULL
              THEN 'Account identifier is missing; governed RLS must fail closed.'
            WHEN a.ni_account_match_count IS NULL
              THEN 'Account identifier has no current CONFORMED account match.'
            WHEN a.ni_account_match_count > 1
              THEN 'Account identifier has multiple current CONFORMED account matches.'
          END,
          CASE
            WHEN s.nk_user_id IS NULL
              THEN 'User identifier is missing.'
            WHEN u.ni_user_match_count IS NULL
              THEN 'User identifier has no current CONFORMED user match.'
            WHEN u.ni_user_match_count > 1
              THEN 'User identifier has multiple current CONFORMED user matches.'
          END,
          CASE
            WHEN s.cd_boarding_status IS NULL
              THEN 'Boarding Status source code is missing; the current description cannot be resolved.'
            WHEN d.ni_boarding_status_dimension_candidate_count IS NULL
              THEN 'Boarding Status code has no current dim_boarding_status_latest match.'
            WHEN d.ni_boarding_status_dimension_candidate_count > 1
              THEN 'Boarding Status code has multiple current dimension candidates.'
          END
        ],
        alert_text -> alert_text IS NOT NULL
      ),
      ' | '
    ),
    ''
  ) AS de_alert,
  s.source_id,
  CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS run_id,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_update_utc
FROM boarding_source s
LEFT JOIN account_latest a
  ON s.nk_account_id = a.nk_account_id
LEFT JOIN user_latest u
  ON s.nk_user_id = u.nk_user_id
LEFT JOIN boarding_status_latest d
  ON UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(s.cd_boarding_status), ''))
    = d.cd_boarding_status

collections.collectionName: To be deleted by Vini - mart_journey_daily_base
collections.description:
Renamed from mart_journey_daily_base

CONSUMPTION mart_journey_daily_base at one accumulated journey row per account and passenger across all eligible transaction FACT history.
collections.comments:
Purpose: Restricted CONSUMPTION journey base for Executive Overview range-safety analysis, journey percentiles, and drill-through. It accumulates one current journey row per account and passenger; daily identifies the first-query-date cohort rather than a periodic daily snapshot. Late eligible transactions may change first/final attributes, counts, flags, and partition assignment.
Grain: one accumulated journey row per account and passenger across all eligible transaction FACT history.
Source and extraction: consumption.fact_transaction_event; consumption.fact_segment_transaction_event; consumption.dim_account_latest
Keys and cardinality: Technical primary key: sk_passenger_journey. Logical row uniqueness: nk_account_id, nk_passenger_id. The sk_ is a deterministic physical key; the separate unique tuple documents the business/aggregation grain and must be validated by the dbt load. Role-playing DIM and FACT keys retain their stated analytical roles.
History/SCD: Current accumulated journey state, not a periodic snapshot. A full-history rebuild can change first/final attributes, counts, flags, and dt_partition when late or corrected eligible transaction events arrive.
Soft deletes and absence: The snapshot/load excludes explicitly deleted or ineligible CONFORMED rows. Production reruns must use an atomic dbt rebuild/swap; absence alone is not a new delete signal.
Load, corrections, and reruns: Current portable SQL uses a full snapshot DELETE/INSERT template. The Hackolade As Select Statement contains the canonical transformation extracted from model_package/sql/mart_tables_for_ana_load.sql. Production dbt must rebuild/swap atomically so readers never observe the gap; run_id must be stamped by orchestration.
Data quality: cd_error/de_error and cd_alert/de_alert remain visible where modelled; key, cast, timestamp, domain, and relationship coverage are validated before CONSUMPTION publication.
Sensitive data: nk_passenger_id and nk_user_id are pseudonymous identifiers. Restrict direct access and export; external users must use the governed semantic model with fail-closed account RLS.
Known limitation/assumption: Governance exception pending: mart_ naming is not yet listed in the IATA table-prefix standard, and this CONSUMPTION object reads FACT/DIM objects rather than sourcing directly from CONFORMED. The 24-hour observation window is provisional. This is an accumulated first-query cohort, not a periodic daily snapshot, and it cannot recreate an arbitrary historical final state after later queries arrive.
Governance: shared structure, key, grain, SCD, or publication changes require I&D data-modeler and data-engineering review.
collections.selectStatement:
WITH
params AS (
  SELECT CAST(24 AS integer) AS ni_range_safety_window_hour
),
processing_entity_account_resolver AS (
  -- Fail closed if the latest account object is not unique by natural key.
  SELECT
    nk_account_id AS cd_processing_entity_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sk_account) = 1 THEN MAX(sk_account)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS sk_processing_entity_account_latest
  FROM dim_account_latest
  WHERE is_current = true
    AND nk_account_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY nk_account_id
),
transaction_source AS (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    processing_entity.sk_processing_entity_account_latest
  FROM fact_transaction_event f
  LEFT JOIN processing_entity_account_resolver processing_entity
    ON f.cd_processing_entity_id = processing_entity.cd_processing_entity_id
  WHERE f.nk_passenger_id IS NOT NULL
    AND f.nk_account_id IS NOT NULL
),
transaction_ordered AS (
  SELECT
    t.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY nk_account_id, nk_passenger_id
      ORDER BY
        dt_transaction_utc ASC NULLS LAST,
        nk_transaction_id ASC NULLS LAST,
        sk_transaction_event ASC
    ) AS ni_query_order_ascending,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY nk_account_id, nk_passenger_id
      ORDER BY
        dt_transaction_utc DESC NULLS LAST,
        nk_transaction_id DESC NULLS LAST,
        sk_transaction_event DESC
    ) AS ni_query_order_descending,
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY nk_account_id, nk_passenger_id
    ) AS ni_query_count,
    MIN(dt_transaction_utc) OVER (
      PARTITION BY nk_account_id, nk_passenger_id
    ) AS dt_first_query_utc,
    MAX(dt_transaction_utc) OVER (
      PARTITION BY nk_account_id, nk_passenger_id
    ) AS dt_last_query_utc
  FROM transaction_source t
),
first_transaction AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM transaction_ordered
  WHERE ni_query_order_ascending = 1
),
final_transaction AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM transaction_ordered
  WHERE ni_query_order_descending = 1
),
journey_metric AS (
  SELECT
    o.nk_account_id,
    o.nk_passenger_id,
    MAX(o.ni_query_count) AS ni_query_count,
    MAX(o.dt_first_query_utc) AS dt_first_query_utc,
    MAX(o.dt_last_query_utc) AS dt_last_query_utc,
    COUNT_IF(
      o.ni_query_order_descending > 1
      AND o.cd_response_evaluation = 'ok_to_board'
    ) AS ni_prior_ok_query_count,
    COUNT_IF(
      o.cd_response_evaluation IN ('conditional', 'not_ok_to_board')
      AND o.dt_transaction_utc <= date_add(
        'hour',
        p.ni_range_safety_window_hour,
        o.dt_first_query_utc
      )
    ) AS ni_conditional_or_not_ok_within_window_count,
    COUNT_IF(o.cd_alert IS NOT NULL) AS ni_source_alert_query_count
  FROM transaction_ordered o
  CROSS JOIN params p
  GROUP BY
    o.nk_account_id,
    o.nk_passenger_id
),
stay_type_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    t.nk_account_id,
    t.nk_passenger_id,
    s.sk_segment_transaction_event,
    s.cd_stay_type,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY t.nk_account_id, t.nk_passenger_id
      ORDER BY
        t.dt_transaction_utc DESC NULLS LAST,
        s.dt_segment_destination_arrival_utc DESC NULLS LAST,
        s.sk_segment_transaction_event DESC
    ) AS ni_stay_type_order
  FROM fact_segment_transaction_event s
  INNER JOIN transaction_source t
    ON s.sk_transaction_event = t.sk_transaction_event
  WHERE s.sk_transaction_event IS NOT NULL
    AND s.is_last_airport_leg = true
),
stay_type AS (
  SELECT
    nk_account_id,
    nk_passenger_id,
    sk_segment_transaction_event,
    cd_stay_type
  FROM stay_type_ranked
  WHERE ni_stay_type_order = 1
)
SELECT
  to_hex(sha256(to_utf8(json_format(CAST(ARRAY[
    f.nk_account_id,
    f.nk_passenger_id
  ] AS JSON))))) AS sk_passenger_journey,
  f.nk_passenger_id,
  f.nk_account_id,
  f.sk_transaction_event AS sk_first_transaction_event,
  final.sk_transaction_event AS sk_final_transaction_event,
  stay.sk_segment_transaction_event
    AS sk_stay_type_segment_transaction_event,
  f.sk_account_latest,
  f.sk_processing_entity_account_latest,
  f.sk_user_latest,
  f.sk_channel,
  f.sk_response_evaluation AS sk_first_response_evaluation,
  final.sk_response_evaluation AS sk_final_response_evaluation,
  f.sk_destination_country_location_latest,
  f.cd_processing_entity_id,
  f.nk_user_id,
  f.cd_channel,
  f.cd_channel_normalized,
  CAST(metric.dt_first_query_utc AS date) AS dt_journey_date,
  metric.dt_first_query_utc,
  metric.dt_last_query_utc,
  date_add(
    'hour',
    p.ni_range_safety_window_hour,
    metric.dt_first_query_utc
  ) AS dt_kpi_observation_complete_utc,
  metric.ni_query_count,
  f.cd_destination_country,
  f.cd_departure_country,
  f.cd_destination_point AS cd_first_destination_point,
  f.cd_departure_point AS cd_first_departure_point,
  f.cd_passenger_type,
  f.de_age_group,
  f.cd_gender,
  f.cd_product_code,
  f.arr_capture_method,
  stay.cd_stay_type,
  f.cd_response_evaluation AS cd_first_response_evaluation,
  final.cd_response_evaluation AS cd_final_response_evaluation,
  CASE
    WHEN final.cd_response_evaluation = 'ok_to_board'
      AND metric.ni_query_count = 1
      THEN 'ok_in_1'
    WHEN final.cd_response_evaluation = 'ok_to_board'
      AND metric.ni_query_count = 2
      THEN 'ok_in_2'
    WHEN final.cd_response_evaluation = 'ok_to_board'
      AND metric.ni_query_count >= 3
      THEN 'ok_in_3_plus'
    WHEN final.cd_response_evaluation = 'conditional'
      AND metric.ni_prior_ok_query_count = 0
      THEN 'conditional_final'
    WHEN final.cd_response_evaluation = 'not_ok_to_board'
      AND metric.ni_prior_ok_query_count = 0
      THEN 'not_ok_final'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS cd_final_evaluation_bucket,
  metric.ni_prior_ok_query_count,
  metric.ni_conditional_or_not_ok_within_window_count,
  COALESCE(
    f.cd_response_evaluation = 'ok_to_board'
    AND metric.ni_conditional_or_not_ok_within_window_count = 0,
    false
  ) AS is_first_time_ok,
  COALESCE(
    final.cd_response_evaluation = 'conditional'
    AND metric.ni_prior_ok_query_count = 0,
    false
  ) AS is_conditional_final,
  COALESCE(
    final.cd_response_evaluation = 'not_ok_to_board'
    AND metric.ni_prior_ok_query_count = 0,
    false
  ) AS is_not_ok_final,
  metric.ni_query_count > 10 AS is_passenger_id_reuse_alert,
  f.sk_account_latest IS NULL AS is_account_unresolved,
  f.sk_processing_entity_account_latest IS NULL
    AS is_processing_entity_account_unresolved,
  f.sk_user_latest IS NULL AS is_user_unresolved,
  f.sk_destination_country_location_latest IS NULL
    AS is_destination_country_location_unresolved,
  stay.cd_stay_type IS NULL AS is_stay_type_missing,
  metric.ni_source_alert_query_count,
  p.ni_range_safety_window_hour,
  date_format(metric.dt_first_query_utc, '%Y%m%d') AS dt_partition,
  'fact_transaction_event+fact_segment_transaction_event+dim_account_latest'
    AS source_id,
  CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS run_id,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_update_utc
FROM first_transaction f
INNER JOIN final_transaction final
  ON f.nk_account_id = final.nk_account_id
 AND f.nk_passenger_id = final.nk_passenger_id
INNER JOIN journey_metric metric
  ON f.nk_account_id = metric.nk_account_id
 AND f.nk_passenger_id = metric.nk_passenger_id
CROSS JOIN params p
LEFT JOIN stay_type stay
  ON f.nk_account_id = stay.nk_account_id
 AND f.nk_passenger_id = stay.nk_passenger_id

renamed from mart_agg_exec_daily
CONSUMPTION mart_agg_exec_daily at one row per 16-attribute aggregate tuple: journey date; account, processing-entity, user, channel, destination-country, first-response, and final-response role keys; account, processing-entity, and user identifiers; normalized channel; stay type; final-evaluation bucket; and first/final response codes.
collections.comments:
Purpose: Import-friendly CONSUMPTION daily aggregate for the Power BI Executive Overview. Measures are additive except ni_range_safety_window_hour, which is configuration. Outcome counts remain provisional and must not drive TIM-IDL-F03 cards until the selected-end/as-of range-safety rule is approved.
Grain: one row per 16-attribute aggregate tuple: journey date; account, processing-entity, user, channel, destination-country, first-response, and final-response role keys; account, processing-entity, and user identifiers; normalized channel; stay type; final-evaluation bucket; and first/final response codes.
Source and extraction: consumption.mart_journey_daily_base
Keys and cardinality: Technical primary key: sk_executive_overview_daily_aggregate. Logical row uniqueness: dt_journey_date, sk_account_latest, sk_processing_entity_account_latest, sk_user_latest, sk_channel, sk_destination_country_location_latest, sk_first_response_evaluation, sk_final_response_evaluation, nk_account_id, cd_processing_entity_id, nk_user_id, cd_channel_normalized, cd_stay_type, cd_final_evaluation_bucket, cd_first_response_evaluation, cd_final_response_evaluation. The sk_ is a deterministic physical key; the separate unique tuple documents the business/aggregation grain and must be validated by the dbt load. Role-playing DIM and FACT keys retain their stated analytical roles.
History/SCD: Current daily aggregate rebuilt from mart_journey_daily_base. It is not Type-2 history and cannot reconstruct a prior final journey state after later events arrive.
Soft deletes and absence: The snapshot/load excludes explicitly deleted or ineligible CONFORMED rows. Production reruns must use an atomic dbt rebuild/swap; absence alone is not a new delete signal.
Load, corrections, and reruns: Current portable SQL uses a full snapshot DELETE/INSERT template. The Hackolade As Select Statement contains the canonical transformation extracted from model_package/sql/mart_tables_for_ana_load.sql. Production dbt must rebuild/swap atomically so readers never observe the gap; run_id must be stamped by orchestration.
Data quality: cd_error/de_error and cd_alert/de_alert remain visible where modelled; key, cast, timestamp, domain, and relationship coverage are validated before CONSUMPTION publication.
Sensitive data: Natural account, processing-entity, and user identifiers are audit/slicer attributes, not entitlement keys; hide or restrict them in external models and enforce RLS only through sk_account_latest.
Known limitation/assumption: Governance exception pending: mart_ naming and the MART-to-MART dependency require I&D data-modeler approval. Outcome-count columns are provisional and must remain hidden from TIM-IDL-F03 cards until the selected-end/as-of range-safety rule is approved. ni_range_safety_window_hour is configuration: Power BI must use MAX or SELECTEDVALUE, never SUM.
Governance: shared structure, key, grain, SCD, or publication changes require I&D data-modeler and data-engineering review.
collections.selectStatement:
WITH journey_aggregate AS (
  SELECT
    dt_journey_date,
    sk_account_latest,
    sk_processing_entity_account_latest,
    sk_user_latest,
    sk_channel,
    sk_destination_country_location_latest,
    sk_first_response_evaluation,
    sk_final_response_evaluation,
    nk_account_id,
    cd_processing_entity_id,
    nk_user_id,
    cd_channel_normalized,
    cd_stay_type,
    cd_final_evaluation_bucket,
    cd_first_response_evaluation,
    cd_final_response_evaluation,
    COUNT(*) AS ni_journey_count,
    SUM(ni_query_count) AS ni_query_count,
    COUNT_IF(is_first_time_ok) AS ni_first_time_ok_journey_count,
    COUNT_IF(is_conditional_final) AS ni_conditional_journey_count,
    COUNT_IF(is_not_ok_final) AS ni_not_ok_journey_count,
    COUNT_IF(cd_final_evaluation_bucket = 'ok_in_1')
      AS ni_ok_in_1_journey_count,
    COUNT_IF(cd_final_evaluation_bucket = 'ok_in_2')
      AS ni_ok_in_2_journey_count,
    COUNT_IF(cd_final_evaluation_bucket = 'ok_in_3_plus')
      AS ni_ok_in_3_plus_journey_count,
    COUNT_IF(is_passenger_id_reuse_alert)
      AS ni_passenger_id_reuse_alert_journey_count,
    COUNT_IF(ni_source_alert_query_count > 0)
      AS ni_source_alert_journey_count,
    COUNT_IF(is_account_unresolved)
      AS ni_unresolved_account_journey_count,
    COUNT_IF(is_processing_entity_account_unresolved)
      AS ni_unresolved_processing_entity_account_journey_count,
    COUNT_IF(is_user_unresolved)
      AS ni_unresolved_user_journey_count,
    COUNT_IF(is_destination_country_location_unresolved)
      AS ni_unresolved_destination_country_location_journey_count,
    COUNT_IF(is_stay_type_missing)
      AS ni_missing_stay_type_journey_count,
    MAX(ni_range_safety_window_hour) AS ni_range_safety_window_hour
  FROM mart_journey_daily_base
  GROUP BY
    dt_journey_date,
    sk_account_latest,
    sk_processing_entity_account_latest,
    sk_user_latest,
    sk_channel,
    sk_destination_country_location_latest,
    sk_first_response_evaluation,
    sk_final_response_evaluation,
    nk_account_id,
    cd_processing_entity_id,
    nk_user_id,
    cd_channel_normalized,
    cd_stay_type,
    cd_final_evaluation_bucket,
    cd_first_response_evaluation,
    cd_final_response_evaluation
)
SELECT
  to_hex(sha256(to_utf8(json_format(CAST(ARRAY[
    CAST(dt_journey_date AS varchar),
    sk_account_latest,
    sk_processing_entity_account_latest,
    sk_user_latest,
    sk_channel,
    sk_destination_country_location_latest,
    sk_first_response_evaluation,
    sk_final_response_evaluation,
    nk_account_id,
    cd_processing_entity_id,
    nk_user_id,
    cd_channel_normalized,
    cd_stay_type,
    cd_final_evaluation_bucket,
    cd_first_response_evaluation,
    cd_final_response_evaluation
  ] AS JSON))))) AS sk_executive_overview_daily_aggregate,
  dt_journey_date,
  sk_account_latest,
  sk_processing_entity_account_latest,
  sk_user_latest,
  sk_channel,
  sk_destination_country_location_latest,
  sk_first_response_evaluation,
  sk_final_response_evaluation,
  nk_account_id,
  cd_processing_entity_id,
  nk_user_id,
  cd_channel_normalized,
  cd_stay_type,
  cd_final_evaluation_bucket,
  cd_first_response_evaluation,
  cd_final_response_evaluation,
  ni_journey_count,
  ni_query_count,
  ni_first_time_ok_journey_count,
  ni_conditional_journey_count,
  ni_not_ok_journey_count,
  ni_ok_in_1_journey_count,
  ni_ok_in_2_journey_count,
  ni_ok_in_3_plus_journey_count,
  ni_passenger_id_reuse_alert_journey_count,
  ni_source_alert_journey_count,
  ni_unresolved_account_journey_count,
  ni_unresolved_processing_entity_account_journey_count,
  ni_unresolved_user_journey_count,
  ni_unresolved_destination_country_location_journey_count,
  ni_missing_stay_type_journey_count,
  ni_range_safety_window_hour,
  date_format(dt_journey_date, '%Y%m%d') AS dt_partition,
  'mart_journey_daily_base' AS source_id,
  CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS run_id,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_update_utc
FROM journey_aggregate

CONSUMPTION fact_transaction_event at one eligible transaction source document per event row.
collections.comments:
Purpose: CONSUMPTION event fact sourced only from valid CONFORMED ST rows. Source-document grain is preserved, nullable dimension/parent keys expose unresolved relationships, and match-status fields make coverage visible. The deterministic sk_ event key is the technical primary key; event timestamps describe business time and are not appended to a key when the source-document grain is already unique.
Grain: one eligible transaction source document per event row.
Source and extraction: conformed.st_transaction_data plus current conformed dimension candidates
Keys and cardinality: Technical primary key: sk_transaction_event. Business uniqueness: nk_transaction_document_id. DIM sk_ columns are foreign keys, not FACT PK components. The event timestamp is a business-time attribute; adding it to an already unique source-document key would be redundant and would change the agreed grain.
History/SCD: Event history is append/rebuild-safe at the declared source-document grain. Late or corrected eligible CONFORMED rows replace the same deterministic event key.
Soft deletes and absence: The snapshot/load excludes explicitly deleted or ineligible CONFORMED rows. Production reruns must use an atomic dbt rebuild/swap; absence alone is not a new delete signal.
Load, corrections, and reruns: Current portable SQL uses a full snapshot DELETE/INSERT template. The Hackolade As Select Statement contains the canonical transformation extracted from model_package/sql/08_consumption_fact_load_sql.sql. Production dbt must rebuild/swap atomically so readers never observe the gap; run_id must be stamped by orchestration.
Data quality: cd_error/de_error and cd_alert/de_alert remain visible where modelled; key, cast, timestamp, domain, and relationship coverage are validated before CONSUMPTION publication.
Sensitive data: No new sensitive attribute is introduced by this model object; source-sensitive fields remain subject to access review.
Known limitation/assumption: No additional approved limitation.
Governance: shared structure, key, grain, SCD, or publication changes require I&D data-modeler and data-engineering review.
collections.selectStatement:
WITH transaction_source AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM st_transaction_data
  WHERE cd_error IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(is_deleted, false) = false
),
account_latest AS (
  SELECT
    nk_account_id,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT sk_account) AS integer) AS ni_account_match_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sk_account) = 1 THEN MAX(sk_account)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS sk_account_latest
  FROM st_account
  WHERE cd_error IS NULL
    AND is_current = true
    AND COALESCE(is_deleted, false) = false
    AND nk_account_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY nk_account_id
),
user_latest AS (
  SELECT
    nk_user_id,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT sk_user) AS integer) AS ni_user_match_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sk_user) = 1 THEN MAX(sk_user)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS sk_user_latest
  FROM st_user
  WHERE cd_error IS NULL
    AND is_current = true
    AND COALESCE(is_deleted, false) = false
    AND nk_user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY nk_user_id
),
current_location AS (
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    cd_location_code,
    cd_code,
    cd_code2,
    cd_code3,
    cd_code5,
    cd_syscode
  FROM st_location
  WHERE cd_error IS NULL
    AND is_current = true
    AND COALESCE(is_deleted, false) = false
),
location_code_source AS (
  SELECT sk_location, UPPER(TRIM(cd_location_code)) AS cd_location_code
  FROM current_location WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(cd_location_code), '') IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sk_location, UPPER(TRIM(cd_code))
  FROM current_location WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(cd_code), '') IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sk_location, UPPER(TRIM(cd_code2))
  FROM current_location WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(cd_code2), '') IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sk_location, UPPER(TRIM(cd_code3))
  FROM current_location WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(cd_code3), '') IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sk_location, UPPER(TRIM(cd_code5))
  FROM current_location WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(cd_code5), '') IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sk_location, UPPER(TRIM(cd_syscode))
  FROM current_location WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(cd_syscode), '') IS NOT NULL
),
location_code_resolver AS (
  SELECT
    cd_location_code,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT sk_location) AS integer) AS ni_location_match_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sk_location) = 1 THEN MAX(sk_location)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS sk_location_latest
  FROM location_code_source
  GROUP BY cd_location_code
)
SELECT
  s.sk_transaction_data AS sk_transaction_event,
  a.sk_account_latest,
  u.sk_user_latest,
  to_hex(sha256(to_utf8(
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(s.cd_channel_normalized), ''),
      LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(s.cd_channel), '')),
      'unknown'
    )
  ))) AS sk_channel,
  to_hex(sha256(to_utf8(
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.cd_response_evaluation), ''), 'unknown')
  ))) AS sk_response_evaluation,
  departure_location.sk_location_latest AS sk_departure_location_latest,
  departure_country.sk_location_latest AS sk_departure_country_location_latest,
  destination_location.sk_location_latest AS sk_destination_location_latest,
  destination_country.sk_location_latest AS sk_destination_country_location_latest,
  s.nk_transaction_document_id,
  s.nk_transaction_id,
  CASE
    WHEN s.nk_transaction_id IS NULL THEN 'missing'
    WHEN STRPOS(s.nk_transaction_id, ',') > 0 THEN 'comma_delimited'
    ELSE 'single_value'
  END AS cd_transaction_id_format,
  CASE
    WHEN s.nk_transaction_id IS NULL THEN 0
    ELSE CAST(
      CARDINALITY(
        FILTER(
          SPLIT(s.nk_transaction_id, ','),
          transaction_id_component ->
            NULLIF(TRIM(transaction_id_component), '') IS NOT NULL
        )
      )
      AS integer
    )
  END AS ni_transaction_id_component_count,
  s.nk_request_id,
  s.nk_request_transaction_id,
  s.nk_passenger_id,
  s.nk_account_id,
  s.nk_user_id,
  CASE
    WHEN s.nk_account_id IS NULL THEN 'source_key_missing'
    WHEN a.ni_account_match_count IS NULL THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN a.ni_account_match_count = 1 THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_account_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN s.nk_user_id IS NULL THEN 'source_key_missing'
    WHEN u.ni_user_match_count IS NULL THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN u.ni_user_match_count = 1 THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_user_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN s.cd_departure_point IS NULL THEN 'source_code_missing'
    WHEN departure_location.ni_location_match_count IS NULL THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN departure_location.ni_location_match_count = 1 THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_departure_location_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN s.cd_departure_country IS NULL THEN 'source_code_missing'
    WHEN departure_country.ni_location_match_count IS NULL THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN departure_country.ni_location_match_count = 1 THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_departure_country_location_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN s.cd_destination_point IS NULL THEN 'source_code_missing'
    WHEN destination_location.ni_location_match_count IS NULL THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN destination_location.ni_location_match_count = 1 THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_destination_location_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN s.cd_destination_country IS NULL THEN 'source_code_missing'
    WHEN destination_country.ni_location_match_count IS NULL THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN destination_country.ni_location_match_count = 1 THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_destination_country_location_match_status,
  s.cd_billing_customer_code,
  s.de_account_name,
  s.cd_channel,
  s.cd_channel_normalized,
  s.de_channel_name,
  s.cd_request_type,
  s.cd_response_evaluation,
  s.de_response_evaluation,
  s.is_success,
  s.is_chargeable,
  s.cd_departure_point,
  s.cd_departure_country,
  s.de_departure_country_name,
  s.cd_departure_location_type,
  s.cd_destination_point,
  s.de_destination_name,
  s.cd_destination_country,
  s.cd_destination_location_type,
  s.dt_creation_utc,
  s.dt_transaction_utc,
  s.dt_departure_utc,
  s.dt_destination_arrival_utc,
  s.dt_transaction_date,
  s.dt_partition,
  1 AS ni_transaction_count,
  CASE WHEN s.is_success = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ni_successful_transaction_count,
  CASE WHEN s.is_chargeable = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ni_chargeable_transaction_count,
  s.ni_response_time_ms,
  s.cd_passenger_type,
  s.de_passenger_type_name,
  s.cd_gender,
  s.de_gender_name,
  s.de_age_group,
  s.cd_processing_entity_id,
  s.de_processing_entity_name,
  s.cd_product_code,
  s.de_product_name,
  s.arr_capture_method,
  s.arr_capture_method_name,
  s.json_nationalities,
  s.json_transits,
  s.json_itinerary_details,
  s.de_hash_code,
  s.de_source_table,
  s.de_source_file,
  s.cd_source_event_type,
  s.dt_source_load_utc,
  s.cd_alert,
  s.de_alert,
  s.source_id,
  CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS run_id,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp) AS dt_update_utc
FROM transaction_source s
LEFT JOIN account_latest a
  ON s.nk_account_id = a.nk_account_id
LEFT JOIN user_latest u
  ON s.nk_user_id = u.nk_user_id
LEFT JOIN location_code_resolver departure_location
  ON UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_departure_point)) = departure_location.cd_location_code
LEFT JOIN location_code_resolver departure_country
  ON UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_departure_country)) = departure_country.cd_location_code
LEFT JOIN location_code_resolver destination_location
  ON UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_destination_point)) = destination_location.cd_location_code
LEFT JOIN location_code_resolver destination_country
  ON UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_destination_country)) = destination_country.cd_location_code

collections.description: 29 million

-- =============================================================================
-- B. TABLE 1 — mart_journey
-- Grain: 1 row per nk_journey_id  (from TRANSACTION fact only)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fact_journey_agg
WITH (
  format = 'PARQUET',
  partitioned_by = ARRAY['dt_partition']
) AS
WITH
params AS (
  SELECT
      24 AS w_hours
    , TIMESTAMP '2099-12-31 23:59:59' AS as_of_utc
    , 'YYYYMMDD' AS watermark_partition
),

tx AS (
  SELECT
      concat(f.nk_account_id, '|', f.nk_passenger_id) AS nk_journey_id
    , f.nk_passenger_id
    , f.nk_account_id
    , f.sk_account_latest
    , f.dt_transaction_utc
    , f.nk_transaction_id
    , f.cd_response_evaluation
    , f.sk_response_evaluation
    , f.dt_partition
  FROM fact_transaction_event f
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE f.dt_partition >= p.watermark_partition
    AND nullif(trim(f.nk_passenger_id), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND nullif(trim(f.nk_account_id), '')   IS NOT NULL
),

ordered AS (
  SELECT
      t.*
    , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY nk_journey_id
        ORDER BY dt_transaction_utc ASC, nk_transaction_id ASC
      ) AS rn_asc
    , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY nk_journey_id
        ORDER BY dt_transaction_utc DESC, nk_transaction_id DESC
      ) AS rn_desc
    , COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY nk_journey_id) AS query_count
    , MIN(dt_transaction_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY nk_journey_id) AS dt_first_query_utc
    , MAX(dt_transaction_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY nk_journey_id) AS dt_last_query_utc
  FROM tx t
),

first_tx AS (SELECT * FROM ordered WHERE rn_asc = 1),
last_tx  AS (SELECT * FROM ordered WHERE rn_desc = 1),

norm AS (
  SELECT
      f.nk_journey_id
    , f.nk_passenger_id
    , f.nk_account_id
    , f.sk_account_latest
    , f.nk_transaction_id AS nk_first_transaction_id
    , CAST(f.dt_first_query_utc AS date) AS dt_journey_date
    , f.dt_first_query_utc
    , l.dt_last_query_utc
    , f.query_count
    , f.cd_response_evaluation AS cd_first_response_evaluation
    , l.cd_response_evaluation AS cd_final_response_evaluation
    , f.sk_response_evaluation AS sk_first_response_evaluation
    , l.sk_response_evaluation AS sk_final_response_evaluation
    , CASE
        WHEN lower(coalesce(f.cd_response_evaluation, '')) LIKE '%not_ok%'
          OR lower(coalesce(f.cd_response_evaluation, '')) LIKE '%not ok%'
          THEN 'not_ok_to_board'
        WHEN lower(coalesce(f.cd_response_evaluation, '')) LIKE '%conditional%'
          THEN 'conditional'
        WHEN lower(coalesce(f.cd_response_evaluation, '')) IN ('ok', 'ok_to_board')
          OR lower(coalesce(f.cd_response_evaluation, '')) LIKE '%ok_to_board%'
          OR lower(coalesce(f.cd_response_evaluation, '')) LIKE '%ok to board%'
          THEN 'ok_to_board'
        ELSE coalesce(nullif(lower(trim(f.cd_response_evaluation)), ''), 'unknown')
      END AS norm_first
    , CASE
        WHEN lower(coalesce(l.cd_response_evaluation, '')) LIKE '%not_ok%'
          OR lower(coalesce(l.cd_response_evaluation, '')) LIKE '%not ok%'
          THEN 'not_ok_to_board'
        WHEN lower(coalesce(l.cd_response_evaluation, '')) LIKE '%conditional%'
          THEN 'conditional'
        WHEN lower(coalesce(l.cd_response_evaluation, '')) IN ('ok', 'ok_to_board')
          OR lower(coalesce(l.cd_response_evaluation, '')) LIKE '%ok_to_board%'
          OR lower(coalesce(l.cd_response_evaluation, '')) LIKE '%ok to board%'
          THEN 'ok_to_board'
        ELSE coalesce(nullif(lower(trim(l.cd_response_evaluation)), ''), 'unknown')
      END AS norm_final
  FROM first_tx f
  INNER JOIN last_tx l
    ON f.nk_journey_id = l.nk_journey_id
)

SELECT
    n.nk_journey_id
  , n.nk_passenger_id
  , n.nk_account_id
  , n.sk_account_latest
  , n.nk_first_transaction_id
  , n.dt_journey_date
  , n.dt_first_query_utc
  , n.dt_last_query_utc
  , n.query_count
  , n.cd_first_response_evaluation
  , n.cd_final_response_evaluation
  , n.sk_first_response_evaluation
  , n.sk_final_response_evaluation
  , CASE
      WHEN n.norm_final = 'ok_to_board' AND n.query_count = 1 THEN 'ok_in_1'
      WHEN n.norm_final = 'ok_to_board' AND n.query_count = 2 THEN 'ok_in_2'
      WHEN n.norm_final = 'ok_to_board' AND n.query_count >= 3 THEN 'ok_in_3_plus'
      WHEN n.norm_final = 'conditional' THEN 'conditional_final'
      WHEN n.norm_final = 'not_ok_to_board' THEN 'not_ok_final'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS cd_final_eval_bucket
  , CASE WHEN n.norm_first = 'ok_to_board' AND n.norm_final = 'ok_to_board' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      AS is_first_time_ok
  , CASE WHEN n.norm_final = 'conditional' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      AS is_conditional_final
  , CASE WHEN n.norm_final = 'not_ok_to_board' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      AS is_not_ok_final
  , CASE
      WHEN n.dt_first_query_utc <= date_add('hour', -p.w_hours, p.as_of_utc)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS is_kpi_eligible_asof
  , p.w_hours AS ni_w_hours
  , date_format(n.dt_journey_date, '%Y%m%d') AS dt_partition
FROM norm n
CROSS JOIN params p
;
