collections.description: CONFORMED submitted-document detail: one documentDetails array item per retained transaction parent and one-based ordinal.
collections.comments:
Purpose: CONFORMED document detail for TIM-IDL-F06-04 Documents (drill down table), preserving the retained transaction and source-array position.
Grain: one row per documentDetails array item and one-based ni_document_ordinal within one retained st_transaction_data row.
Source and extraction: conformed.st_transaction_data supplies the retained parent, identifiers, typed transaction time and lineage. raw.historical_transaction_data and raw.ods_transaction_data supply doc_check_request_string, document_categories, document_category_names, document_types and document_type_names. The RAW join is parent nk_transaction_document_id to trimmed document_id, restricted by de_source_table. Item fields are documentCode, documentMRZType, documentSeries, documentFeature, documentIssueCountry, nationality, documentIssueDate and documentExpiryDate.
Keys and cardinality: technical primary key sk_transaction_document is TO_HEX(SHA256(TO_UTF8(sk_transaction_data || '|document_details|' || CAST(ni_document_ordinal AS varchar)))). Compound uniqueness is (sk_transaction_data, ni_document_ordinal), declared separately from the surrogate key. One st_transaction_data parent has zero or many items; each interpretable child resolves to exactly one parent. nk_source_transaction_document_id is the parent MongoDB transaction document ID, not an ID for the submitted travel document. No submitted-document natural key exists in the profiled payload. Transaction, request and passenger identifiers are non-unique at this grain; series is not a key.
History/SCD: retained event detail, not SCD; no new history columns. Historical data is the parent baseline; ODS contributes parent-selected inserts not represented by that baseline. Re-emitted ODS inserts are ordered by dt_load_utc DESC, source_record_id DESC and cdc_event_id DESC, partitioned by the retained parent key. Child logic does not independently reinterpret update/delete events.
Transformation: trim and normalize blanks; uppercase codes; retain source case for descriptions and series; parse issue/expiry dates with TRY_CAST or supported day-month-year parsing; inherit parent UTC transaction time. Explode documentDetails WITH ORDINALITY. Assign parallel summaries only when their cardinality matches the item count, preserving blank positions. documentCode is canonical type; an aligned type summary is validation evidence, not a fallback. Publish type name only when aligned type/name summaries and the item-local type agree.
Data quality: malformed nonblank request JSON, a present-but-invalid document array, missing parent key or missing/duplicate selected RAW payload must fail the pre-load validation/quarantine gate. Missing request, absent documentDetails or an empty array legitimately contributes zero children. Parent errors/deletes remain visible; interpretable warning rows load with cd_alert/de_alert. Alignment mismatches suppress only unsafe derived attributes. Missing category/type, type disagreement, invalid nonblank dates and series over four characters are warnings; source series is preserved. The focused validation SQL is the enforcement contract; malformed payloads cannot be considered safely handled by TRY returning NULL alone.
Load, corrections, and reruns: existing Athena DEV implementation is an empty unpartitioned Parquet CTAS followed by one full-history INSERT. dt_partition is a retained varchar attribute, not a physical partition. The As Select Statement contains the existing load SELECT. Never append the full result twice. A DEV rerun needs controlled recreation and S3 lifecycle handling. Production atomic replacement or an idempotent Iceberg/dbt implementation remains separately governed. If an authoritative correction changes/reorders an array, replace the entire child set, including removed ordinals. Late parents land in the next coordinated rebuild; no finite lateness cutoff has been established. Source-retention tombstones are not newly interpreted as business deletions here.
Lineage: preserve nk_source_transaction_document_id, sk_transaction_data, de_source_table, de_source_file, cd_source_event_type and dt_source_load_utc. source_id adds document_details and the ordinal; run_id is NULL in the supplied DEV SQL and is an orchestration responsibility. dt_load_utc/dt_update_utc are audit-only and do not define identity.
Sensitive data: passenger/user identifiers, document series and issue/expiry dates require restricted access and an approved masking/export policy. cd_document_mrz_type is documentMRZType only. Complete MRZ, raw request JSON, birth dates and IP addresses are excluded. Account name is descriptive and never authorizes access.
Known limitations and evidence: documented full DEV ST profiling found 51,146,058 eligible rows, unique document keys, unique parent-plus-ordinal keys and zero missing/ineligible CONFORMED parents. Document category coverage was 44.203%; absent or misaligned categories must not be inferred from type. These are recorded snapshot results, not a fresh validation. There is no intrinsic item identity stable across source-array reordering.
Physical representation: the existing v4 Snowflake Hackolade target is retained. varchar/integer/boolean/date and timestamp_ntz(3) represent the supplied Athena varchar/integer/boolean/date and timestamp(3). Logical keys are documented in Hackolade; Athena CTAS does not enforce them. The focused Athena DDL/load/validation files remain authoritative for DEV storage and execution.
collections.selectStatement:
WITH parent AS (
  SELECT
    sk_transaction_data,
    nk_transaction_document_id,
    nk_transaction_id,
    nk_request_id,
    nk_passenger_id,
    nk_account_id,
    de_account_name,
    nk_user_id,
    CAST(dt_transaction_utc AS timestamp(3)) AS dt_transaction_utc,
    dt_transaction_date,
    dt_partition,
    de_source_table,
    de_source_file,
    cd_source_event_type,
    CAST(dt_source_load_utc AS timestamp(3)) AS dt_source_load_utc,
    is_deleted,
    cd_error AS cd_parent_error,
    de_error AS de_parent_error,
    cd_alert AS cd_parent_alert,
    de_alert AS de_parent_alert
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_transaction_data
  WHERE de_source_table IN (
    'historical_transaction_data',
    'ods_transaction_data'
  )
),
historical_payload AS (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    h.doc_check_request_string,
    h.document_categories,
    h.document_category_names,
    h.document_types,
    h.document_type_names
  FROM parent p
  JOIN timatic4datarepositorydev.historical_transaction_data h
    ON p.nk_transaction_document_id = NULLIF(TRIM(h.document_id), '')
  WHERE p.de_source_table = 'historical_transaction_data'
),
ods_payload_candidate AS (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    o.doc_check_request_string,
    o.document_categories,
    o.document_category_names,
    o.document_types,
    o.document_type_names,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY p.sk_transaction_data
      ORDER BY
        o.dt_load_utc DESC,
        COALESCE(o.source_record_id, '') DESC,
        COALESCE(o.cdc_event_id, '') DESC
    ) AS ni_source_row_rank
  FROM parent p
  JOIN timatic4datarepositorydev.ods_transaction_data o
    ON p.nk_transaction_document_id = NULLIF(TRIM(o.document_id), '')
  WHERE p.de_source_table = 'ods_transaction_data'
    AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(o.cdc_operation_type, ''))) = 'insert'
),
source_payload AS (
  SELECT
    sk_transaction_data,
    nk_transaction_document_id,
    nk_transaction_id,
    nk_request_id,
    nk_passenger_id,
    nk_account_id,
    de_account_name,
    nk_user_id,
    dt_transaction_utc,
    dt_transaction_date,
    dt_partition,
    de_source_table,
    de_source_file,
    cd_source_event_type,
    dt_source_load_utc,
    is_deleted,
    cd_parent_error,
    de_parent_error,
    cd_parent_alert,
    de_parent_alert,
    doc_check_request_string,
    document_categories,
    document_category_names,
    document_types,
    document_type_names
  FROM historical_payload

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    sk_transaction_data,
    nk_transaction_document_id,
    nk_transaction_id,
    nk_request_id,
    nk_passenger_id,
    nk_account_id,
    de_account_name,
    nk_user_id,
    dt_transaction_utc,
    dt_transaction_date,
    dt_partition,
    de_source_table,
    de_source_file,
    cd_source_event_type,
    dt_source_load_utc,
    is_deleted,
    cd_parent_error,
    de_parent_error,
    cd_parent_alert,
    de_parent_alert,
    doc_check_request_string,
    document_categories,
    document_category_names,
    document_types,
    document_type_names
  FROM ods_payload_candidate
  WHERE ni_source_row_rank = 1
),
parsed AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    TRY(
      CAST(
        JSON_EXTRACT(
          JSON_PARSE(NULLIF(TRIM(doc_check_request_string), '')),
          '$.documentDetails'
        ) AS ARRAY(JSON)
      )
    ) AS arr_document
  FROM source_payload
),
prepared AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CAST(CARDINALITY(arr_document) AS integer) AS ni_document_count,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(document_categories), '') IS NULL
        THEN CAST(ARRAY[] AS ARRAY(VARCHAR))
      ELSE TRANSFORM(
        SPLIT(document_categories, ','),
        value -> NULLIF(TRIM(value), '')
      )
    END AS arr_document_category,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(document_category_names), '') IS NULL
        THEN CAST(ARRAY[] AS ARRAY(VARCHAR))
      ELSE TRANSFORM(
        SPLIT(document_category_names, ','),
        value -> NULLIF(TRIM(value), '')
      )
    END AS arr_document_category_name,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(document_types), '') IS NULL
        THEN CAST(ARRAY[] AS ARRAY(VARCHAR))
      ELSE TRANSFORM(
        SPLIT(document_types, ','),
        value -> NULLIF(TRIM(value), '')
      )
    END AS arr_document_type,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(document_type_names), '') IS NULL
        THEN CAST(ARRAY[] AS ARRAY(VARCHAR))
      ELSE TRANSFORM(
        SPLIT(document_type_names, ','),
        value -> NULLIF(TRIM(value), '')
      )
    END AS arr_document_type_name
  FROM parsed
  WHERE COALESCE(CARDINALITY(arr_document), 0) > 0
),
aligned AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(document_categories), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE CARDINALITY(arr_document_category) = ni_document_count
    END AS is_document_category_aligned,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(document_category_names), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE CARDINALITY(arr_document_category_name) = ni_document_count
    END AS is_document_category_name_aligned,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(document_types), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE CARDINALITY(arr_document_type) = ni_document_count
    END AS is_document_type_aligned,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(document_type_names), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE CARDINALITY(arr_document_type_name) = ni_document_count
    END AS is_document_type_name_aligned
  FROM prepared
),
document_item AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    item,
    CAST(document_ordinal AS integer) AS ni_document_ordinal,
    CASE
      WHEN is_document_category_aligned
        THEN ELEMENT_AT(arr_document_category, document_ordinal)
    END AS document_category,
    CASE
      WHEN is_document_category_aligned
        AND is_document_category_name_aligned
        THEN ELEMENT_AT(arr_document_category_name, document_ordinal)
    END AS document_category_name,
    CASE
      WHEN is_document_type_aligned
        THEN ELEMENT_AT(arr_document_type, document_ordinal)
    END AS document_type_summary,
    CASE
      WHEN is_document_type_aligned
        AND is_document_type_name_aligned
        THEN ELEMENT_AT(arr_document_type_name, document_ordinal)
    END AS document_type_name
  FROM aligned a
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(arr_document) WITH ORDINALITY
    AS d(item, document_ordinal)
),
normalized AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(document_category)), '') AS normalized_category,
    NULLIF(TRIM(document_category_name), '') AS normalized_category_name,
    NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(document_type_summary)), '')
      AS normalized_type_summary,
    NULLIF(TRIM(document_type_name), '') AS normalized_type_name,
    NULLIF(
      UPPER(TRIM(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(item, '$.documentCode'))),
      ''
    ) AS normalized_document_type,
    NULLIF(
      UPPER(TRIM(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(item, '$.documentMRZType'))),
      ''
    ) AS normalized_document_mrz_type,
    NULLIF(TRIM(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(item, '$.documentSeries')), '')
      AS normalized_document_series,
    NULLIF(
      UPPER(TRIM(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(item, '$.documentFeature'))),
      ''
    ) AS normalized_document_feature,
    NULLIF(
      UPPER(TRIM(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(item, '$.documentIssueCountry'))),
      ''
    ) AS normalized_document_issue_country,
    NULLIF(
      UPPER(TRIM(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(item, '$.nationality'))),
      ''
    ) AS normalized_document_nationality,
    NULLIF(TRIM(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(item, '$.documentIssueDate')), '')
      AS document_issue_date_source,
    NULLIF(TRIM(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(item, '$.documentExpiryDate')), '')
      AS document_expiry_date_source
  FROM document_item
),
typed AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    COALESCE(
      TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(document_issue_date_source, 1, 10) AS date),
      TRY(CAST(DATE_PARSE(document_issue_date_source, '%d-%m-%Y') AS date))
    ) AS parsed_document_issue_date,
    COALESCE(
      TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(document_expiry_date_source, 1, 10) AS date),
      TRY(CAST(DATE_PARSE(document_expiry_date_source, '%d-%m-%Y') AS date))
    ) AS parsed_document_expiry_date,
    CASE
      WHEN normalized_document_type IS NOT NULL
        AND normalized_type_summary IS NOT NULL
        THEN normalized_document_type = normalized_type_summary
      ELSE NULL
    END AS is_document_type_consistent
  FROM normalized
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    NULLIF(
      ARRAY_JOIN(
        FILTER(
          ARRAY[
            cd_parent_error
          ],
          error_code -> error_code IS NOT NULL
        ),
        '|'
      ),
      ''
    ) AS child_error_code,
    NULLIF(
      ARRAY_JOIN(
        FILTER(
          ARRAY[
            de_parent_error
          ],
          error_text -> error_text IS NOT NULL
        ),
        ' | '
      ),
      ''
    ) AS child_error_text,
    NULLIF(
      ARRAY_JOIN(
        FILTER(
          ARRAY[
            cd_parent_alert,
            CASE
              WHEN is_document_category_aligned = false
                THEN 'document_category_alignment_mismatch'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN is_document_category_name_aligned = false
                THEN 'document_category_name_alignment_mismatch'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN is_document_type_aligned = false
                THEN 'document_type_alignment_mismatch'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN is_document_type_name_aligned = false
                THEN 'document_type_name_alignment_mismatch'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN normalized_category IS NULL
                THEN 'missing_document_category'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN normalized_document_type IS NULL
                THEN 'missing_document_type'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN LENGTH(normalized_document_series) > 4
                THEN 'document_series_length_exceeded'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN is_document_type_consistent = false
                THEN 'document_type_summary_disagreement'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN document_issue_date_source IS NOT NULL
                AND parsed_document_issue_date IS NULL
                THEN 'invalid_document_issue_date'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN document_expiry_date_source IS NOT NULL
                AND parsed_document_expiry_date IS NULL
                THEN 'invalid_document_expiry_date'
            END
          ],
          alert_code -> alert_code IS NOT NULL
        ),
        '|'
      ),
      ''
    ) AS child_alert_code,
    NULLIF(
      ARRAY_JOIN(
        FILTER(
          ARRAY[
            de_parent_alert,
            CASE
              WHEN is_document_category_aligned = false
                THEN 'Document category count does not match the document item count; category values were suppressed.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN is_document_category_name_aligned = false
                THEN 'Document category-name count does not match the document item count; category names were suppressed.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN is_document_type_aligned = false
                THEN 'Document type-summary count does not match the document item count; summary values were suppressed.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN is_document_type_name_aligned = false
                THEN 'Document type-name count does not match the document item count; type names were suppressed.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN normalized_category IS NULL
                THEN 'Document category is unavailable for this document item.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN normalized_document_type IS NULL
                THEN 'Item-local documentCode is unavailable for this document item.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN LENGTH(normalized_document_series) > 4
                THEN 'Document series exceeds the approved maximum of four characters; the source value was preserved.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN is_document_type_consistent = false
                THEN 'The aligned type summary disagrees with item-local documentCode.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN document_issue_date_source IS NOT NULL
                AND parsed_document_issue_date IS NULL
                THEN 'Document issue date cannot be parsed as a supported date.'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN document_expiry_date_source IS NOT NULL
                AND parsed_document_expiry_date IS NULL
                THEN 'Document expiry date cannot be parsed as a supported date.'
            END
          ],
          alert_text -> alert_text IS NOT NULL
        ),
        ' | '
      ),
      ''
    ) AS child_alert_text
  FROM typed
)
SELECT
  TO_HEX(
    SHA256(
      TO_UTF8(
        CONCAT(
          sk_transaction_data,
          '|document_details|',
          CAST(ni_document_ordinal AS varchar)
        )
      )
    )
  ) AS sk_transaction_document,
  sk_transaction_data,
  nk_transaction_document_id AS nk_source_transaction_document_id,
  nk_transaction_id,
  nk_request_id,
  nk_passenger_id,
  nk_account_id,
  de_account_name,
  nk_user_id,
  ni_document_ordinal,
  ni_document_count,
  normalized_category AS cd_document_category,
  CASE
    WHEN normalized_category IS NOT NULL THEN normalized_category_name
  END AS de_document_category_name,
  normalized_document_type AS cd_document_type,
  normalized_type_summary AS cd_document_type_summary,
  CASE
    WHEN is_document_type_consistent THEN normalized_type_name
  END AS de_document_type_name,
  normalized_document_mrz_type AS cd_document_mrz_type,
  normalized_document_series AS de_document_series,
  normalized_document_feature AS cd_document_feature,
  normalized_document_issue_country AS cd_document_issue_country,
  normalized_document_nationality AS cd_document_nationality,
  parsed_document_issue_date AS dt_document_issue_date,
  parsed_document_expiry_date AS dt_document_expiry_date,
  dt_transaction_utc,
  dt_transaction_date,
  dt_partition,
  is_document_category_aligned,
  is_document_category_name_aligned,
  is_document_type_aligned,
  is_document_type_name_aligned,
  is_document_type_consistent,
  de_source_table,
  de_source_file,
  cd_source_event_type,
  dt_source_load_utc,
  is_deleted,
  child_error_code AS cd_error,
  child_error_text AS de_error,
  child_alert_code AS cd_alert,
  child_alert_text AS de_alert,
  CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS run_id,
  CONCAT(
    de_source_table,
    ':',
    COALESCE(nk_transaction_document_id, 'missing'),
    ':document_details:',
    CAST(ni_document_ordinal AS varchar)
  ) AS source_id,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp(3)) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(current_timestamp AS timestamp(3)) AS dt_update_utc
FROM classified

/*
How it loads: run this projection once into an empty target using the focused ST INSERT. Pre-load payload validation/quarantine is mandatory. Inherit the retained parent population, explode documentDetails by ordinal and preserve all lineage/DQ fields.
Reruns: no full-result append. Controlled DEV recreation/S3 handling; production atomic replacement or governed idempotent merge. Corrections replace the entire parent ordinal set, including removed items; late parents appear after the next coordinated rebuild.
*/

properties.name: sk_transaction_document
properties.description: Technical document-item key: SHA-256 of the retained parent key, |document_details| and the one-based ordinal.

properties.name: sk_transaction_data
properties.description: Exact retained CONFORMED transaction parent key; one parent has zero or many submitted-document items.

properties.name: nk_source_transaction_document_id
properties.description: Parent MongoDB transaction document ID, not an ID for a submitted passport or travel document.

properties.name: nk_passenger_id
properties.description: Parent passenger/journey identifier; non-unique at document grain and restricted for external exposure.

properties.name: de_account_name
properties.description: Descriptive event/source account name inherited from the retained parent; never an authorization key.

properties.name: nk_user_id
properties.description: Parent API-consumer user identifier; non-unique at document grain and restricted for external exposure.

properties.name: ni_document_ordinal
properties.description: One-based documentDetails array position within the retained parent; not an intrinsic document identity.

properties.name: ni_document_count
properties.description: Number of parsed document items in the parent payload; repeated on each child. Do not sum across child rows.

properties.name: cd_document_category
properties.description: Normalized ordinal-aligned category summary; NULL when absent or cardinality-misaligned. Never inferred from type.

properties.name: de_document_category_name
properties.description: Category display name only when both category summaries align and category is present.

properties.name: cd_document_type
properties.description: Canonical type from item-local documentDetails[].documentCode; no summary fallback.

properties.name: cd_document_type_summary
properties.description: Safely aligned document_types summary for validation; not canonical type.

properties.name: de_document_type_name
properties.description: Aligned source type name only when item-local documentCode agrees with the aligned type summary.

properties.name: cd_document_mrz_type
properties.description: documentDetails[].documentMRZType indicator; does not contain complete MRZ text.

properties.name: de_document_series
properties.description: Trimmed source documentSeries with original case. Restricted. Preserve and warn if longer than four characters; never a key.

properties.name: cd_document_feature
properties.description: Normalized item-local documentFeature code; optional source attribute.

properties.name: cd_document_issue_country
properties.description: Normalized item-local documentIssueCountry code; retain even when the current country resolver is ambiguous or unmatched.

properties.name: cd_document_nationality
properties.description: Normalized document-item nationality; no automatic equivalence to governed passenger-journey nationality.

properties.name: dt_document_issue_date
properties.description: Parsed item-local documentIssueDate; invalid nonblank source becomes NULL with a warning. Restricted.

properties.name: dt_document_expiry_date
properties.description: Parsed item-local documentExpiryDate; invalid nonblank source becomes NULL with a warning. Restricted.

properties.name: dt_transaction_utc
properties.description: Parent transaction timestamp in UTC, the requirement query DateTime; millisecond precision.

properties.name: dt_transaction_date
properties.description: Parent transaction date inherited from CONFORMED.

properties.name: dt_partition
properties.description: Parent YYYYMMDD value retained as varchar; the focused Athena DEV table is unpartitioned.

properties.name: is_document_category_aligned
properties.description: NULL if the corresponding source summary is absent; otherwise true only when its cardinality matches the documentDetails item count. Retained from CONFORMED in the fact.

properties.name: is_document_category_name_aligned
properties.description: NULL if the corresponding source summary is absent; otherwise true only when its cardinality matches the documentDetails item count. Retained from CONFORMED in the fact.

properties.name: is_document_type_aligned
properties.description: NULL if the corresponding source summary is absent; otherwise true only when its cardinality matches the documentDetails item count. Retained from CONFORMED in the fact.

properties.name: is_document_type_name_aligned
properties.description: NULL if the corresponding source summary is absent; otherwise true only when its cardinality matches the documentDetails item count. Retained from CONFORMED in the fact.

properties.name: is_document_type_consistent
properties.description: NULL unless canonical item type and safely aligned summary type both exist; otherwise their normalized equality.

properties.name: dt_source_load_utc
properties.description: Retained parent source-load timestamp at millisecond precision.

properties.name: cd_error
properties.description: Inherited parent error code(s); error rows are ineligible for the document fact. Payload structural errors are pre-load gates.

properties.name: de_error
properties.description: Inherited parent error description(s); retain for reconciliation.

properties.name: cd_alert
properties.description: Pipe-separated inherited and document/relationship warnings; multiple conditions may coexist.

properties.name: de_alert
properties.description: Visible explanation of the recorded warning conditions; warnings do not remove interpretable items.

properties.name: run_id
properties.description: NULL in the existing DEV load; orchestration supplies the run identifier in a governed production implementation.

properties.name: source_id
properties.description: RAW source table and parent source document ID plus document_details and ordinal; inherited unchanged by the fact.

properties.name: dt_load_utc
properties.description: Current load timestamp cast to timestamp(3); audit-only, not row identity.

properties.name: dt_update_utc
properties.description: Current load/update timestamp cast to timestamp(3); audit-only, not row identity.

collections.description:
TIM-IDL-F06-01/04. Submitted document items for transaction drill-down.

One row per valid, non-deleted st_transaction_document item. sk_transaction_document_event inherits the CONFORMED item key and must be unique. (sk_transaction_event, ni_document_sequence) must also be unique. nk_source_transaction_document_id retains the source parent-document ID.

A transaction can contain several document items. Each item belongs to one exact parent, with at most one account, user or location match. Category, type, issuer and expiry stay on the same item. Alignment and consistency flags show uncertain classifications.

ni_transaction_document_count counts items, not passengers or Journeys. A document ordinal can change when the submitted array is corrected; it is not a stable document identity across revisions.
collections.comments:
Sources: st_account, st_location, st_transaction_data, st_transaction_document, st_user.

Loaded incrementally by data engineering. Replace the complete document ordinal set for an affected parent and remove disappeared items. Repeated runs must not leave old document items behind.

History: current values for retained source events, with current dimension references. CONFORMED errors and deleted records are excluded; warnings and match-status fields remain visible.

Checks: unique technical key, source-row reconciliation, lookup coverage and timestamp consistency. Retain source keys and audit fields for trace-back.

cd_row_signature is an internal join field used by the load. It has no reporting role.

Keep account/user access rules on report and export paths. Request payloads and passenger/document identifiers remain restricted.
collections.selectStatement:
-- TIM-IDL-F06-01/04. Submitted document items for transaction drill-down.
-- cd_row_signature is handled by the load logic.
WITH document_source AS (
  SELECT
    d.*,
    p.sk_transaction_data AS sk_parent_transaction_data,
    p.cd_error AS cd_parent_error,
    p.is_deleted AS is_parent_deleted,
    p.cd_channel AS cd_parent_channel,
    p.cd_channel_normalized AS cd_parent_channel_normalized,
    p.de_channel_name AS de_parent_channel_name,
    p.cd_request_type AS cd_parent_request_type,
    p.cd_response_evaluation AS cd_parent_response_evaluation,
    p.de_response_evaluation AS de_parent_response_evaluation,
    p.cd_processing_entity_id AS cd_parent_processing_entity_id,
    p.de_processing_entity_name AS de_parent_processing_entity_name,
    p.cd_destination_point AS cd_parent_destination_point,
    p.cd_destination_country AS cd_parent_destination_country,
    p.cd_passenger_type AS cd_parent_passenger_type,
    p.de_passenger_type_name AS de_parent_passenger_type_name,
    p.cd_gender AS cd_parent_gender,
    p.de_gender_name AS de_parent_gender_name,
    p.de_age_group AS de_parent_age_group
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_transaction_document AS d
  LEFT JOIN timatic4datarepositorydev.st_transaction_data AS p
    ON d.sk_transaction_data = p.sk_transaction_data
  WHERE
    d.cd_error IS NULL AND COALESCE(d.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
), account_latest AS (
  SELECT
    nk_account_id,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT sk_account) AS INTEGER) AS ni_account_match_count,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sk_account) = 1 THEN MAX(sk_account) ELSE NULL END AS sk_account_latest
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_account
  WHERE
    cd_error IS NULL
    AND is_current = TRUE
    AND COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND NOT nk_account_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    nk_account_id
), user_latest AS (
  SELECT
    nk_user_id,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT sk_user) AS INTEGER) AS ni_user_match_count,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sk_user) = 1 THEN MAX(sk_user) ELSE NULL END AS sk_user_latest
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_user
  WHERE
    cd_error IS NULL
    AND is_current = TRUE
    AND COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND NOT nk_user_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    nk_user_id
), current_location AS (
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    cd_location_code,
    cd_code,
    cd_code2,
    cd_code3,
    cd_code5,
    cd_syscode,
    cd_location_type
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_location
  WHERE
    cd_error IS NULL AND is_current = TRUE AND COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
), location_code_source AS (
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_location_code)) AS cd_location_code
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_location_code), '') IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_code))
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_code), '') IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_code2))
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_code2), '') IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_code3))
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_code3), '') IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_code5))
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_code5), '') IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_syscode))
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_syscode), '') IS NULL
), location_code_resolver AS (
  SELECT
    cd_location_code,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT sk_location) AS INTEGER) AS ni_location_match_count,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sk_location) = 1 THEN MAX(sk_location) ELSE NULL END AS sk_location_latest
  FROM location_code_source
  GROUP BY
    cd_location_code
), country_location_code_source AS (
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_location_code)) AS cd_location_code
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(cd_location_type, ''))) = 'COUNTRY'
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_location_code), '') IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_code))
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(cd_location_type, ''))) = 'COUNTRY'
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_code), '') IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_code2))
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(cd_location_type, ''))) = 'COUNTRY'
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_code2), '') IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_code3))
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(cd_location_type, ''))) = 'COUNTRY'
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_code3), '') IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_code5))
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(cd_location_type, ''))) = 'COUNTRY'
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_code5), '') IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sk_location,
    UPPER(TRIM(cd_syscode))
  FROM current_location
  WHERE
    UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(cd_location_type, ''))) = 'COUNTRY'
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_syscode), '') IS NULL
), country_location_code_resolver AS (
  SELECT
    cd_location_code,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT sk_location) AS INTEGER) AS ni_location_match_count,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sk_location) = 1 THEN MAX(sk_location) ELSE NULL END AS sk_location_latest
  FROM country_location_code_source
  GROUP BY
    cd_location_code
)
SELECT
  d.sk_transaction_document AS sk_transaction_document_event,
  CASE
    WHEN NOT d.sk_parent_transaction_data IS NULL
    AND d.cd_parent_error IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(d.is_parent_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
    THEN d.sk_parent_transaction_data
  END AS sk_transaction_event,
  a.sk_account_latest,
  u.sk_user_latest,
  TO_HEX(
    SHA256(
      TO_UTF8(
        COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(d.cd_parent_channel_normalized), ''),
          LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(d.cd_parent_channel), '')),
          'unknown'
        )
      )
    )
  ) AS sk_channel,
  TO_HEX(
    SHA256(TO_UTF8(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.cd_parent_response_evaluation), ''), 'unknown')))
  ) AS sk_response_evaluation,
  destination_location.sk_location_latest AS sk_destination_location_latest,
  destination_country.sk_location_latest AS sk_destination_country_location_latest,
  document_issue_country.sk_location_latest AS sk_document_issue_country_location_latest,
  document_nationality.sk_location_latest AS sk_document_nationality_location_latest,
  d.nk_source_transaction_document_id,
  d.nk_transaction_id,
  d.nk_request_id,
  d.nk_passenger_id,
  d.nk_account_id,
  d.nk_user_id,
  CASE
    WHEN d.sk_transaction_data IS NULL
    THEN 'source_key_missing'
    WHEN d.sk_parent_transaction_data IS NULL
    THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN NOT d.cd_parent_error IS NULL OR COALESCE(d.is_parent_deleted, FALSE) = TRUE
    THEN 'parent_not_eligible'
    ELSE 'matched'
  END AS cd_transaction_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN d.nk_account_id IS NULL
    THEN 'source_key_missing'
    WHEN a.ni_account_match_count IS NULL
    THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN a.ni_account_match_count = 1
    THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_account_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN d.nk_user_id IS NULL
    THEN 'source_key_missing'
    WHEN u.ni_user_match_count IS NULL
    THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN u.ni_user_match_count = 1
    THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_user_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN d.cd_parent_destination_point IS NULL
    THEN 'source_code_missing'
    WHEN destination_location.ni_location_match_count IS NULL
    THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN destination_location.ni_location_match_count = 1
    THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_destination_location_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN d.cd_parent_destination_country IS NULL
    THEN 'source_code_missing'
    WHEN destination_country.ni_location_match_count IS NULL
    THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN destination_country.ni_location_match_count = 1
    THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_destination_country_location_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN d.cd_document_issue_country IS NULL
    THEN 'source_code_missing'
    WHEN document_issue_country.ni_location_match_count IS NULL
    THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN document_issue_country.ni_location_match_count = 1
    THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_document_issue_country_location_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN d.cd_document_nationality IS NULL
    THEN 'source_code_missing'
    WHEN document_nationality.ni_location_match_count IS NULL
    THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN document_nationality.ni_location_match_count = 1
    THEN 'matched'
    ELSE 'ambiguous'
  END AS cd_document_nationality_location_match_status,
  d.de_account_name,
  d.cd_parent_channel AS cd_channel,
  d.cd_parent_channel_normalized AS cd_channel_normalized,
  d.de_parent_channel_name AS de_channel_name,
  d.cd_parent_request_type AS cd_request_type,
  d.cd_parent_response_evaluation AS cd_response_evaluation,
  d.de_parent_response_evaluation AS de_response_evaluation,
  d.cd_parent_processing_entity_id AS cd_processing_entity_id,
  d.de_parent_processing_entity_name AS de_processing_entity_name,
  d.cd_parent_destination_point AS cd_destination_point,
  d.cd_parent_destination_country AS cd_destination_country,
  d.cd_parent_passenger_type AS cd_passenger_type,
  d.de_parent_passenger_type_name AS de_passenger_type_name,
  d.cd_parent_gender AS cd_gender,
  d.de_parent_gender_name AS de_gender_name,
  d.de_parent_age_group AS de_age_group,
  d.ni_document_ordinal AS ni_document_sequence,
  d.ni_document_count AS ni_document_count_in_transaction_event,
  d.cd_document_category,
  d.de_document_category_name,
  d.cd_document_type,
  d.de_document_type_name,
  d.cd_document_mrz_type,
  d.de_document_series,
  d.cd_document_feature,
  d.cd_document_issue_country,
  d.cd_document_nationality,
  d.dt_document_issue_date,
  d.dt_document_expiry_date,
  CAST(d.dt_transaction_utc AS TIMESTAMP(3)),
  d.dt_transaction_date,
  d.dt_partition,
  1 AS ni_transaction_document_count,
  d.is_document_category_aligned,
  d.is_document_category_name_aligned,
  d.is_document_type_aligned,
  d.is_document_type_name_aligned,
  d.is_document_type_consistent,
  d.de_source_table,
  d.de_source_file,
  d.cd_source_event_type,
  CAST(d.dt_source_load_utc AS TIMESTAMP(3)),
  NULLIF(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(
        ARRAY[d.cd_alert, CASE
          WHEN d.sk_transaction_data IS NULL
          THEN 'transaction_key_missing'
          WHEN d.sk_parent_transaction_data IS NULL
          THEN 'transaction_not_found'
          WHEN NOT d.cd_parent_error IS NULL OR COALESCE(d.is_parent_deleted, FALSE) = TRUE
          THEN 'transaction_parent_not_eligible'
        END, CASE
          WHEN d.nk_account_id IS NULL
          THEN 'account_key_missing'
          WHEN a.ni_account_match_count IS NULL
          THEN 'account_not_found'
          WHEN a.ni_account_match_count > 1
          THEN 'account_ambiguous'
        END, CASE
          WHEN d.nk_user_id IS NULL
          THEN 'user_key_missing'
          WHEN u.ni_user_match_count IS NULL
          THEN 'user_not_found'
          WHEN u.ni_user_match_count > 1
          THEN 'user_ambiguous'
        END, CASE
          WHEN d.cd_parent_destination_point IS NULL
          THEN 'destination_location_code_missing'
          WHEN destination_location.ni_location_match_count IS NULL
          THEN 'destination_location_not_found'
          WHEN destination_location.ni_location_match_count > 1
          THEN 'destination_location_ambiguous'
        END, CASE
          WHEN d.cd_parent_destination_country IS NULL
          THEN 'destination_country_code_missing'
          WHEN destination_country.ni_location_match_count IS NULL
          THEN 'destination_country_not_found'
          WHEN destination_country.ni_location_match_count > 1
          THEN 'destination_country_ambiguous'
        END, CASE
          WHEN d.cd_document_issue_country IS NULL
          THEN 'document_issue_country_code_missing'
          WHEN document_issue_country.ni_location_match_count IS NULL
          THEN 'document_issue_country_not_found'
          WHEN document_issue_country.ni_location_match_count > 1
          THEN 'document_issue_country_ambiguous'
        END, CASE
          WHEN d.cd_document_nationality IS NULL
          THEN 'document_nationality_code_missing'
          WHEN document_nationality.ni_location_match_count IS NULL
          THEN 'document_nationality_not_found'
          WHEN document_nationality.ni_location_match_count > 1
          THEN 'document_nationality_ambiguous'
        END],
        alert_code -> NOT alert_code IS NULL
      ),
      '|'
    ),
    ''
  ) AS cd_alert,
  NULLIF(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(
        ARRAY[d.de_alert, CASE
          WHEN d.sk_transaction_data IS NULL
          THEN 'Parent transaction technical key is missing.'
          WHEN d.sk_parent_transaction_data IS NULL
          THEN 'Parent CONFORMED transaction was not found.'
          WHEN NOT d.cd_parent_error IS NULL OR COALESCE(d.is_parent_deleted, FALSE) = TRUE
          THEN 'Parent CONFORMED transaction is not FACT eligible.'
        END, CASE
          WHEN d.nk_account_id IS NULL
          THEN 'Account identifier is missing; governed RLS must fail closed.'
          WHEN a.ni_account_match_count IS NULL
          THEN 'Account identifier has no current CONFORMED account match.'
          WHEN a.ni_account_match_count > 1
          THEN 'Account identifier has multiple current CONFORMED account matches.'
        END, CASE
          WHEN d.nk_user_id IS NULL
          THEN 'User identifier is missing.'
          WHEN u.ni_user_match_count IS NULL
          THEN 'User identifier has no current CONFORMED user match.'
          WHEN u.ni_user_match_count > 1
          THEN 'User identifier has multiple current CONFORMED user matches.'
        END, CASE
          WHEN d.cd_parent_destination_point IS NULL
          THEN 'Destination point is missing.'
          WHEN destination_location.ni_location_match_count IS NULL
          THEN 'Destination point has no current CONFORMED location match.'
          WHEN destination_location.ni_location_match_count > 1
          THEN 'Destination point has multiple current CONFORMED location matches.'
        END, CASE
          WHEN d.cd_parent_destination_country IS NULL
          THEN 'Destination country is missing.'
          WHEN destination_country.ni_location_match_count IS NULL
          THEN 'Destination country has no current CONFORMED country match.'
          WHEN destination_country.ni_location_match_count > 1
          THEN 'Destination country has multiple current CONFORMED country matches.'
        END, CASE
          WHEN d.cd_document_issue_country IS NULL
          THEN 'Document issue country is missing.'
          WHEN document_issue_country.ni_location_match_count IS NULL
          THEN 'Document issue country has no current CONFORMED country match.'
          WHEN document_issue_country.ni_location_match_count > 1
          THEN 'Document issue country has multiple current CONFORMED country matches.'
        END, CASE
          WHEN d.cd_document_nationality IS NULL
          THEN 'Document nationality is missing.'
          WHEN document_nationality.ni_location_match_count IS NULL
          THEN 'Document nationality has no current CONFORMED country match.'
          WHEN document_nationality.ni_location_match_count > 1
          THEN 'Document nationality has multiple current CONFORMED country matches.'
        END],
        alert_text -> NOT alert_text IS NULL
      ),
      ' | '
    ),
    ''
  ) AS de_alert,
  d.source_id,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS run_id,
  CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP(3)) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP(3)) AS dt_update_utc
FROM document_source AS d
LEFT JOIN account_latest AS a
  ON d.nk_account_id = a.nk_account_id
LEFT JOIN user_latest AS u
  ON d.nk_user_id = u.nk_user_id
LEFT JOIN location_code_resolver AS destination_location
  ON UPPER(TRIM(d.cd_parent_destination_point)) = destination_location.cd_location_code
LEFT JOIN country_location_code_resolver AS destination_country
  ON UPPER(TRIM(d.cd_parent_destination_country)) = destination_country.cd_location_code
LEFT JOIN country_location_code_resolver AS document_issue_country
  ON UPPER(TRIM(d.cd_document_issue_country)) = document_issue_country.cd_location_code
LEFT JOIN country_location_code_resolver AS document_nationality
  ON UPPER(TRIM(d.cd_document_nationality)) = document_nationality.cd_location_code;

properties.name: sk_transaction_document_event
properties.description: Technical fact key inherited exactly from st_transaction_document.sk_transaction_document.

properties.name: sk_transaction_event
properties.description: Eligible parent st_transaction_data key, also the fact_transaction_event key. NULL with an explicit status when the parent is unavailable/ineligible; publication requires a match.

properties.name: nk_source_transaction_document_id
properties.description: Parent MongoDB transaction document ID, not an ID for a submitted passport or travel document.

properties.name: nk_passenger_id
properties.description: Parent passenger/journey identifier; non-unique at document grain and restricted for external exposure.

properties.name: nk_user_id
properties.description: Parent API-consumer user identifier; non-unique at document grain and restricted for external exposure.

properties.name: cd_transaction_match_status
properties.description: matched, source_key_missing, not_found or parent_not_eligible; publication requires matched.

properties.name: cd_account_match_status
properties.description: Explicit current CONFORMED resolver status: matched, ambiguous, not_found, or source_key_missing/source_code_missing as applicable. An unresolved account must fail closed under RLS.

properties.name: cd_user_match_status
properties.description: Explicit current CONFORMED resolver status: matched, ambiguous, not_found, or source_key_missing/source_code_missing as applicable. An unresolved account must fail closed under RLS.

properties.name: cd_destination_location_match_status
properties.description: Explicit current CONFORMED resolver status: matched, ambiguous, not_found, or source_key_missing/source_code_missing as applicable. An unresolved account must fail closed under RLS.

properties.name: cd_destination_country_location_match_status
properties.description: Explicit current CONFORMED resolver status: matched, ambiguous, not_found, or source_key_missing/source_code_missing as applicable. An unresolved account must fail closed under RLS.

properties.name: cd_document_issue_country_location_match_status
properties.description: Explicit current CONFORMED resolver status: matched, ambiguous, not_found, or source_key_missing/source_code_missing as applicable. An unresolved account must fail closed under RLS.

properties.name: cd_document_nationality_location_match_status
properties.description: Explicit current CONFORMED resolver status: matched, ambiguous, not_found, or source_key_missing/source_code_missing as applicable. An unresolved account must fail closed under RLS.

properties.name: de_account_name
properties.description: Descriptive event/source account name inherited from the retained parent; never an authorization key.

properties.name: cd_destination_country
properties.description: Logged segment destination used for associated filters; distinguish final Journey destination.

properties.name: cd_gender
properties.description: Gender used by the filter or grouping.

properties.name: ni_document_sequence
properties.description: One-based source-array ordinal inherited from ni_document_ordinal; not a measure or persistent physical-document identity.

properties.name: ni_document_count_in_transaction_event
properties.description: Repeated parent document count; non-additive across document rows. Use MAX within one parent or distinct-parent grouping.

properties.name: cd_document_category
properties.description: Document category from the same item as document type and issuing country.

properties.name: de_document_category_name
properties.description: Category display name only when both category summaries align and category is present.

properties.name: cd_document_type
properties.description: Document type from the same item as category and issuing country.

properties.name: de_document_type_name
properties.description: Aligned source type name only when item-local documentCode agrees with the aligned type summary.

properties.name: cd_document_mrz_type
properties.description: documentDetails[].documentMRZType indicator; does not contain complete MRZ text.

properties.name: de_document_series
properties.description: Trimmed source documentSeries with original case. Restricted. Preserve and warn if longer than four characters; never a key.

properties.name: cd_document_feature
properties.description: Normalized item-local documentFeature code; optional source attribute.

properties.name: cd_document_issue_country
properties.description: Issuing country of the document identified by the category/type tuple.

properties.name: cd_document_nationality
properties.description: Normalized document-item nationality; no automatic equivalence to governed passenger-journey nationality.

properties.name: dt_document_issue_date
properties.description: Parsed item-local documentIssueDate; invalid nonblank source becomes NULL with a warning. Restricted.

properties.name: dt_document_expiry_date
properties.description: Parsed item-local documentExpiryDate; invalid nonblank source becomes NULL with a warning. Restricted.

properties.name: dt_transaction_utc
properties.description:
Parent transaction timestamp in UTC, the requirement query DateTime; millisecond precision.
Type: timestamp(6).

properties.name: dt_transaction_date
properties.description: Parent transaction date inherited from CONFORMED.

properties.name: dt_partition
properties.description: Date value used by the load. Identity partition column in Iceberg.

properties.name: ni_transaction_document_count
properties.description: Additive submitted-document count; the existing load writes 1 on every row.

properties.name: is_document_category_aligned
properties.description: NULL if the corresponding source summary is absent; otherwise true only when its cardinality matches the documentDetails item count. Retained from CONFORMED in the fact.

properties.name: is_document_category_name_aligned
properties.description: NULL if the corresponding source summary is absent; otherwise true only when its cardinality matches the documentDetails item count. Retained from CONFORMED in the fact.

properties.name: is_document_type_aligned
properties.description: NULL if the corresponding source summary is absent; otherwise true only when its cardinality matches the documentDetails item count. Retained from CONFORMED in the fact.

properties.name: is_document_type_name_aligned
properties.description: NULL if the corresponding source summary is absent; otherwise true only when its cardinality matches the documentDetails item count. Retained from CONFORMED in the fact.

properties.name: is_document_type_consistent
properties.description: NULL unless canonical item type and safely aligned summary type both exist; otherwise their normalized equality.

properties.name: de_source_file
properties.description: Source file retained for tracing the row back to ingestion.

properties.name: dt_source_load_utc
properties.description:
Retained parent source-load timestamp at millisecond precision.
Type: timestamp(6).

properties.name: cd_alert
properties.description: Pipe-separated inherited and document/relationship warnings; multiple conditions may coexist.

properties.name: de_alert
properties.description: Visible explanation of the recorded warning conditions; warnings do not remove interpretable items.

properties.name: run_id
properties.description: Load run identifier supplied by orchestration.

properties.name: dt_load_utc
properties.description:
UTC timestamp when the row was loaded.
Type: timestamp(6).

properties.name: dt_update_utc
properties.description:
UTC timestamp when the row was last updated.
Type: timestamp(6).

properties.name: cd_row_signature
properties.description: Technical field used by Vini in the load joins. Not used in reports.

properties.name: sk_journey_event
properties.description: Technical Journey PK, deterministic SHA-256 of JSON-encoded exact parent key and sequence as text. A corrected itinerary can change sequence and key.

properties.name: sk_transaction_event
