collections.description:
TIM-IDL-F06-01/02. Passenger Journey detail for the Data Page.

One row per eligible ENTRY-ended Journey within an exact CONFORMED transaction parent. sk_journey_event is the SHA-256 hash of the JSON-encoded parent technical key and sequence. (sk_transaction_event, ni_journey_sequence) must also be unique.

One transaction can have several Journeys. Each Journey has one parent and identified first/ENTRY segments; arr_segment_key holds the member segments. The load reads CONFORMED tables directly. Matching consumption keys provide the report join path.

Ambiguous parents or segment membership do not create a Journey. Keep ordering, membership and time-basis status visible. ni_journey_count is 1 and can be summed before expanding arrays or joining document items. A corrected itinerary can split, reorder or remove Journeys and change their keys.

Boarding status is matched by account and passenger as of the transaction query time. Both the status and recorded time must be no later than the query. An ambiguous latest match remains unresolved. This is recorded passenger/account status, not proof of boarding on the Journey. Timatic evaluation results remain separate.
collections.comments:
Sources: st_account, st_boarding_status, st_segment_transaction_data, st_transaction_data, st_transaction_document, st_user.

Loaded incrementally by data engineering. Replace the complete Journey set for an affected parent, including removal of old sequences. Segment, document and boarding changes can require a rebuild even if the transaction is unchanged.

History: current values for retained source events, with current dimension references. CONFORMED errors and deleted records are excluded; warnings and match-status fields remain visible.

Checks: unique technical key, source-row reconciliation, lookup coverage and timestamp consistency. Retain source keys and audit fields for trace-back.

cd_row_signature is an internal join field used by the load. It has no reporting role.

Keep account/user access rules on report and export paths. Request payloads and passenger/document identifiers remain restricted.
collections.selectStatement:
-- TIM-IDL-F06-01/02. Passenger Journey detail for the Data Page.
-- cd_row_signature is handled by the load logic.
WITH transaction_source AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY sk_transaction_data) AS ni_parent_key_count
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_transaction_data
  WHERE
    cd_error IS NULL AND COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
), segment_source AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY sk_segment_transaction_data) AS ni_segment_key_count
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_segment_transaction_data
  WHERE
    cd_error IS NULL AND COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
), transaction_id_profile AS (
  SELECT
    nk_transaction_id,
    COUNT(*) AS ni_transaction_candidate_count,
    MAX(sk_transaction_data) AS sk_single_transaction_event
  FROM transaction_source
  GROUP BY
    nk_transaction_id
), ambiguous_transaction_source AS (
  SELECT
    t.*
  FROM transaction_source AS t
  JOIN transaction_id_profile AS p
    ON t.nk_transaction_id = p.nk_transaction_id
    AND p.ni_transaction_candidate_count > 1
), passenger_timestamp_profile AS (
  SELECT
    s.sk_segment_transaction_data,
    COUNT(t.sk_transaction_data) AS ni_transaction_passenger_timestamp_candidate_count,
    MAX(t.sk_transaction_data) AS sk_passenger_timestamp_transaction_event
  FROM segment_source AS s
  JOIN transaction_id_profile AS p
    ON s.nk_transaction_id = p.nk_transaction_id
    AND p.ni_transaction_candidate_count > 1
  LEFT JOIN ambiguous_transaction_source AS t
    ON s.nk_transaction_id = t.nk_transaction_id
    AND NOT s.nk_passenger_id IS NULL
    AND s.nk_passenger_id = t.nk_passenger_id
    AND NOT s.dt_transaction_utc IS NULL
    AND s.dt_transaction_utc = t.dt_transaction_utc
  GROUP BY
    s.sk_segment_transaction_data
), resolved_segment AS (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    CASE
      WHEN p.ni_transaction_candidate_count = 1
      THEN p.sk_single_transaction_event
      WHEN p.ni_transaction_candidate_count > 1
      AND pt.ni_transaction_passenger_timestamp_candidate_count = 1
      THEN pt.sk_passenger_timestamp_transaction_event
    END AS sk_parent,
    NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_regulation_applicability)), '') AS cd_applicability,
    NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_segment_departure_point)), '') AS cd_departure,
    NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_segment_destination_point)), '') AS cd_arrival,
    NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_segment_departure_location_type)), '') AS cd_departure_type,
    NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_segment_destination_location_type)), '') AS cd_arrival_type
  FROM segment_source AS s
  LEFT JOIN transaction_id_profile AS p
    ON s.nk_transaction_id = p.nk_transaction_id
  LEFT JOIN passenger_timestamp_profile AS pt
    ON s.sk_segment_transaction_data = pt.sk_segment_transaction_data
), parent_scope AS (
  SELECT
    t.*,
    CASE
      WHEN t.sk_transaction_data IS NULL OR t.ni_parent_key_count <> 1
      THEN 'bad_parent_key'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(t.de_service_name, ''))) <> 'process document check'
      THEN 'ineligible_service'
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(t.nk_account_id), '') IS NULL
      THEN 'account_missing'
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(t.nk_passenger_id), '') IS NULL
      THEN 'passenger_missing'
      WHEN NOT LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(t.cd_response_evaluation, ''))) IN ('ok_to_board', 'not_ok_to_board', 'conditional')
      THEN 'ineligible_evaluation'
    END AS cd_eligibility_error
  FROM transaction_source AS t
), unresolved_segment AS (
  SELECT
    nk_transaction_id,
    COUNT(*) AS ni_unresolved_segment_count
  FROM resolved_segment
  WHERE
    sk_parent IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    nk_transaction_id
), linked_member AS (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.sk_parent ORDER BY s.sk_segment_transaction_data) AS ni_input_ordinal,
    CASE
      WHEN s.sk_segment_transaction_data IS NULL OR s.ni_segment_key_count <> 1
      THEN 'bad_segment_key'
      WHEN (
        NOT s.nk_account_id IS NULL AND s.nk_account_id <> p.nk_account_id
      )
      OR (
        NOT s.nk_passenger_id IS NULL AND s.nk_passenger_id <> p.nk_passenger_id
      )
      THEN 'segment_parent_context_mismatch'
      WHEN s.cd_applicability IS NULL OR NOT s.cd_applicability IN ('ENTRY', 'TRANSIT')
      THEN 'unknown_applicability'
      WHEN s.cd_departure IS NULL
      OR s.cd_arrival IS NULL
      OR s.cd_departure_type IS NULL
      OR s.cd_arrival_type IS NULL
      THEN 'incomplete_route'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.cd_segment_response_evaluation, ''))) = 'error'
      OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.cd_response_evaluation, ''))) = 'error'
      THEN 'segment_evaluation_error'
    END AS cd_member_error
  FROM resolved_segment AS s
  JOIN parent_scope AS p
    ON s.sk_parent = p.sk_transaction_data
  WHERE
    p.cd_eligibility_error IS NULL
), member_profile AS (
  SELECT
    sk_parent,
    COUNT(*) AS ni_logged_segment_count,
    COUNT_IF(NOT cd_member_error IS NULL) AS ni_bad_member_count
  FROM linked_member
  GROUP BY
    sk_parent
), parent_quality AS (
  SELECT
    p.sk_transaction_data,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(u.ni_unresolved_segment_count, 0) > 0
      THEN 'unresolved_segment_parent'
      WHEN m.ni_logged_segment_count IS NULL
      THEN 'no_linked_logged_segment'
      WHEN m.ni_bad_member_count > 0
      THEN 'invalid_logged_member'
    END AS cd_parent_error
  FROM parent_scope AS p
  LEFT JOIN member_profile AS m
    ON p.sk_transaction_data = m.sk_parent
  LEFT JOIN unresolved_segment AS u
    ON p.nk_transaction_id = u.nk_transaction_id
  WHERE
    p.cd_eligibility_error IS NULL
), route_array AS (
  SELECT
    s.sk_parent,
    COUNT(*) AS ni_segment_count,
    ARRAY_AGG(
      JSON_FORMAT(CAST(ARRAY[cd_departure, cd_departure_type] AS JSON)) ORDER BY ni_input_ordinal
    ) AS arr_departure,
    ARRAY_AGG(
      JSON_FORMAT(CAST(ARRAY[cd_arrival, cd_arrival_type] AS JSON)) ORDER BY ni_input_ordinal
    ) AS arr_arrival,
    ARRAY_AGG(ni_input_ordinal ORDER BY dt_segment_destination_arrival_utc, ni_input_ordinal) AS arr_time_order,
    COUNT(dt_segment_destination_arrival_utc) = COUNT(*)
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT dt_segment_destination_arrival_utc) = COUNT(*) AS is_time_order_available
  FROM linked_member AS s
  JOIN parent_quality AS q
    ON s.sk_parent = q.sk_transaction_data
  WHERE
    q.cd_parent_error IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    s.sk_parent
), route_profile AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    is_time_order_available
    AND CARDINALITY(
      FILTER(
        ZIP_WITH(
          SLICE(arr_time_order, 1, ni_segment_count - 1),
          SLICE(arr_time_order, 2, ni_segment_count - 1),
          (previous_item, next_item) -> ELEMENT_AT(arr_arrival, previous_item) = ELEMENT_AT(arr_departure, next_item)
        ),
        connected -> NOT connected
      )
    ) = 0 AS is_time_order_connected
  FROM route_array AS a
), route_start AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    FILTER(
      SEQUENCE(CAST(1 AS BIGINT), ni_segment_count),
      i -> NOT CONTAINS(arr_arrival, ELEMENT_AT(arr_departure, i))
    ) AS arr_start
  FROM route_profile AS a
  WHERE
    ni_segment_count > 1 AND NOT is_time_order_connected AND ni_segment_count <= 1000
), route_walk AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    REDUCE(
      SEQUENCE(CAST(1 AS BIGINT), ni_segment_count),
      CAST(ARRAY[] AS ARRAY(BIGINT)),
      (path, step) -> CONCAT(
        path,
        ARRAY[CASE
          WHEN step = 1
          THEN CASE WHEN CARDINALITY(arr_start) = 1 THEN ELEMENT_AT(arr_start, 1) END
          WHEN CARDINALITY(
            FILTER(
              SEQUENCE(CAST(1 AS BIGINT), ni_segment_count),
              i -> NOT CONTAINS(path, i)
              AND ELEMENT_AT(arr_departure, i) = ELEMENT_AT(arr_arrival, ELEMENT_AT(path, -1))
            )
          ) = 1
          THEN ELEMENT_AT(
            FILTER(
              SEQUENCE(CAST(1 AS BIGINT), ni_segment_count),
              i -> NOT CONTAINS(path, i)
              AND ELEMENT_AT(arr_departure, i) = ELEMENT_AT(arr_arrival, ELEMENT_AT(path, -1))
            ),
            1
          )
          ELSE CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)
        END]
      ),
      path -> path
    ) AS arr_chain_order
  FROM route_start AS a
), chosen_order AS (
  SELECT
    a.sk_parent,
    CASE
      WHEN a.ni_segment_count = 1
      THEN ARRAY[CAST(1 AS BIGINT)]
      WHEN a.is_time_order_connected
      THEN a.arr_time_order
      ELSE w.arr_chain_order
    END AS arr_order,
    CASE
      WHEN a.ni_segment_count = 1
      THEN 'single_logged_segment'
      WHEN a.is_time_order_connected
      THEN 'logged_arrival_utc'
      ELSE 'unique_logged_route_chain'
    END AS cd_ordering_method,
    CASE
      WHEN a.ni_segment_count > 1 AND NOT a.is_time_order_connected
      THEN CASE
        WHEN a.ni_segment_count > 1000
        THEN 'route_chain_limit_exceeded'
        WHEN w.arr_chain_order IS NULL
        OR CARDINALITY(FILTER(w.arr_chain_order, i -> i IS NULL)) > 0
        OR CARDINALITY(ARRAY_DISTINCT(w.arr_chain_order)) <> a.ni_segment_count
        THEN 'ordering_ambiguous_or_disconnected'
      END
    END AS cd_order_error
  FROM route_profile AS a
  LEFT JOIN route_walk AS w
    ON a.sk_parent = w.sk_parent
), parent_decision AS (
  SELECT
    p.sk_transaction_data,
    p.cd_eligibility_error,
    q.cd_parent_error,
    o.cd_order_error,
    COALESCE(p.cd_eligibility_error, q.cd_parent_error, o.cd_order_error, 'accepted_logged_parent') AS cd_status
  FROM parent_scope AS p
  LEFT JOIN parent_quality AS q
    ON p.sk_transaction_data = q.sk_transaction_data
  LEFT JOIN chosen_order AS o
    ON p.sk_transaction_data = o.sk_parent
), ordered AS (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    o.cd_ordering_method,
    ARRAY_POSITION(o.arr_order, s.ni_input_ordinal) AS ni_segment_order
  FROM linked_member AS s
  JOIN chosen_order AS o
    ON s.sk_parent = o.sk_parent
  JOIN parent_decision AS d
    ON s.sk_parent = d.sk_transaction_data
  WHERE
    d.cd_status = 'accepted_logged_parent'
), island AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    1 + COALESCE(
      SUM(CASE WHEN cd_applicability = 'ENTRY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
        PARTITION BY sk_parent
        ORDER BY ni_segment_order
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
      ),
      0
    ) AS ni_journey_sequence
  FROM ordered AS o
), journey AS (
  SELECT
    sk_parent,
    ni_journey_sequence,
    ELEMENT_AT(ARRAY_AGG(sk_segment_transaction_data ORDER BY ni_segment_order), 1) AS sk_first_segment,
    ELEMENT_AT(ARRAY_AGG(sk_segment_transaction_data ORDER BY ni_segment_order DESC), 1) AS sk_entry_segment,
    FILTER(
      ARRAY_AGG(
        CASE WHEN cd_applicability = 'TRANSIT' THEN cd_arrival END ORDER BY ni_segment_order
      ),
      value -> NOT value IS NULL
    ) AS arr_transit_point,
    ARRAY_AGG(sk_segment_transaction_data ORDER BY ni_segment_order) AS arr_segment_key,
    ARRAY_AGG(cd_segment_destination_country ORDER BY ni_segment_order) AS arr_segment_destination_country,
    ARRAY_AGG(cd_applicability ORDER BY ni_segment_order) AS arr_segment_applicability,
    ARRAY_AGG(cd_channel_normalized ORDER BY ni_segment_order) AS arr_segment_channel,
    ARRAY_AGG(cd_processing_entity_id ORDER BY ni_segment_order) AS arr_segment_processing_entity_id,
    COUNT(*) AS ni_segment_count,
    COUNT_IF(dt_segment_destination_arrival_utc < dt_segment_departure_utc) AS ni_arrival_before_departure_count,
    MAX(dt_source_load_utc) AS dt_member_source_load_utc
  FROM island
  GROUP BY
    sk_parent,
    ni_journey_sequence
  HAVING
    COUNT_IF(cd_applicability = 'ENTRY') = 1
), account_latest AS (
  SELECT
    nk_account_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sk_account) AS ni_match_count,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sk_account) = 1 THEN MAX(sk_account) END AS sk_account_latest
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_account
  WHERE
    cd_error IS NULL AND is_current = TRUE AND COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
  GROUP BY
    nk_account_id
), user_latest AS (
  SELECT
    nk_user_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sk_user) AS ni_match_count,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sk_user) = 1 THEN MAX(sk_user) END AS sk_user_latest
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_user
  WHERE
    cd_error IS NULL AND is_current = TRUE AND COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
  GROUP BY
    nk_user_id
), document_set AS (
  SELECT
    d.sk_transaction_data,
    COUNT(*) AS ni_document_count,
    COUNT_IF(NULLIF(TRIM(d.cd_document_category), '') IS NULL) AS ni_missing_category_count,
    COUNT_IF(d.dt_source_load_utc IS DISTINCT FROM CAST(p.dt_source_load_utc AS TIMESTAMP(3))) AS ni_version_mismatch_count,
    ARRAY_SORT(
      ARRAY_DISTINCT(
        FILTER(ARRAY_AGG(NULLIF(TRIM(d.cd_document_category), '')), value -> NOT value IS NULL)
      )
    ) AS arr_document_category
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_transaction_document AS d
  JOIN transaction_source AS p
    ON d.sk_transaction_data = p.sk_transaction_data
  WHERE
    d.cd_error IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(d.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND p.ni_parent_key_count = 1
  GROUP BY
    d.sk_transaction_data
), boarding_status_source AS (
  SELECT
    sk_boarding_status,
    nk_boarding_status_document_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(nk_account_id), '') AS nk_account_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(nk_passenger_id), '') AS nk_passenger_id,
    cd_boarding_status,
    dt_boarding_status_utc,
    dt_source_event_utc AS dt_boarding_status_recorded_utc
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.st_boarding_status
  WHERE
    cd_error IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(sk_boarding_status), '') IS NULL
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(nk_boarding_status_document_id), '') IS NULL
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(nk_account_id), '') IS NULL
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(nk_passenger_id), '') IS NULL
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(cd_boarding_status), '') IS NULL
    AND NOT dt_boarding_status_utc IS NULL
    AND NOT dt_source_event_utc IS NULL
), boarding_status_candidate AS (
  SELECT
    t.sk_transaction_data,
    b.sk_boarding_status,
    b.nk_boarding_status_document_id,
    b.cd_boarding_status,
    b.dt_boarding_status_utc,
    b.dt_boarding_status_recorded_utc
  FROM transaction_source AS t
  JOIN boarding_status_source AS b
    ON NULLIF(TRIM(t.nk_account_id), '') = b.nk_account_id
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(t.nk_passenger_id), '') = b.nk_passenger_id
    AND b.dt_boarding_status_utc <= t.dt_transaction_utc
    AND b.dt_boarding_status_recorded_utc <= t.dt_transaction_utc
), boarding_status_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sk_transaction_data ORDER BY dt_boarding_status_utc DESC) AS ni_boarding_status_time_rank
  FROM boarding_status_candidate
), boarding_status_resolved AS (
  SELECT
    sk_transaction_data,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(cd_boarding_status) END AS cd_boarding_status,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(sk_boarding_status) END AS sk_boarding_status_event,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(nk_boarding_status_document_id) END AS nk_boarding_status_document_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(dt_boarding_status_utc) END AS dt_boarding_status_utc,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(dt_boarding_status_recorded_utc) END AS dt_boarding_status_recorded_utc,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) = 1
      THEN 'matched_as_of_query_time'
      ELSE 'ambiguous_latest_timestamp'
    END AS cd_boarding_status_match_status
  FROM boarding_status_ranked
  WHERE
    ni_boarding_status_time_rank = 1
  GROUP BY
    sk_transaction_data
)
SELECT
  TO_HEX(
    SHA256(
      TO_UTF8(
        JSON_FORMAT(CAST(ARRAY[j.sk_parent, CAST(j.ni_journey_sequence AS VARCHAR)] AS JSON))
      )
    )
  ) AS sk_journey_event,
  j.sk_parent AS sk_transaction_event,
  j.sk_first_segment AS sk_first_segment_transaction_event,
  j.sk_entry_segment AS sk_entry_segment_transaction_event,
  a.sk_account_latest,
  u.sk_user_latest,
  TO_HEX(
    SHA256(
      TO_UTF8(
        COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(e.cd_channel_normalized), ''),
          LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(e.cd_channel), '')),
          'unknown'
        )
      )
    )
  ) AS sk_channel,
  TO_HEX(SHA256(TO_UTF8(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.cd_response_evaluation), ''), 'unknown')))) AS sk_response_evaluation,
  p.nk_transaction_document_id,
  p.nk_transaction_id,
  p.nk_request_id,
  p.nk_passenger_id,
  p.nk_account_id,
  p.nk_user_id,
  CAST(j.ni_journey_sequence AS BIGINT) AS ni_journey_sequence,
  p.de_account_name,
  p.cd_processing_entity_id,
  p.de_processing_entity_name,
  p.dt_transaction_utc,
  p.dt_transaction_date,
  f.dt_segment_departure_utc AS dt_journey_departure_utc,
  e.dt_segment_destination_arrival_utc AS dt_journey_arrival_utc,
  CAST(f.dt_segment_departure_utc AS DATE) AS dt_journey_date,
  p.cd_response_evaluation,
  p.de_response_evaluation,
  'source_transaction' AS cd_response_evaluation_scope,
  p.arr_nationality,
  p.arr_nationality_name,
  p.cd_nationality_status,
  p.cd_nationality_source,
  p.cd_residence_country,
  p.de_residence_country_name,
  p.de_age_group,
  p.cd_gender,
  p.de_submitted_gender_name AS de_gender_name,
  p.arr_gender,
  p.arr_gender_name,
  p.cd_gender_status,
  p.cd_gender_source,
  f.cd_departure AS cd_first_departure_point,
  f.de_segment_departure_name AS de_first_departure_name,
  f.cd_departure_type AS cd_first_departure_location_type,
  e.cd_arrival AS cd_final_arrival_point,
  e.de_segment_destination_name AS de_final_arrival_name,
  e.cd_arrival_type AS cd_final_arrival_location_type,
  e.cd_segment_destination_country AS cd_final_destination_country,
  j.arr_transit_point,
  e.cd_channel_normalized,
  e.cd_stay_type,
  e.cd_logged_ticket AS cd_return_onward_ticket,
  e.de_logged_ticket_name AS de_return_onward_ticket_name,
  CASE
    WHEN e.cd_logged_ticket IS NULL
    THEN 'missing_logged_entry_value'
    WHEN NOT e.cd_logged_ticket IN ('TICKET', 'NOTICKET')
    THEN 'unrecognized_logged_entry_value'
    ELSE 'effective_logged_entry'
  END AS cd_return_onward_ticket_status,
  CASE WHEN d.ni_version_mismatch_count = 0 THEN d.arr_document_category END AS arr_document_category,
  CASE
    WHEN d.ni_document_count IS NULL
    THEN 'no_document_child'
    WHEN d.ni_version_mismatch_count > 0
    THEN 'document_version_mismatch'
    WHEN CARDINALITY(d.arr_document_category) = 0
    THEN 'categories_unavailable'
    WHEN d.ni_missing_category_count > 0
    THEN 'partial'
    ELSE 'available'
  END AS cd_document_set_status,
  p.json_request,
  p.cd_request_payload_status,
  p.arr_capture_method,
  p.arr_capture_method_name,
  j.ni_segment_count,
  CAST(1 AS INTEGER) AS ni_journey_count,
  j.arr_segment_key,
  j.arr_segment_destination_country,
  j.arr_segment_applicability,
  j.arr_segment_channel,
  j.arr_segment_processing_entity_id,
  f.cd_ordering_method,
  'logged_segments_only' AS cd_membership_status,
  'logged_timestamp_assumed_utc' AS cd_time_basis,
  j.ni_arrival_before_departure_count,
  CASE
    WHEN a.ni_match_count = 1
    THEN 'matched'
    WHEN a.ni_match_count > 1
    THEN 'ambiguous'
    ELSE 'not_found'
  END AS cd_account_match_status,
  CASE
    WHEN p.nk_user_id IS NULL
    THEN 'source_key_missing'
    WHEN u.ni_match_count = 1
    THEN 'matched'
    WHEN u.ni_match_count > 1
    THEN 'ambiguous'
    ELSE 'not_found'
  END AS cd_user_match_status,
  p.de_source_table,
  p.de_source_file,
  p.dt_source_load_utc,
  j.dt_member_source_load_utc,
  'f06_logged_journey_v1' AS cd_derivation_version,
  CONCAT(
    'LOGGED_MEMBERSHIP_UNVERIFIED|LOGGED_UTC_UNVERIFIED',
    CASE
      WHEN f.dt_segment_departure_utc IS NULL
      OR e.dt_segment_destination_arrival_utc IS NULL
      THEN '|MISSING_JOURNEY_TIME'
      ELSE ''
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN j.ni_arrival_before_departure_count > 0
      THEN '|ARRIVAL_BEFORE_DEPARTURE'
      ELSE ''
    END,
    CASE WHEN e.cd_logged_ticket IS NULL THEN '|MISSING_ENTRY_TICKET' ELSE '' END,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT e.cd_logged_ticket IS NULL
      AND NOT e.cd_logged_ticket IN ('TICKET', 'NOTICKET')
      THEN '|UNKNOWN_ENTRY_TICKET'
      ELSE ''
    END,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.ni_match_count, 0) <> 1 THEN '|ACCOUNT_UNRESOLVED' ELSE '' END,
    CASE
      WHEN d.ni_document_count IS NULL
      OR COALESCE(d.ni_version_mismatch_count, 0) > 0
      OR COALESCE(d.ni_missing_category_count, 0) > 0
      THEN '|DOCUMENT_SET_INCOMPLETE'
      ELSE ''
    END
  ) AS cd_alert,
  'Logged-only derivation; UTC semantics and submitted-leg completeness are not certified. Enforce Account/PE access including full request JSON.' AS de_alert,
  COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(f.dt_segment_departure_utc, '%Y%m%d'), 'undated') AS dt_partition,
  p.source_id,
  p.run_id,
  CAST(AT_TIMEZONE(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'UTC') AS TIMESTAMP) AS dt_load_utc,
  CAST(AT_TIMEZONE(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'UTC') AS TIMESTAMP) AS dt_update_utc,
  p.de_nationality AS de_nationality,
  p.de_nationality_name AS de_nationality_name,
  p.de_submitted_gender AS de_gender,
  COALESCE(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(TRANSFORM(j.arr_transit_point, v -> NULLIF(TRIM(v), '')), v -> NOT v IS NULL),
      ', '
    ),
    ''
  ) AS de_transit_point,
  COALESCE(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(
        TRANSFORM(
          CASE WHEN d.ni_version_mismatch_count = 0 THEN d.arr_document_category END,
          v -> NULLIF(TRIM(v), '')
        ),
        v -> NOT v IS NULL
      ),
      ', '
    ),
    ''
  ) AS de_document_category,
  COALESCE(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(TRANSFORM(p.arr_capture_method, v -> NULLIF(TRIM(v), '')), v -> NOT v IS NULL),
      ', '
    ),
    ''
  ) AS de_capture_method,
  COALESCE(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(TRANSFORM(p.arr_capture_method_name, v -> NULLIF(TRIM(v), '')), v -> NOT v IS NULL),
      ', '
    ),
    ''
  ) AS de_capture_method_name,
  p.de_gender_name AS de_source_gender_name,
  COALESCE(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(TRANSFORM(j.arr_segment_key, v -> NULLIF(TRIM(v), '')), v -> NOT v IS NULL),
      ', '
    ),
    ''
  ) AS de_segment_key,
  COALESCE(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(
        TRANSFORM(j.arr_segment_destination_country, v -> NULLIF(TRIM(v), '')),
        v -> NOT v IS NULL
      ),
      ', '
    ),
    ''
  ) AS de_segment_destination_country,
  COALESCE(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(
        TRANSFORM(j.arr_segment_applicability, v -> NULLIF(TRIM(v), '')),
        v -> NOT v IS NULL
      ),
      ', '
    ),
    ''
  ) AS de_segment_applicability,
  COALESCE(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(TRANSFORM(j.arr_segment_channel, v -> NULLIF(TRIM(v), '')), v -> NOT v IS NULL),
      ', '
    ),
    ''
  ) AS de_segment_channel,
  COALESCE(
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      FILTER(
        TRANSFORM(j.arr_segment_processing_entity_id, v -> NULLIF(TRIM(v), '')),
        v -> NOT v IS NULL
      ),
      ', '
    ),
    ''
  ) AS de_segment_processing_entity_id,
  boarding_status.cd_boarding_status AS cd_boarding_status,
  boarding_status.sk_boarding_status_event AS sk_boarding_status_event,
  boarding_status.nk_boarding_status_document_id AS nk_boarding_status_document_id,
  boarding_status.dt_boarding_status_utc AS dt_boarding_status_utc,
  boarding_status.dt_boarding_status_recorded_utc AS dt_boarding_status_recorded_utc,
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(p.nk_account_id), '') IS NULL
    OR NULLIF(TRIM(p.nk_passenger_id), '') IS NULL
    THEN 'source_key_missing'
    WHEN p.dt_transaction_utc IS NULL
    THEN 'query_time_missing'
    ELSE COALESCE(boarding_status.cd_boarding_status_match_status, 'not_found_as_of_query_time')
  END AS cd_boarding_status_match_status,
  'source_transaction_query_time' AS cd_boarding_status_time_basis
FROM journey AS j
JOIN transaction_source AS p
  ON j.sk_parent = p.sk_transaction_data
LEFT JOIN boarding_status_resolved AS boarding_status
  ON p.sk_transaction_data = boarding_status.sk_transaction_data
JOIN ordered AS f
  ON j.sk_parent = f.sk_parent AND j.sk_first_segment = f.sk_segment_transaction_data
JOIN ordered AS e
  ON j.sk_parent = e.sk_parent AND j.sk_entry_segment = e.sk_segment_transaction_data
LEFT JOIN account_latest AS a
  ON p.nk_account_id = a.nk_account_id
LEFT JOIN user_latest AS u
  ON p.nk_user_id = u.nk_user_id
LEFT JOIN document_set AS d
  ON j.sk_parent = d.sk_transaction_data;

properties.name: dt_partition
properties.description: Date value used by the load. Ordinary column; this table is unpartitioned.

collections.description:
TIM-IDL-F04. Segment counts by Journey and destination country for the map and destination analysis.

One row per Journey date, Journey ID, account, processing entity, user, channel, applicability, purpose of stay, destination country and entry flag. The GROUP BY columns form the business key. ni_segment_count counts segments, not Journeys or passengers.

Journeys are built from transaction and segment facts using transaction ID. Both exclude error evaluations. The segment scan covers seven days either side of the transaction window. A Journey ends at ENTRY; trailing transit segments are excluded. Check transaction ID uniqueness before joining to avoid multiplying segments.
collections.comments:
Sources: fact_segment_transaction_event, fact_transaction_event.

Loaded incrementally by data engineering. Recompute affected Journeys and their segment groups. Remove groups that disappear after a correction.

History: current derived values for the retained events. This table has no load/run audit columns; use the pipeline logs to trace refreshes.

Physical storage: external Parquet, unpartitioned. dt_partition is an ordinary column. Existing table and column names are kept for now; naming changes will be agreed separately.

Checks: grouping-key uniqueness, source totals and join coverage. Keep the exclusions and Journey-eligibility rules in the SELECT.

Keep account/user access rules on report and export paths. Request payloads and passenger/document identifiers remain restricted.
collections.selectStatement:
-- TIM-IDL-F04. Segment counts by Journey and destination country for the map and destination analysis.
-- Set watermark_partition to the source start date (YYYYMMDD).
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    'YYYYMMDD' AS watermark_partition
), eligible_tx AS (
  SELECT
    f.nk_transaction_id,
    f.dt_transaction_utc,
    f.dt_partition
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.fact_transaction_event AS f
  CROSS JOIN params AS p
  WHERE
    f.dt_partition >= p.watermark_partition
    AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(f.cd_response_evaluation, ''))) <> 'error'
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(f.nk_passenger_id), '') IS NULL
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(f.nk_account_id), '') IS NULL
), seg_partition_bound AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD('DAY', -7, DATE_PARSE(MIN(dt_partition), '%Y%m%d')), '%Y%m%d'),
      '19000101'
    ) AS seg_partition_from,
    COALESCE(
      DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD('DAY', 7, DATE_PARSE(MAX(dt_partition), '%Y%m%d')), '%Y%m%d'),
      '19000101'
    ) AS seg_partition_to
  FROM eligible_tx
), seg_raw AS (
  SELECT
    s.nk_transaction_id,
    s.nk_account_id,
    s.sk_account_latest,
    s.cd_processing_entity_id,
    s.de_processing_entity_name,
    s.nk_user_id,
    s.sk_user_latest,
    s.sk_channel,
    s.cd_channel,
    s.cd_channel_normalized,
    s.cd_regulation_applicability,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.cd_regulation_applicability, ''))), '[^A-Z]', '') AS applicability_norm,
    s.cd_stay_type,
    s.sk_segment_destination_country_location_latest,
    s.cd_segment_destination_country,
    s.cd_segment_departure_point,
    s.cd_segment_destination_point,
    s.dt_segment_departure_utc,
    s.dt_segment_destination_arrival_utc,
    t.dt_transaction_utc
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.fact_segment_transaction_event AS s
  INNER JOIN eligible_tx AS t
    ON TRIM(CAST(s.nk_transaction_id AS VARCHAR)) = TRIM(CAST(t.nk_transaction_id AS VARCHAR))
  CROSS JOIN seg_partition_bound AS b
  WHERE
    s.dt_partition BETWEEN b.seg_partition_from AND b.seg_partition_to
    AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.cd_response_evaluation, ''))) <> 'error'
), seg_ordered AS (
  SELECT
    r.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY r.nk_transaction_id
      ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.dt_segment_destination_arrival_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, r.dt_segment_destination_arrival_utc ASC, CASE WHEN r.dt_segment_departure_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, r.dt_segment_departure_utc ASC, r.cd_segment_departure_point ASC, r.cd_segment_destination_point ASC
    ) AS ni_segment_ord
  FROM seg_raw AS r
), seg_journeyed AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    1 + COALESCE(
      SUM(CASE WHEN o.applicability_norm = 'ENTRY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.nk_transaction_id
        ORDER BY o.ni_segment_ord
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
      ),
      0
    ) AS ni_journey_seq
  FROM seg_ordered AS o
), journey_valid AS (
  SELECT
    nk_transaction_id,
    ni_journey_seq
  FROM seg_journeyed
  GROUP BY
    nk_transaction_id,
    ni_journey_seq
  HAVING
    MAX(CASE WHEN applicability_norm = 'ENTRY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
), journey_date AS (
  SELECT
    s.nk_transaction_id,
    s.ni_journey_seq,
    CAST(COALESCE(MIN(s.dt_segment_departure_utc), MIN(s.dt_transaction_utc)) AS DATE) AS dt_journey_date
  FROM seg_journeyed AS s
  INNER JOIN journey_valid AS v
    ON s.nk_transaction_id = v.nk_transaction_id AND s.ni_journey_seq = v.ni_journey_seq
  GROUP BY
    s.nk_transaction_id,
    s.ni_journey_seq
), seg_final AS (
  SELECT
    CONCAT(s.nk_transaction_id, '|', CAST(s.ni_journey_seq AS VARCHAR)) AS nk_journey_id,
    d.dt_journey_date AS dt_event_date,
    s.nk_account_id,
    s.sk_account_latest,
    s.cd_processing_entity_id,
    s.de_processing_entity_name,
    s.nk_user_id,
    s.sk_user_latest,
    s.sk_channel,
    s.cd_channel,
    s.cd_channel_normalized,
    s.cd_regulation_applicability,
    s.cd_stay_type,
    s.sk_segment_destination_country_location_latest,
    s.cd_segment_destination_country,
    CASE WHEN s.applicability_norm = 'ENTRY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_entry_segment
  FROM seg_journeyed AS s
  INNER JOIN journey_valid AS v
    ON s.nk_transaction_id = v.nk_transaction_id AND s.ni_journey_seq = v.ni_journey_seq
  INNER JOIN journey_date AS d
    ON s.nk_transaction_id = d.nk_transaction_id AND s.ni_journey_seq = d.ni_journey_seq
)
SELECT
  f.dt_event_date,
  f.nk_journey_id,
  f.nk_account_id,
  f.sk_account_latest,
  f.cd_processing_entity_id,
  f.de_processing_entity_name,
  f.nk_user_id,
  f.sk_user_latest,
  f.sk_channel,
  f.cd_channel,
  f.cd_channel_normalized,
  f.cd_regulation_applicability,
  f.cd_stay_type,
  f.sk_segment_destination_country_location_latest,
  f.cd_segment_destination_country,
  f.is_entry_segment,
  COUNT(*) AS ni_segment_count,
  DATE_FORMAT(CAST(f.dt_event_date AS TIMESTAMP), '%Y%m%d') AS dt_partition
FROM seg_final AS f
GROUP BY
  f.dt_event_date,
  f.nk_journey_id,
  f.nk_account_id,
  f.sk_account_latest,
  f.cd_processing_entity_id,
  f.de_processing_entity_name,
  f.nk_user_id,
  f.sk_user_latest,
  f.sk_channel,
  f.cd_channel,
  f.cd_channel_normalized,
  f.cd_regulation_applicability,
  f.cd_stay_type,
  f.sk_segment_destination_country_location_latest,
  f.cd_segment_destination_country,
  f.is_entry_segment;

collections.description:
TIM-IDL-F04. Transaction counts for the Executive Overview.

One row per transaction date, transaction ID, passenger, account, processing entity, user, channel, evaluation result, request type and Journey-eligibility combination. The GROUP BY columns form the business key. There is no separate surrogate key.

ni_tx_count counts source transaction rows and can be summed across these groups. Error evaluations are excluded. Rows without an account or passenger can still count as transactions, but are not eligible for Journey construction.
collections.comments:
Sources: fact_transaction_event.

Loaded incrementally by data engineering. For a correction, recompute both the old and new grouping rows; a rerun must not append the same counts again.

History: current derived values for the retained events. This table has no load/run audit columns; use the pipeline logs to trace refreshes.

Physical storage: external Parquet, unpartitioned. dt_partition is an ordinary column. Existing table and column names are kept for now; naming changes will be agreed separately.

Checks: grouping-key uniqueness, source totals and join coverage. Keep the exclusions and Journey-eligibility rules in the SELECT.

Keep account/user access rules on report and export paths. Request payloads and passenger/document identifiers remain restricted.
collections.selectStatement:
-- TIM-IDL-F04. Transaction counts for the Executive Overview.
-- Set watermark_partition to the source start date (YYYYMMDD).
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    'YYYYMMDD' AS watermark_partition
), tx AS (
  SELECT
    f.nk_transaction_id,
    CAST(f.dt_transaction_utc AS DATE) AS dt_event_date,
    f.nk_passenger_id,
    f.nk_account_id,
    f.sk_account_latest,
    f.cd_processing_entity_id,
    f.de_processing_entity_name,
    f.nk_user_id,
    f.sk_user_latest,
    f.sk_channel,
    f.cd_channel,
    f.cd_channel_normalized,
    f.cd_response_evaluation,
    f.cd_request_type,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT NULLIF(TRIM(f.nk_passenger_id), '') IS NULL
      AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(f.nk_account_id), '') IS NULL
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_journey_eligible_tx
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.fact_transaction_event AS f
  CROSS JOIN params AS p
  WHERE
    f.dt_partition >= p.watermark_partition
    AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(f.cd_response_evaluation, ''))) <> 'error'
)
SELECT
  t.dt_event_date,
  t.nk_transaction_id,
  t.nk_passenger_id,
  t.nk_account_id,
  t.sk_account_latest,
  t.cd_processing_entity_id,
  t.de_processing_entity_name,
  t.nk_user_id,
  t.sk_user_latest,
  t.sk_channel,
  t.cd_channel,
  t.cd_channel_normalized,
  t.cd_response_evaluation,
  t.cd_request_type,
  t.is_journey_eligible_tx,
  COUNT(*) AS ni_tx_count,
  DATE_FORMAT(CAST(t.dt_event_date AS TIMESTAMP), '%Y%m%d') AS dt_partition
FROM tx AS t
GROUP BY
  t.dt_event_date,
  t.nk_transaction_id,
  t.nk_passenger_id,
  t.nk_account_id,
  t.sk_account_latest,
  t.cd_processing_entity_id,
  t.de_processing_entity_name,
  t.nk_user_id,
  t.sk_user_latest,
  t.sk_channel,
  t.cd_channel,
  t.cd_channel_normalized,
  t.cd_response_evaluation,
  t.cd_request_type,
  t.is_journey_eligible_tx;

collections.description:
TIM-IDL-F04. Journey detail for the Executive Overview.

One row per ENTRY-ended Journey within an eligible transaction. nk_journey_id is transaction ID plus Journey sequence. The combination must be unique; it uses a different key recipe from fact_journey_event. One transaction can have several Journeys.

Transactions need an account and passenger ID. Transaction and segment error evaluations are excluded; request type is not an eligibility condition. Segments are ordered and grouped up to each ENTRY. Journey date comes from the first departure, with transaction UTC as the fallback. Channel and purpose of stay come from the ENTRY segment. Trailing transit is excluded.

Count rows at Journey grain before expanding segments or joining documents. Transaction ID uniqueness is required for the source join. A corrected itinerary can change the sequence and Journey key.
collections.comments:
Sources: fact_segment_transaction_event, fact_transaction_event.

Loaded incrementally by data engineering. Rebuild all Journeys for an affected transaction and remove obsolete sequences. Do not append the rebuilt set to the old one.

History: current derived values for the retained events. This table has no load/run audit columns; use the pipeline logs to trace refreshes.

Physical storage: external Parquet, unpartitioned. dt_partition is an ordinary column. Existing table and column names are kept for now; naming changes will be agreed separately.

Checks: grouping-key uniqueness, source totals and join coverage. Keep the exclusions and Journey-eligibility rules in the SELECT.

For review: this detail table reads consumption facts. Agree the move to CONFORMED inputs with Bryn and data engineering.

Keep account/user access rules on report and export paths. Request payloads and passenger/document identifiers remain restricted.

-- TIM-IDL-F04. Journey detail for the Executive Overview.
-- Set watermark_partition to the source start date (YYYYMMDD).
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    'YYYYMMDD' AS watermark_partition
), eligible_tx AS (
  SELECT
    f.nk_transaction_id,
    f.nk_passenger_id,
    f.nk_account_id,
    f.sk_account_latest,
    f.dt_transaction_utc,
    f.cd_processing_entity_id,
    f.de_processing_entity_name,
    f.nk_user_id,
    f.sk_user_latest,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(f.json_itinerary_details), ''), '(unknown)') AS de_itinerary_key,
    CONCAT(
      TRIM(f.nk_passenger_id),
      '|',
      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(f.json_itinerary_details), ''), '(unknown)')
    ) AS de_passenger_itinerary_key,
    f.dt_partition
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.fact_transaction_event AS f
  CROSS JOIN params AS p
  WHERE
    f.dt_partition >= p.watermark_partition
    AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(f.cd_response_evaluation, ''))) <> 'error'
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(f.nk_passenger_id), '') IS NULL
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(f.nk_account_id), '') IS NULL
), seg_partition_bound AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD('DAY', -7, DATE_PARSE(MIN(dt_partition), '%Y%m%d')), '%Y%m%d'),
      '19000101'
    ) AS seg_partition_from,
    COALESCE(
      DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD('DAY', 7, DATE_PARSE(MAX(dt_partition), '%Y%m%d')), '%Y%m%d'),
      '19000101'
    ) AS seg_partition_to
  FROM eligible_tx
), seg_raw AS (
  SELECT
    s.nk_transaction_id,
    t.nk_passenger_id,
    t.nk_account_id,
    t.sk_account_latest,
    t.cd_processing_entity_id,
    t.de_processing_entity_name,
    t.nk_user_id,
    t.sk_user_latest,
    t.de_itinerary_key,
    t.de_passenger_itinerary_key,
    t.dt_transaction_utc,
    s.cd_channel_normalized,
    s.sk_channel,
    s.cd_channel,
    s.cd_regulation_applicability,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.cd_regulation_applicability, ''))), '[^A-Z]', '') AS applicability_norm,
    s.cd_stay_type,
    s.sk_segment_destination_country_location_latest,
    s.cd_segment_destination_country,
    s.cd_segment_departure_point,
    s.cd_segment_destination_point,
    s.dt_segment_departure_utc,
    s.dt_segment_destination_arrival_utc,
    s.dt_partition
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.fact_segment_transaction_event AS s
  INNER JOIN eligible_tx AS t
    ON TRIM(CAST(s.nk_transaction_id AS VARCHAR)) = TRIM(CAST(t.nk_transaction_id AS VARCHAR))
  CROSS JOIN seg_partition_bound AS b
  WHERE
    s.dt_partition BETWEEN b.seg_partition_from AND b.seg_partition_to
    AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.cd_response_evaluation, ''))) <> 'error'
), seg_ordered AS (
  SELECT
    r.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY r.nk_transaction_id
      ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.dt_segment_destination_arrival_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, r.dt_segment_destination_arrival_utc ASC, CASE WHEN r.dt_segment_departure_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, r.dt_segment_departure_utc ASC, r.cd_segment_departure_point ASC, r.cd_segment_destination_point ASC
    ) AS ni_segment_ord,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.nk_transaction_id) > 1
      AND (
        COUNT(r.dt_segment_destination_arrival_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY r.nk_transaction_id) = 0
        OR MIN(r.dt_segment_destination_arrival_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY r.nk_transaction_id) = MAX(r.dt_segment_destination_arrival_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY r.nk_transaction_id)
      )
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_ordering_ambiguous
  FROM seg_raw AS r
), seg_journeyed AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    1 + COALESCE(
      SUM(CASE WHEN o.applicability_norm = 'ENTRY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.nk_transaction_id
        ORDER BY o.ni_segment_ord
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
      ),
      0
    ) AS ni_journey_seq
  FROM seg_ordered AS o
), journey_valid AS (
  SELECT
    j.nk_transaction_id,
    j.ni_journey_seq
  FROM seg_journeyed AS j
  GROUP BY
    j.nk_transaction_id,
    j.ni_journey_seq
  HAVING
    MAX(CASE WHEN j.applicability_norm = 'ENTRY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
), journey_segs AS (
  SELECT
    s.*
  FROM seg_journeyed AS s
  INNER JOIN journey_valid AS v
    ON s.nk_transaction_id = v.nk_transaction_id AND s.ni_journey_seq = v.ni_journey_seq
), entry_seg AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      s.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.nk_transaction_id, s.ni_journey_seq ORDER BY s.ni_segment_ord DESC) AS rn_entry_desc
    FROM journey_segs AS s
    WHERE
      s.applicability_norm = 'ENTRY'
  ) AS e
  WHERE
    rn_entry_desc = 1
), journey_agg AS (
  SELECT
    s.nk_transaction_id,
    s.ni_journey_seq,
    MIN(s.nk_passenger_id) AS nk_passenger_id,
    MIN(s.nk_account_id) AS nk_account_id,
    MIN(s.sk_account_latest) AS sk_account_latest,
    MIN(s.cd_processing_entity_id) AS cd_processing_entity_id,
    MIN(s.de_processing_entity_name) AS de_processing_entity_name,
    MIN(s.nk_user_id) AS nk_user_id,
    MIN(s.sk_user_latest) AS sk_user_latest,
    MIN(s.de_itinerary_key) AS de_itinerary_key,
    MIN(s.de_passenger_itinerary_key) AS de_passenger_itinerary_key,
    COALESCE(MIN(s.dt_segment_departure_utc), MIN(s.dt_transaction_utc)) AS dt_journey_start_utc,
    CAST(COALESCE(MIN(s.dt_segment_departure_utc), MIN(s.dt_transaction_utc)) AS DATE) AS dt_journey_date,
    COUNT(*) AS ni_segment_count,
    MAX(s.is_ordering_ambiguous) AS is_ordering_ambiguous,
    MIN(s.dt_partition) AS dt_partition_src
  FROM journey_segs AS s
  GROUP BY
    s.nk_transaction_id,
    s.ni_journey_seq
)
SELECT
  CONCAT(a.nk_transaction_id, '|', CAST(a.ni_journey_seq AS VARCHAR)) AS nk_journey_id,
  a.ni_journey_seq,
  a.nk_transaction_id,
  a.nk_passenger_id,
  a.nk_account_id,
  a.sk_account_latest,
  a.cd_processing_entity_id,
  a.de_processing_entity_name,
  a.nk_user_id,
  a.sk_user_latest,
  a.de_itinerary_key,
  a.de_passenger_itinerary_key,
  a.dt_journey_date,
  a.dt_journey_start_utc,
  e.cd_channel_normalized,
  e.sk_channel,
  e.cd_channel,
  e.cd_stay_type,
  e.sk_segment_destination_country_location_latest AS sk_final_destination_country_location_latest,
  e.cd_segment_destination_country AS cd_final_destination_country,
  a.ni_segment_count,
  a.is_ordering_ambiguous,
  DATE_FORMAT(CAST(a.dt_journey_date AS TIMESTAMP), '%Y%m%d') AS dt_partition
FROM journey_agg AS a
INNER JOIN entry_seg AS e
  ON a.nk_transaction_id = e.nk_transaction_id AND a.ni_journey_seq = e.ni_journey_seq;

collections.description:
TIM-IDL-F04-03. First and final evaluation results for each passenger/itinerary sequence.

One row per passenger ID and itinerary string. de_passenger_itinerary_key combines the trimmed passenger ID and itinerary, using an unknown marker when the itinerary is missing. The table has no account or user columns, so cross-account passenger identity and report scoping need to be checked.

Error evaluations and rows without a passenger ID are excluded. Transaction time and transaction ID determine the first and last evaluations. ni_tx_count counts evaluations in the sequence. The result fields and flags are sequence-level values, not additive measures.

The stored sequence covers the input used by the load. Arbitrary report ranges and the W-hour observation window need separate handling. The final bucket currently uses the final result alone, while the Conditional and Not OK flags also exclude an earlier OK. Align the bucket with the funnel rule before using it for that KPI.
collections.comments:
Sources: fact_transaction_event.

Loaded incrementally by data engineering. Recompute the complete affected passenger/itinerary sequence, including earlier evaluations. Loading only its newest rows would change first/final results.

History: current derived values for the retained events. This table has no load/run audit columns; use the pipeline logs to trace refreshes.

Physical storage: external Parquet, unpartitioned. dt_partition is an ordinary column. Existing table and column names are kept for now; naming changes will be agreed separately.

Checks: grouping-key uniqueness, source totals and join coverage. Keep the exclusions and Journey-eligibility rules in the SELECT.

Keep account/user access rules on report and export paths. Request payloads and passenger/document identifiers remain restricted.
collections.selectStatement:
-- TIM-IDL-F04-03. First and final evaluation results for each passenger/itinerary sequence.
-- Set watermark_partition to the source start date (YYYYMMDD).
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    'YYYYMMDD' AS watermark_partition
), tx AS (
  SELECT
    f.nk_passenger_id,
    f.nk_transaction_id,
    f.dt_transaction_utc,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(f.json_itinerary_details), ''), '(unknown)') AS de_itinerary_key,
    CONCAT(
      TRIM(f.nk_passenger_id),
      '|',
      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(f.json_itinerary_details), ''), '(unknown)')
    ) AS de_passenger_itinerary_key,
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(f.cd_response_evaluation, '')) LIKE '%not_ok%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(f.cd_response_evaluation, '')) LIKE '%not ok%'
      THEN 'not_ok_to_board'
      WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(f.cd_response_evaluation, '')) LIKE '%conditional%'
      THEN 'conditional'
      WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(f.cd_response_evaluation, '')) IN ('ok', 'ok_to_board')
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(f.cd_response_evaluation, '')) LIKE '%ok_to_board%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(f.cd_response_evaluation, '')) LIKE '%ok to board%'
      THEN 'ok_to_board'
      ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(f.cd_response_evaluation)), ''), 'unknown')
    END AS norm_eval
  FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.fact_transaction_event AS f
  CROSS JOIN params AS p
  WHERE
    f.dt_partition >= p.watermark_partition
    AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(f.cd_response_evaluation, ''))) <> 'error'
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(f.nk_passenger_id), '') IS NULL
), ordered AS (
  SELECT
    t.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY t.de_passenger_itinerary_key
      ORDER BY t.dt_transaction_utc ASC, t.nk_transaction_id ASC
    ) AS rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY t.de_passenger_itinerary_key
      ORDER BY t.dt_transaction_utc DESC, t.nk_transaction_id DESC
    ) AS rn_desc,
    MIN(t.dt_transaction_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY t.de_passenger_itinerary_key) AS dt_first_eval_utc,
    MAX(t.dt_transaction_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY t.de_passenger_itinerary_key) AS dt_last_eval_utc,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t.de_passenger_itinerary_key) AS ni_tx_count
  FROM tx AS t
), first_last AS (
  SELECT
    f.nk_passenger_id,
    f.de_itinerary_key,
    f.de_passenger_itinerary_key,
    f.dt_first_eval_utc,
    f.dt_last_eval_utc,
    f.ni_tx_count,
    f.norm_eval AS norm_first,
    l.norm_eval AS norm_final,
    CAST(f.dt_first_eval_utc AS DATE) AS dt_first_eval_date
  FROM ordered AS f
  INNER JOIN ordered AS l
    ON f.de_passenger_itinerary_key = l.de_passenger_itinerary_key
    AND f.rn_asc = 1
    AND l.rn_desc = 1
), flags AS (
  SELECT
    fl.*,
    MIN(
      CASE
        WHEN o.norm_eval IN ('conditional', 'not_ok_to_board')
        THEN o.dt_transaction_utc
      END
    ) AS dt_first_bad_eval_utc,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN o.rn_asc < fl.ni_tx_count AND o.norm_eval = 'ok_to_board'
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS has_earlier_ok_before_final
  FROM first_last AS fl
  INNER JOIN ordered AS o
    ON fl.de_passenger_itinerary_key = o.de_passenger_itinerary_key
  GROUP BY
    fl.nk_passenger_id,
    fl.de_itinerary_key,
    fl.de_passenger_itinerary_key,
    fl.dt_first_eval_utc,
    fl.dt_last_eval_utc,
    fl.ni_tx_count,
    fl.norm_first,
    fl.norm_final,
    fl.dt_first_eval_date
)
SELECT
  nk_passenger_id,
  de_itinerary_key,
  de_passenger_itinerary_key,
  dt_first_eval_date,
  dt_first_eval_utc,
  dt_last_eval_utc,
  dt_first_bad_eval_utc,
  ni_tx_count,
  norm_first,
  norm_final,
  CASE
    WHEN norm_first = 'ok_to_board' AND dt_first_bad_eval_utc IS NULL
    THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS is_first_time_ok,
  CASE
    WHEN norm_final = 'conditional' AND has_earlier_ok_before_final = 0
    THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS is_conditional_final,
  CASE
    WHEN norm_final = 'not_ok_to_board' AND has_earlier_ok_before_final = 0
    THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS is_not_ok_final,
  CASE
    WHEN norm_final = 'ok_to_board' AND ni_tx_count = 1
    THEN 'ok_in_1'
    WHEN norm_final = 'ok_to_board' AND ni_tx_count = 2
    THEN 'ok_in_2'
    WHEN norm_final = 'ok_to_board' AND ni_tx_count >= 3
    THEN 'ok_in_3_plus'
    WHEN norm_final = 'conditional'
    THEN 'conditional_final'
    WHEN norm_final = 'not_ok_to_board'
    THEN 'not_ok_final'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS cd_final_eval_bucket,
  CASE
    WHEN norm_final = 'ok_to_board' AND ni_tx_count = 1
    THEN 1
    WHEN norm_final = 'ok_to_board' AND ni_tx_count = 2
    THEN 2
    WHEN norm_final = 'ok_to_board' AND ni_tx_count >= 3
    THEN 3
    WHEN norm_final = 'conditional'
    THEN 4
    WHEN norm_final = 'not_ok_to_board'
    THEN 5
    ELSE 6
  END AS ni_final_eval_bucket_sort,
  DATE_FORMAT(CAST(dt_first_eval_date AS TIMESTAMP), '%Y%m%d') AS dt_partition
FROM flags;

TIM-IDL-F05-01/02. Journey counts by nationality and final destination.

One row per daily Journey counting group and scalar filter combination. The row key follows the grouping recipe in the SELECT and must be unique. Nationality groups can overlap, so their sum is not necessarily the distinct Journey total.

cd_final_destination_country is the final Journey destination used by the chart. cd_destination_country belongs to the logged segment and is used by the destination filter.

Filter first, then take MAX(ni_journey_count) per counting context and displayed category, then SUM. The count repeats across scalar filter rows. sk_journey_filter_context identifies the counting group, not a single Journey or a foreign key.

Destination, applicability, purpose, ticket, channel and processing entity must belong to the same logged segment. Document category, type and issuer must belong to the same document. Duration is request-wide and must be read with its unit and status; it is not linked to a destination or segment. Missing filter values retain their status so they do not silently remove Journeys. Dates use Journey departure date.
collections.comments:
Sources: fact_journey_event, fact_segment_transaction_event, fact_transaction_document_event, fact_transaction_event.

Loaded incrementally by data engineering. Recompute the complete affected counting groups, including their old keys and scalar combinations. Remove groups that disappear; do not add deltas to repeated counts.

History: current derived values for the retained events. To trace a group back to its Journeys, rerun the membership and key logic against the corresponding source version.

Checks: unique row key, positive and consistent counts within each context, and Journey totals matching the source after deduplication. Keep unknown classifications and parsing failures visible.

Keep account/user access rules on report and export paths. Request payloads and passenger/document identifiers remain restricted.
collections.selectStatement:
-- TIM-IDL-F05-01/02. Journey counts by nationality and final destination.
-- Apply report filters before context MAX and SUM. See the table notes for counting rules.
-- Supply run_id through the load orchestration.
WITH base AS (
  WITH candidate AS (
    WITH base AS (
      WITH source AS (
        SELECT
          *
        FROM (
          SELECT
            *
          FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.fact_journey_event
        ) AS bounded_journey
      ), parent AS (
        SELECT
          t.*
        FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.fact_transaction_event AS t
        WHERE
          t.sk_transaction_event IN (
            SELECT
              sk_transaction_event
            FROM source
          )
      ), document_filter AS (
        SELECT
          d.sk_transaction_event,
          ARRAY_SORT(
            ARRAY_DISTINCT(
              ARRAY_AGG(
                JSON_FORMAT(
                  CAST(ARRAY[NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(d.cd_document_category)), ''), NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(d.cd_document_type)), ''), NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(d.cd_document_issue_country)), '')] AS JSON)
                )
              )
            )
          ) AS arr_document_filter
        FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.fact_transaction_document_event AS d
        WHERE
          d.sk_transaction_event IN (
            SELECT
              sk_transaction_event
            FROM parent
          )
        GROUP BY
          1
      ), membership AS (
        SELECT
          s.sk_journey_event AS sk_event,
          k.sk_segment_event
        FROM source AS s
        CROSS JOIN UNNEST(s.arr_segment_key) AS k(sk_segment_event)
      ), segment_filter AS (
        SELECT
          m.sk_event,
          ARRAY_SORT(
            ARRAY_DISTINCT(
              ARRAY_AGG(
                JSON_FORMAT(
                  CAST(ARRAY[NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_segment_destination_country)), ''), NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_regulation_applicability)), ''), NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_stay_type)), ''), NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_logged_ticket)), ''), s.cd_channel_normalized, s.cd_processing_entity_id, JSON_FORMAT(TRY(JSON_PARSE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.json_rule_sets_and_response), ''))))] AS JSON)
                )
              )
            )
          ) AS arr_segment_filter
        FROM membership AS m
        JOIN timatic4datarepositorydev.fact_segment_transaction_event AS s
          ON m.sk_segment_event = s.sk_segment_transaction_event
        GROUP BY
          1
      ), request_duration AS (
        SELECT
          p.sk_transaction_event,
          ARRAY_SORT(
            ARRAY_DISTINCT(
              ARRAY_AGG(
                JSON_FORMAT(
                  CAST(ARRAY[TRY(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(l.item, '$.departure.point')), TRY(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(l.item, '$.departure.type')), TRY(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(l.item, '$.arrival.point')), TRY(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(l.item, '$.arrival.type')), TRY(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(l.item, '$.durationOfStay.duration')), TRY(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(l.item, '$.durationOfStay.timeUnit'))] AS JSON)
                )
              )
            )
          ) AS arr_request_duration_filter
        FROM parent AS p
        CROSS JOIN UNNEST(TRY(
          CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(TRY(JSON_PARSE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.json_request), ''))), '$.itineraryDetails.segments') AS ARRAY(JSON))
        )) AS l(item)
        GROUP BY
          1
      ), context AS (
        SELECT
          s.sk_journey_event AS sk_event,
          s.dt_journey_date AS dt_event_date,
          p.nk_account_id AS nk_account_id,
          p.sk_account_latest AS sk_account_latest,
          p.nk_user_id AS nk_user_id,
          p.sk_user_latest AS sk_user_latest,
          p.cd_processing_entity_id AS cd_processing_entity_id,
          s.sk_channel AS sk_channel,
          s.cd_channel_normalized AS cd_channel_normalized,
          s.cd_response_evaluation AS cd_response_evaluation,
          p.cd_passenger_type AS cd_passenger_type,
          ARRAY_SORT(
            ARRAY_DISTINCT(
              TRANSFORM(
                FILTER(
                  COALESCE(p.arr_nationality, CAST(ARRAY[] AS ARRAY(VARCHAR))),
                  x -> NOT NULLIF(TRIM(x), '') IS NULL
                ),
                x -> UPPER(TRIM(x))
              )
            )
          ) AS arr_nationality,
          ARRAY_SORT(
            ARRAY_DISTINCT(
              TRANSFORM(
                FILTER(
                  COALESCE(p.arr_gender, CAST(ARRAY[] AS ARRAY(VARCHAR))),
                  x -> NOT NULLIF(TRIM(x), '') IS NULL
                ),
                x -> UPPER(TRIM(x))
              )
            )
          ) AS arr_gender,
          ARRAY_SORT(
            ARRAY_DISTINCT(
              TRANSFORM(
                FILTER(
                  COALESCE(p.arr_processing_entity_id, CAST(ARRAY[] AS ARRAY(VARCHAR))),
                  x -> NOT NULLIF(TRIM(x), '') IS NULL
                ),
                x -> TRIM(x)
              )
            )
          ) AS arr_authorization_processing_entity_id,
          COALESCE(d.arr_document_filter, CAST(ARRAY[] AS ARRAY(VARCHAR))) AS arr_document_filter,
          COALESCE(m.arr_segment_filter, CAST(ARRAY[] AS ARRAY(VARCHAR))) AS arr_segment_filter,
          COALESCE(r.arr_request_duration_filter, CAST(ARRAY[] AS ARRAY(VARCHAR))) AS arr_request_duration_filter,
          CASE
            WHEN d.sk_transaction_event IS NULL
            THEN 'no_document_fact'
            ELSE 'retained_document_rows'
          END AS cd_document_filter_status,
          CASE
            WHEN m.sk_event IS NULL
            THEN 'no_linked_segment'
            ELSE 'retained_linked_segments'
          END AS cd_segment_filter_status,
          CASE
            WHEN r.sk_transaction_event IS NULL
            THEN 'request_array_unavailable_or_empty'
            ELSE 'request_scope_not_logged_leg_mapping'
          END AS cd_request_duration_status,
          NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_final_destination_country)), '') AS cd_final_destination_country,
          NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_stay_type)), '') AS cd_stay_type,
          NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_return_onward_ticket)), '') AS cd_return_onward_ticket
        FROM source AS s
        JOIN parent AS p
          ON s.sk_transaction_event = p.sk_transaction_event
        LEFT JOIN document_filter AS d
          ON p.sk_transaction_event = d.sk_transaction_event
        LEFT JOIN segment_filter AS m
          ON s.sk_journey_event = m.sk_event
        LEFT JOIN request_duration AS r
          ON p.sk_transaction_event = r.sk_transaction_event
      ), expanded AS (
        SELECT
          c.*,
          n.cd_nationality
        FROM context AS c
        CROSS JOIN UNNEST(CASE
          WHEN CARDINALITY(c.arr_nationality) = 0
          THEN ARRAY[CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)]
          ELSE c.arr_nationality
        END) AS n(cd_nationality)

collections.description:
TIM-IDL-F05-01/06. Submitted residence-permit evidence where residence and nationality differ.

One row per daily Journey counting group, residence/permit classification and scalar filter combination. The row key follows the grouping recipe in the SELECT and must be unique.

Keep eligibility, assessment, permit presence and result separate. Country aliases are resolved through st_location only when the mapping is unambiguous. Missing or uncertain country/document classifications retain their status. The permit allowlist is provisional. A matching document is not proof of legal validity. Use the eligible and assessed populations for the relevant denominator.

Filter first, then take MAX(ni_journey_count) per counting context and displayed category, then SUM. The count repeats across scalar filter rows. sk_journey_filter_context identifies the counting group, not a single Journey or a foreign key.

Destination, applicability, purpose, ticket, channel and processing entity must belong to the same logged segment. Document category, type and issuer must belong to the same document. Duration is request-wide and must be read with its unit and status; it is not linked to a destination or segment. Missing filter values retain their status so they do not silently remove Journeys. Dates use Journey departure date.
collections.comments:
Sources: fact_journey_event, fact_segment_transaction_event, fact_transaction_document_event, fact_transaction_event, st_location.

Loaded incrementally by data engineering. Recompute the complete affected counting groups, including their old keys and scalar combinations. Remove groups that disappear; do not add deltas to repeated counts.

History: current derived values for the retained events. To trace a group back to its Journeys, rerun the membership and key logic against the corresponding source version.

Checks: unique row key, positive and consistent counts within each context, and Journey totals matching the source after deduplication. Keep unknown classifications and parsing failures visible.

Keep account/user access rules on report and export paths. Request payloads and passenger/document identifiers remain restricted.
collections.selectStatement:
-- TIM-IDL-F05-01/06. Submitted residence-permit evidence where residence and nationality differ.
-- Apply report filters before context MAX and SUM. See the table notes for counting rules.
-- Supply run_id through the load orchestration.
WITH base AS (
  WITH candidate AS (
    WITH context AS (
      WITH source AS (
        SELECT
          *
        FROM (
          SELECT
            *
          FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.fact_journey_event
        ) AS bounded_journey
      ), parent AS (
        SELECT
          t.*
        FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.fact_transaction_event AS t
        WHERE
          t.sk_transaction_event IN (
            SELECT
              sk_transaction_event
            FROM source
          )
      ), document_filter AS (
        SELECT
          d.sk_transaction_event,
          ARRAY_SORT(
            ARRAY_DISTINCT(
              ARRAY_AGG(
                JSON_FORMAT(
                  CAST(ARRAY[NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(d.cd_document_category)), ''), NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(d.cd_document_type)), ''), NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(d.cd_document_issue_country)), '')] AS JSON)
                )
              )
            )
          ) AS arr_document_filter
        FROM timatic4datarepositorydev.fact_transaction_document_event AS d
        WHERE
          d.sk_transaction_event IN (
            SELECT
              sk_transaction_event
            FROM parent
          )
        GROUP BY
          1
      ), membership AS (
        SELECT
          s.sk_journey_event AS sk_event,
          k.sk_segment_event
        FROM source AS s
        CROSS JOIN UNNEST(s.arr_segment_key) AS k(sk_segment_event)
      ), segment_filter AS (
        SELECT
          m.sk_event,
          ARRAY_SORT(
            ARRAY_DISTINCT(
              ARRAY_AGG(
                JSON_FORMAT(
                  CAST(ARRAY[NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_segment_destination_country)), ''), NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_regulation_applicability)), ''), NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_stay_type)), ''), NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_logged_ticket)), ''), s.cd_channel_normalized, s.cd_processing_entity_id, JSON_FORMAT(TRY(JSON_PARSE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.json_rule_sets_and_response), ''))))] AS JSON)
                )
              )
            )
          ) AS arr_segment_filter
        FROM membership AS m
        JOIN timatic4datarepositorydev.fact_segment_transaction_event AS s
          ON m.sk_segment_event = s.sk_segment_transaction_event
        GROUP BY
          1
      ), request_duration AS (
        SELECT
          p.sk_transaction_event,
          ARRAY_SORT(
            ARRAY_DISTINCT(
              ARRAY_AGG(
                JSON_FORMAT(
                  CAST(ARRAY[TRY(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(l.item, '$.departure.point')), TRY(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(l.item, '$.departure.type')), TRY(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(l.item, '$.arrival.point')), TRY(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(l.item, '$.arrival.type')), TRY(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(l.item, '$.durationOfStay.duration')), TRY(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(l.item, '$.durationOfStay.timeUnit'))] AS JSON)
                )
              )
            )
          ) AS arr_request_duration_filter
        FROM parent AS p
        CROSS JOIN UNNEST(TRY(
          CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(TRY(JSON_PARSE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.json_request), ''))), '$.itineraryDetails.segments') AS ARRAY(JSON))
        )) AS l(item)
        GROUP BY
          1
      ), context AS (
        SELECT
          s.sk_journey_event AS sk_event,
          s.dt_journey_date AS dt_event_date,
          p.nk_account_id AS nk_account_id,
          p.sk_account_latest AS sk_account_latest,
          p.nk_user_id AS nk_user_id,
          p.sk_user_latest AS sk_user_latest,
          p.cd_processing_entity_id AS cd_processing_entity_id,
          s.sk_channel AS sk_channel,
          s.cd_channel_normalized AS cd_channel_normalized,
          s.cd_response_evaluation AS cd_response_evaluation,
          p.cd_passenger_type AS cd_passenger_type,
          ARRAY_SORT(
            ARRAY_DISTINCT(
              TRANSFORM(
                FILTER(
                  COALESCE(p.arr_nationality, CAST(ARRAY[] AS ARRAY(VARCHAR))),
                  x -> NOT NULLIF(TRIM(x), '') IS NULL
                ),
                x -> UPPER(TRIM(x))
              )
            )
          ) AS arr_nationality,
          ARRAY_SORT(
            ARRAY_DISTINCT(
              TRANSFORM(
                FILTER(
                  COALESCE(p.arr_gender, CAST(ARRAY[] AS ARRAY(VARCHAR))),
                  x -> NOT NULLIF(TRIM(x), '') IS NULL
                ),
                x -> UPPER(TRIM(x))
              )
            )
          ) AS arr_gender,
          ARRAY_SORT(
            ARRAY_DISTINCT(
              TRANSFORM(
                FILTER(
                  COALESCE(p.arr_processing_entity_id, CAST(ARRAY[] AS ARRAY(VARCHAR))),
                  x -> NOT NULLIF(TRIM(x), '') IS NULL
                ),
                x -> TRIM(x)
              )
            )
          ) AS arr_authorization_processing_entity_id,
          COALESCE(d.arr_document_filter, CAST(ARRAY[] AS ARRAY(VARCHAR))) AS arr_document_filter,
          COALESCE(m.arr_segment_filter, CAST(ARRAY[] AS ARRAY(VARCHAR))) AS arr_segment_filter,
          COALESCE(r.arr_request_duration_filter, CAST(ARRAY[] AS ARRAY(VARCHAR))) AS arr_request_duration_filter,
          CASE
            WHEN d.sk_transaction_event IS NULL
            THEN 'no_document_fact'
            ELSE 'retained_document_rows'
          END AS cd_document_filter_status,
          CASE
            WHEN m.sk_event IS NULL
            THEN 'no_linked_segment'
            ELSE 'retained_linked_segments'
          END AS cd_segment_filter_status,
          CASE
            WHEN r.sk_transaction_event IS NULL
            THEN 'request_array_unavailable_or_empty'
            ELSE 'request_scope_not_logged_leg_mapping'
          END AS cd_request_duration_status,
          NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_final_destination_country)), '') AS cd_final_destination_country,
          NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_stay_type)), '') AS cd_stay_type,
          NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(s.cd_return_onward_ticket)), '') AS cd_return_onward_ticket,

collections.description:
TIM-IDL-F05-01/03. Journey counts by logged rule-set type and evaluation result.

One row per daily Journey counting group, rule-type/result membership and scalar filter combination. The row key follows the grouping recipe in the SELECT and must be unique. A Journey can appear in several types and result categories.

For result bars, take MAX(ni_journey_count) by sk_rule_set_evaluation_context, type and result, then SUM. For type totals and Top 10, deduplicate by evaluation context and type across eligible results before summing. Rank by descending type Journey count, then type name. Do not add result categories to get the type total.

For a segment breakdown, filter first and deduplicate by sk_journey_filter_context within each displayed type, result and segment tuple. The rule item and segment filters must come from the same logged segment. Only ok_to_board, conditional and not_ok_to_board enter chart categories; keep unknown results and mapping status available for coverage checks.

This table provides Journey counts. Separate passenger counts, transaction counts and a rule-type code are not included; agree how these requirement items will be shown with the report owner.

Filter first, then take MAX(ni_journey_count) per counting context and displayed category, then SUM. The count repeats across scalar filter rows. sk_journey_filter_context identifies the counting group, not a single Journey or a foreign key.

Destination, applicability, purpose, ticket, channel and processing entity must belong to the same logged segment. Document category, type and issuer must belong to the same document. Duration is request-wide and must be read with its unit and status; it is not linked to a destination or segment. Missing filter values retain their status so they do not silently remove Journeys. Dates use Journey departure date.
collections.comments:
Sources: fact_journey_event, fact_segment_transaction_event, fact_transaction_document_event, fact_transaction_event.

Loaded incrementally by data engineering. Recompute the complete affected counting groups, including their old keys and scalar combinations. Remove groups that disappear; do not add deltas to repeated counts.

History: current derived values for the retained events. To trace a group back to its Journeys, rerun the membership and key logic against the corresponding source version.

Checks: unique row key, positive and consistent counts within each context, and Journey totals matching the source after deduplication. Keep unknown classifications and parsing failures visible.

Keep account/user access rules on report and export paths. Request payloads and passenger/document identifiers remain restricted.
